2021-02-01.kline: Price fell from the left side of the window to a low zone around bars 4 to 10, then rallied sharply to the window high near bars 14 to 16. A pullback of several red candles since then has pushed the latest close back into the lower half of the range, giving back roughly two-thirds of the rally, so the shape is an inverted V with a rounded top.
2021-02-01.volume: Volume stays in a fairly steady band across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars cluster around the top of the rally and the red down days just after it, while the green up days in the middle of the window are similar in size.
2021-02-01.combined: Price rallied and then reversed lower on volume that did not clearly expand, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. The flat volume suggests the pullback is not yet a high-conviction selloff and the reversal signal is only moderately supported.

2021-02-02.kline: The price rallied from a low base in the middle of the window to a peak near the window high around the mid-to-late candles, then fell back over several red days to near the lower part of the range before a small bounce. The shape is an inverted V with most of the rise given back, and the latest close sits slightly below the midpoint of the range.
2021-02-02.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars cluster on the rally's peak days and the sell-off's red days, and the most recent bar is moderate, not the largest in the window.
2021-02-02.combined: The high-volume red days during the decline suggest sellers were active as price fell from the peak, which supports a top rather than a simple pullback. Because volume is flat overall and the latest day is only moderate, the reversal signal is not strongly confirmed by volume.

2021-02-03.kline: Price rallied from the lower-left area to a peak near the top of the window, then fell sharply, giving back most of the rise, before a partial bounce; the shape is a rounded inverted V. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, roughly 45% up from the window low.
2021-02-03.volume: Volume stays at a similar level across the window, with no clear surge or drop in the latest days. The tallest bars are on the early red down day and the red day near the peak, while recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier ones.
2021-02-03.combined: The reversal from the top is not backed by a volume expansion on the decline, so the top looks less decisive. Price has reversed lower, but flat volume means the signal needs confirmation from further selling on higher volume.

2021-02-04.kline: Price rallies from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high around the middle-right, then falls sharply on several red days to near the window low before a partial recovery with green candles. The latest close sits roughly at the midpoint of the range, slightly above the post-drop low, so the fall gave back more than half of the rise.
2021-02-04.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars fall on the red days around the peak and the sell-off, while the most recent green days show modest volume similar to earlier levels.
2021-02-04.combined: Heavy volume on the decline and only average volume on the recovery suggest sellers were more committed than buyers, which supports a topping reversal. Confirmation would need the price to fail back below the peak area on rising volume.

2021-02-05.kline: The price rallied from near the window low to a peak near the top of the range, then fell sharply on long red candles, giving back most of the rise, and has recently stabilized with small bodies around the midpoint of the range, forming an inverted-V shape where the latest close sits roughly mid-range.
2021-02-05.volume: Volume was heavy during the rally and the sell-off, with the tallest bars near the peak and on the large red decline days, then tapered to clearly lower, mid-height bars on the most recent sessions, matching the contracting volume state.
2021-02-05.combined: Heavy volume on the decline followed by fading volume in the latest sessions suggests the selling pressure is easing, so the top is not yet confirmed as a clean reversal and the pattern needs further price follow-through to resolve.

2021-02-08.kline: Price climbed to a spike high about two-thirds of the way through the window, then fell sharply through several large red candles to the window low near the 75% mark. The last several days show a partial rebound of roughly half the decline, with the latest green close sitting around the middle-to-upper part of the range, just below the earlier highs.
2021-02-08.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bars come during the sell-off around the spike and low, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter and lower, showing declining activity as the rebound develops.
2021-02-08.combined: The rebound is occurring on shrinking volume, so the recovery lacks strong buying conviction and does not yet confirm a durable bottom. A move above the prior highs on rising volume would be needed to strengthen the reversal case.

2021-02-09.kline: Price rose from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top around the middle-late days, then fell sharply to a low near the lower part of the range, and has since rebounded in choppy, overlapping candles. The latest red candle closes only slightly above the middle of the range, about 40% of the way back from the low, so there is no clean rise or fall to classify as a reversal or trend.
2021-02-09.volume: Volume is contracting, with the strongest bars around the sharp sell-off in the middle of the window and a tall red spike just before it. Volume falls steadily over the last several days, and the recent bars are clearly lower than the earlier peaks, with both up and down days at similar modest levels.
2021-02-09.combined: Price is moving sideways in a choppy range while volume shrinks, which suggests the sell-off has lost momentum but no clear direction has been established. Without a breakout or breakdown on rising volume, the pattern remains a consolidation.

2021-02-10.kline: Price climbs from a low around the early-window base to a peak near the window high around day 11, then falls back over about three days, giving back more than half of the rise. The latest closes recover modestly into the middle of the range, forming a rounded inverted-V top.
2021-02-10.volume: Volume is contracting, with the largest spike on the red day at the peak and the tallest red bars during the sell-off, while the most recent days show clearly smaller bars than earlier in the window, with mostly red down-days and a small green bar at the end.
2021-02-10.combined: The heavy volume on the decline from the peak confirms selling pressure, and the recent rebound on lighter volume suggests weak buying conviction, so the top appears to be holding.

2021-02-11.kline: Price rallied over several days from the lower part of the window to a sharp peak near the window high, then fell back hard through the middle, giving back more than half of the rise, forming an inverted-V style top. A partial green recovery stalled in the upper-middle area, and the latest red candles drift lower, leaving the final close in the lower half of the range.
2021-02-11.volume: Volume is contracting: the bars were heaviest during the rally and the sharp selloff near the peak, with a very large spike around the top, then shrink steadily toward the right. The most recent red down days carry the smallest volume bars of the window.
2021-02-11.combined: The heavy volume on the peak and the initial sell-off confirms the reversal, but the falling volume on the recent declines suggests selling pressure is fading rather than accelerating. This supports a topping pattern with a weakening downside move that would need a volume increase to confirm further weakness.

2021-02-12.kline: Price rallied over the first half of the window with several green candles, peaking near the window high around the middle of the window, then fell sharply on red candles to a low about a quarter of the way up the range. A partial bounce to the middle of the range was followed by a drift lower with lower highs, so the latest small green candle closes in the lower-middle of the range, forming an inverted-V style top.
2021-02-12.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bar is a red day near the peak-to-decline transition, and bars shrink steadily toward the end of the window, with the most recent days showing the lowest volume. 2021-02-12.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp decline followed by shrinking volume on the rebound and the latest sessions suggests selling pressure dominated and buyers are not participating, which supports a top pattern rather than a durable recovery.

2021-02-16.kline: Price rose from a low near the left edge through several green candles to a high near the top of the window, then fell sharply over several red candles to a low near the starting level, roughly an inverted V. 2021-02-16.volume: Volume was heavy during the rise and especially on the sharp selloff, where one tall red bar stands out near the window's peak volume. Volume then contracted steadily, with the most recent bars clearly smaller than earlier ones, and the latest down day is on below-average volume.
2021-02-16.combined: The high-volume sell-off after the rise, followed by quieter trading and a close in the lower half, supports a reversal from the high rather than a continuation. The fading volume during the sideways recovery suggests little conviction behind the rebound.

2021-02-17.kline: Price starts near the window low, rises over about four or five days to a peak near the top of the range, then falls over the next dozen-plus days in a rounded, inverted-V shape that gives back most of the rise. 2021-02-17.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur during the early rally and the sharp red days near the peak, while the bars over the recent declining stretch are noticeably shorter. 2021-02-22.kline: The window opens near the top of its range, then falls sharply through the middle, with a large red candle carrying price toward the window low. 2021-02-23.kline: The window opens near the top of the range with red candles, then falls in steps to a long red candle near the lower part of the range. 2021-02-24.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, falls steeply through the first half, bounces briefly in the middle, and then declines again into the right side, with the latest small green candles sitting in the lower part of the range near the window low. The rebound recovers only about 40% of the fall, so this is a downtrend with a bounce, not a reversal.

2021-03-05.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the chart to a low near the bottom, with small bounces along the way. 2021-03-05.combined: Heavy volume on the recent down days confirms selling pressure behind the downtrend. The small green close on the latest day, with still-elevated volume, suggests only a tentative bounce so far, not a reversal.

2021-03-08.kline: Price falls across the 20-day window in a stair-step decline with small green bounces, and the final red candle drops to a new low below the earlier lows near the bottom of the range, closing in the lowest part of the window. 2021-03-09.kline: The price path is a steady decline from a high near the top of the window toward the lower part of the range, with small bounces along the way, including a red candle near the window low just before the final green candle. 2021-03-10.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window from near the top of the range, with a few green bounces along the way, including a sharp drop to the window low near the second-to-last session. 2021-03-12.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range at the start to a low near the bottom around the middle-late bars, with a brief mid-window bounce that does not change the decline. 2021-09-15.kline: Price rallied for several days from the lower part of the window to a peak near the window high, then fell steeply for several days, forming an inverted-V shape. The fall gave back roughly two-thirds of the rise, and the latest small green candle leaves the close in the lower third of the range.
2021-09-15.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the largest spike on a red down day near the right side and the next red days also elevated. Earlier green up days carry moderate volume, while the final green day is noticeably lower than the preceding selling days.
2021-09-15.combined: Heavy volume on the falling days alongside lighter volume on the last bounce suggests distribution and selling pressure outweighing buying, which supports the top reversal. The weak final up day offers little evidence of a recovery.

2021-09-16.kline: Price rises over several days from the lower part of the window to a peak near the window high, then falls over several days with large red candles, giving back most of the rise. The latest green candle sits in the lower half of the range, forming a rounded inverted-V top.
2021-09-16.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the largest bars appearing in the later decline as red down days run well above the earlier volume levels. Green up days in the middle of the window carry only moderate volume.
2021-09-16.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp down days alongside a fading rally suggests sellers are taking control after the peak, which supports the reversal-top reading.

2021-09-17.kline: Price rallied from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top of the range, forming a rounded inverted-V top, then fell over several sessions with large red candles. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the window range, giving back more than half of the rally, so the close sits in the lower part of the range.
2021-09-17.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the most recent days clearly higher than earlier. The tallest bars cluster on the red down days of the decline and on the final red bar at the right edge, while the green bounce days show smaller volume.
2021-09-17.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp red decline after the peak suggests selling pressure is confirming the reversal from the top. The rising volume into the latest down day supports the view that the rally has failed.

2021-09-20.kline: Price climbs from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-late days, then falls over several sessions with mostly large red candles, giving back most of the rise. The shape is an inverted V with a rounded top. The latest candle is a large red bar sitting at the bottom of the window range, so the close is in the lower part of the range.
2021-09-20.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the earlier bars modest and the bars during the decline and the final sessions much taller. The tallest bars cluster on the red down days near the top and during the sell-off, while the green up days in the early and middle part of the rise carry lighter volume.
2021-09-20.combined: Heavy volume on the falling red days alongside a rise on lighter volume suggests distribution at the top and supports the reversal. The latest large red session on high volume confirms that sellers are in control.

2021-09-21.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window into a sharp peak near the upper part of the range, forming an inverted V, then falls steeply back down to the window low area. The latest candle is a small green bar near the bottom of the range, so the close sits in the lower half after giving back most of the rise.
2021-09-21.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars come on several red down days in the middle-to-late part of the window, while the most recent bar is only moderate and green.
2021-09-21.combined: The rally to the peak came with no clear volume expansion, and the decline came on several heavy red days, which suggests selling pressure during the reversal. Flat overall volume means the signal is not strongly confirmed, but the latest close in the lower half supports a top-reversal reading.

2021-09-22.kline: Price rises from the middle of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the 9th to 11th sessions, forming a rounded inverted-V top. It then falls back over the following days to a low near the bottom of the window, leaving the latest green candle in the lower-middle part of the range.
2021-09-22.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no clear surge or drying up. The tallest red bars cluster around the peak and early selloff, and the most recent green days are not notably heavier than earlier sessions.
2021-09-22.combined: The fall from the peak occurred on volume that is not clearly elevated, so the selloff lacks strong conviction. The latest bounce is small and unsupported by a volume increase, so the reversal is not confirmed by volume.

2021-09-23.kline: Price rises over the first half of the window to a peak near the top of the range, then falls through several large red candles and gives back most of the rise. The latest days are small green candles bouncing off a low near the bottom, leaving the latest close in the lower half of the range, which forms an inverted-V top.
2021-09-23.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no sustained surge or fade. The largest red bars cluster during the sharp decline in the middle of the window, while the green up days near the end carry only moderate volume.
2021-09-23.combined: Heavy volume on the decline and lighter volume on the late rebound suggest sellers are in control after the top. Because overall volume is flat rather than expanding, the reversal signal is only moderately confirmed.

2021-09-24.kline: Price rose from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top of the range, then fell over several sessions to the lower part of the range, giving back most of the advance in an inverted-V shape. The latest candle is a small green bounce that closes in the lower half of the range, well below the window high.
2021-09-24.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window with no sustained build-up or drop-off. The biggest bars cluster on red down days in the middle and late part of the decline, while recent green days show moderate volume similar to the earlier bars.
2021-09-24.combined: The price peak came on moderate volume and the decline was driven by heavier selling on red days, so the inverted-V top is supported by sellers being more active. The flat recent volume and small green bounce do not show a clear buying push back toward the prior high.

2021-09-27.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, with a sharp drop from a high near the window's upper middle down through several large red candles, and a few green bounces along the way. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2021-09-27.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest volume bars are the large red down days in the middle, while the most recent bars are clearly shorter than those earlier spikes. The recent red and green bars are both lower in volume, so the chart shows the activity fading as price moves lower.
2021-09-27.combined: Falling price on shrinking volume suggests the selling pressure is losing strength, but it does not yet show a reversal. The downtrend remains intact until price stabilizes or volume picks up on up days.

2021-09-28.kline: Price opens the window in the lower-middle of the range, rallies briefly over about four green days to a high near the top of the range, then falls sharply on a run of mostly red candles that gives back nearly all of the rise. The latest close sits near the bottom of the window range, so the fall dominates the window.
2021-09-28.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained surge or fade across the window. The tallest bars cluster in the middle and early part of the decline on red down days, while the most recent bars are of similar height to earlier ones, with green up days not carrying noticeably more volume than red days.
2021-09-28.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp red declines alongside the price fall confirms selling pressure, but the flat recent volume and the small green bounces suggest the downtrend is not accelerating and has no clear volume-backed reversal yet.

2021-09-29.kline: After a brief rise from the left side of the window to a peak near the top of the range, price fell steeply through the middle and into the lower part of the range. Lows are clustered near the window bottom, and the latest day is a small green candle that sits in the lower part of the range, so the bounce is too small to change the downtrend.
2021-09-29.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained build-up or fade. Several tall red bars appear in the middle and late window on down days, while the green up days are mostly lower and more moderate, and the most recent bars are close to the window average.
2021-09-29.combined: Price keeps falling while volume stays flat, so the decline shows no clear volume confirmation of selling pressure or exhaustion. The small green bounce on ordinary volume does not signal a reversal, so the downtrend remains the most likely reading.

2021-09-30.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the chart to a low near the bottom, with a few small green bounces along the way. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so the pattern is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2021-09-30.volume: Volume is flat, as the state says: the recent bars are about the same size as the earlier ones. The chart shows several tall red bars in the early and middle part of the window, along with moderate bars on both red and green days, and the most recent bars are no larger than the earlier average.
2021-09-30.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest the decline is persistent but not accelerating, with no clear sign of capitulation or a volume-driven reversal. The downtrend pattern holds, though the lack of a volume surge on the latest down days means there is no strong confirmation of further selling pressure.

2021-10-01.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range at the left edge down to a low near the bottom around the middle-to-late bars, with a partial bounce of green candles in between. The latest candle is green and sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high, so the bounce recovers only a small portion of the decline.
2021-10-01.volume: Volume shows no clear trend, with occasional tall red spikes earlier in the window and moderate bars more recently. The most recent days are close to the average level of the earlier window, consistent with a flat volume state. Green and red bars are mixed, with no sustained surge on the up days.
2021-10-01.combined: The falling price with no sustained volume expansion suggests the downtrend lacks strong conviction, but the bounce is not supported by heavy buying volume either. Together they point to a continued downtrend rather than a confirmed reversal.

2021-10-04.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window from near the window high, with a steep decline, a brief sideways-to-up bounce in the middle (a small rally of a few green candles), and then a renewed drop. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range, so the latest close sits in the lower part of the window and the bounce does not change the downtrend.
2021-10-04.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained rise or fall: bars of similar height appear throughout, with a few taller red bars early in the window and a tall red bar near the middle-left. Recent bars are close to the window average, and the last few bars are mixed in color and height without a clear surge.
2021-10-04.combined: Price is falling while volume stays about the same as earlier in the window, so the selling pressure is steady rather than accelerating. This supports the downtrend without a clear sign of capitulation or a reversal.

2021-10-05.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range with a series of large red candles and a few small green bounces in the middle. The window high is at the left edge and the window low sits in the final few days, and the latest small green candle closes in the lower part of the range, well below the midpoint. This is a persistent decline rather than a V or double-top shape.
2021-10-05.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no single day standing out dramatically. The tallest bars appear early on, around the second and third days, and the later bars are of similar height, with red and green days mixed in similar sizes.
2021-10-05.combined: Falling prices on flat volume suggest a steady downtrend without strong conviction or a volume-driven capitulation. The latest small green candle on similar volume is too weak to signal a reversal.

2021-10-06.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range and dropping to the lower part with a small green bounce in the middle. The latest few candles are small green bars near the bottom of the range, so the latest close sits in the lower part of the range without a clear reversal.
2021-10-06.volume: Volume is flat: the tallest red bars come early in the window, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar in height to the mid-window bars. Heavy red days and lighter green days are mixed through the window, with no clear surge at the end.
2021-10-06.combined: The price decline with flat volume shows no strong selling or buying surge, so the downtrend lacks conviction. The small green bounce at the end is not confirmed by rising volume, so it does not signal a reversal.

2021-10-07.kline: The price path falls from a high near the top of the window, with a tall red candle at the left edge, through a series of lower highs and lower lows, with small green bounces along the way. The latest close, a small green candle, sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high and close to the window low, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2021-10-07.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the tall early red-day bars are roughly matched by similar-height bars in the recent days, with no clear surge or drop-off at the end. Red and green bars are mixed through the window, and the most recent green bars are of moderate size.
2021-10-07.combined: Falling prices with no volume expansion suggest the downtrend is steady rather than accelerating, and the lack of heavier volume on the recent bounce means it does not yet signal a reversal. The pattern is best read as a continued downtrend with no volume confirmation of a turn.

2021-10-08.kline: The window starts near the top of its range with several red down candles, then falls to the lows with a brief green bounce in the middle of the window that recovers only part of the decline. Late in the window price slips to near the window low and the latest candle is a small green bounce that leaves the close in the lower part of the range, so this is a downtrend.
2021-10-08.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the tallest bars occur early on red down days, and the most recent bars are at similar, moderate heights without a surge or a sharp fade. Volume is not clearly higher on the falling days than on the green days, so it does not show a strong directional signal.
2021-10-08.combined: Price falling on steady, unremarkable volume suggests the downtrend is continuing without a clear increase in selling conviction. The small green bounce on the latest day, with no volume surge, does not signal a reversal.

2021-10-11.kline: Price starts near the top of the 20-day range, falls through the middle of the window, and makes its lows around days 15-17 near the bottom. A small green bounce in the middle of the window does not change the broader decline. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, below the midpoint.
2021-10-11.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars come early on red down days, and the latest red day is only moderate, so the chart does not show a clear volume spike or drop-off at the end.
2021-10-11.combined: Steady volume alongside falling prices suggests a gradual downtrend without a clear capitulation or accumulation signal. The mid-window bounce was not backed by a volume surge, so it does not change the bearish read.

2021-10-12.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range and stepping down with several bounces along the way, such as green candles in the middle. The latest close is a red candle near the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal, since no rally of several days recovered half the decline.
2021-10-12.volume: Volume is flat, staying about the same across the window. The chart shows tall red bars on some early down days and a few tall bars mid-window, with green and red bars at similar heights through the recent days, and the latest red bar is moderate rather than a spike.
2021-10-12.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the downtrend continues without strong conviction from buyers or sellers. The lack of a volume surge on the latest down day does not signal capitulation or a reversal.

2021-10-13.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, starting from highs near the top of the range and sliding through a series of lower highs and lower lows. Bounces, such as the green candles in the middle, are small and do not reverse the decline. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, close to the window low.
2021-10-13.volume: Volume is flat, with recent sessions at about the same level as earlier in the window. The tallest bars come early and in the middle, on both red and green days, while the last several bars are moderate and similar in height to the earlier ones. No single recent day stands out as a surge or a sharp drop.
2021-10-13.combined: Falling prices on steady, unchanged volume point to a persistent but unemphatic selloff rather than a capitulation or a high-conviction breakdown. The downtrend is intact, but the lack of a volume increase on the latest down days gives little extra confirmation of it.

2021-10-14.kline: The window opens with a large red candle near the window high, followed by a steady decline with a few green bounces, and the lowest prices cluster in the late-middle of the window. The most recent candles recover from those lows, and the latest green close sits roughly in the middle of the range, not in the upper half, so this reads as a downtrend with a partial bounce rather than a reversal.
2021-10-14.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with the tallest bars on the early red down days and similar-sized bars later on. Recent days show moderate volume that is not noticeably above or below earlier levels, and up and down days carry comparable volume.
2021-10-14.combined: The downtrend is not accompanied by a volume surge or fade, so the selling pressure looks steady rather than exhausting. The recent bounce on unchanged volume is weak confirmation, so it does not yet signal a reversal.

2021-10-15.kline: Price rises to a peak near the top of the window around the sixth day, then falls for about nine sessions to a low near the bottom of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom. The last six or so sessions recover roughly two-thirds of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range but below the window high.
2021-10-15.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with the tallest red bars early on and near the middle of the fall. Recent sessions show moderate green up-day bars at about the same height as earlier bars, so there is no clear surge or drop-off in the latest days.
2021-10-15.combined: The recovery from the low is occurring on up days with ordinary volume rather than a clear expansion, which makes the V-shaped bottom look plausible but not strongly confirmed. The volume pattern does not show the buying surge that would normally back a strong reversal.

2021-10-18.kline: Price rises from the left side to a peak in the first third of the window, then falls over roughly nine days to a low near the middle-to-right of the window. A rebound of several green candles then recovers most of the decline, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range near the window high, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2021-10-18.volume: Volume is flat: the recent bars are about the same height as the earlier bars, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bar is a red day in the early-middle of the window, and the last few green up-day bars are moderate in size.
2021-10-18.combined: The rebound on volume that is no higher than earlier in the window gives the recovery only modest confirmation, so the V-shaped bottom is plausible but not strongly backed by volume. A renewed rise on clearly expanding volume would be needed to confirm the reversal.

2021-10-19.kline: After an early rise and a decline to a low near the middle-to-lower part of the window, price recovered in a V-shaped reversal and the final green candle closed at the very top of the range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window. The latest close sits near the window high, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2021-10-19.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop, so the volume state is flat. The tallest bars are red selloff days in the middle of the window, while the most recent green bar is of ordinary size and does not stand out.
2021-10-19.combined: The breakout above the earlier highs is not backed by a volume expansion, so the move is less convincing than a breakout on heavy volume. Confirmation would need higher volume on the up days that follow.

2021-10-20.kline: After a choppy decline from the upper part of the window to lows near the lower-middle of the range around days 13-15, price rallies sharply in the final five or so sessions, with a series of green candles. The latest close sits at the top of the window and above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so the pattern is a breakout after a V-shaped reversal from the lows.
2021-10-20.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent bars are roughly the same height as the earlier bars, with no clear surge on the strongest green up days. The tallest red bar appears early in the window, and the recent green up days are not standing out in volume.
2021-10-20.combined: The sharp price move above the earlier range is not confirmed by a volume surge, so the breakout is weaker and less reliable than one backed by rising volume. Rising price on flat volume suggests the move may need follow-through volume to confirm it.

2021-10-21.kline: Price falls from a high near the top of the window at the start, drops through the middle and bottoms out around the 15th bar near the window low, then rallies steeply over the final several days, forming a V shape. The latest close sits near the window high, in the upper part of the range, and the rally recovers the full decline. The last close is not clearly above the early-window highs, so this is not a breakout.
2021-10-21.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge. A few early red days carry some of the tallest bars, and the recent green rally days are moderate rather than clearly expanding. Up and down days show no consistent volume difference.
2021-10-21.combined: The V-shaped recovery is supported by price, but volume does not expand on the rally, so the reversal is only weakly confirmed. Rising price on flat volume suggests the bounce lacks strong conviction.

2021-10-22.kline: After an early choppy stretch in the middle of the range, price fell to a low around the middle-late part of the window, then rallied in a steady climb over the final several days to finish near the window high. The latest red candle sits in the upper part of the range, close to the highest levels of the window.
2021-10-22.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the tallest bars are early and in the middle, and the most recent days run at about the same level as earlier, with no clear surge or fade. Up days (green) and down days (red) are mixed in volume size, with several green days on the rally carrying similar volume to the earlier red days.
2021-10-22.combined: The steady rally to the window high is not accompanied by a volume expansion, so the uptrend is supported by price alone and lacks volume confirmation. The pattern still reads as an uptrend, but the flat volume suggests the move may be less conviction-driven than a volume-backed breakout.

2021-10-25.kline: The window starts with red down days, falls to a low about 60% of the way across, then rallies through a series of green candles with a sharp run up to the right. The latest candle is a small red day near the window high, so the close sits in the upper part of the range; the rise spans most of the window, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2021-10-25.volume: Volume stays in a similar band across the window, with no clear surge: the tallest bar is an early red day, and the most recent bars are moderate and close to the window average. Volume on the rally's green up days is not noticeably larger than on the red down days.
2021-10-25.combined: Price rising on steady, unremarkable volume shows a persistent uptrend without strong volume confirmation, so the move is orderly but lacks a volume-driven push.

2021-10-26.kline: Price starts near the lower-middle of the window, pulls back and chops sideways for the first half, then rises strongly over the last 8 or so days into the upper part of the range, with big green bodies in the rally. The window high sits near the last few candles, and the latest close is a small red candle just below the recent highs, still in the upper part of the range, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout or reversal.
2021-10-26.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars come early and in the middle of the window, while the most recent bars are noticeably shorter. Up days (green) and down days (red) both show lower bars near the end, with the latest red day at a moderate height that is still below the earlier peaks.
2021-10-26.combined: Rising prices on falling volume suggest the advance is losing momentum and is not fully confirmed by buying interest. The uptrend is intact, but the lighter volume into the latest highs is a caution sign for continuation.

2021-10-27.kline: Price fell from the window's upper-middle area into a low near the early-middle bars, then rallied in several strong green days into the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped recovery that has regained most of the decline. The latest closes sit in the upper half of the range, just below the window high.
2021-10-27.volume: Volume is contracting, as the chart shows: the tallest bars are at the start of the window and during the mid-window rally, while the final several bars are visibly shorter. The most recent red days carry noticeably lighter volume than the earlier selloff days.
2021-10-27.combined: The rally from the low came on substantial volume, which supports the recovery, but the fading volume in the latest sessions suggests buying interest is weakening. The V-shaped reversal is therefore not yet strongly confirmed.

2021-10-28.kline: After a choppy start with a mid-window dip, price climbs through most of the 20 days, and the final green candle closes far above the highs of the earlier window, leaving the prior range upward. That makes it a breakout, with the latest close near the top of the window range.
2021-10-28.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with tall and short bars mixed throughout and no sustained expansion. The final green day is one of the taller bars but is not clearly larger than several earlier sessions, so it does not stand out as a volume surge.
2021-10-28.combined: The upside breakout is supported by rising price, but volume is not expanding on the breakout day, so the move is less convincing and needs follow-through on higher volume to confirm it.

2021-10-29.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, from a low base on the left to a series of higher highs near the right, with a tall green surge late in the window. The latest green candle has pulled back to roughly the middle-to-upper part of the range, below the window high, so the rise is intact but the last day gave back some ground.
2021-10-29.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay at similar heights through the window, with no clear surge or drying up. The latest green up-day bar is about as tall as the earlier bars, and the down-day bars in the middle of the window are of similar size.
2021-10-29.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong buying conviction. The flat volume does not confirm an acceleration, so the last-day pullback is best read as a minor pause within the uptrend rather than a reversal.

2021-11-01.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left area of the window to a high near the right side, with a few red down days interrupting the rise, and the last day closes red in the upper part of the range, just below the window high after a sharp spike.
2021-11-01.volume: Volume is roughly flat: bars stay in a similar band through the window, with a tall green day near the end and a tall red day on the final bar, but no sustained increase or decrease in the most recent days.
2021-11-01.combined: The rising price path with steady volume suggests the uptrend is intact without strong volume-driven confirmation, and the latest red day on similar volume points only to a modest pullback.

2021-11-02.kline: Price climbs from the lower part of the window to near the top, with a sharp rally in the later half and a few small pullbacks along the way. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below the window high, so it does not clearly break above the earlier highs.
2021-11-02.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, consistent with the measured state, with no sustained surge. The tallest bar sits on a green up day in the later part of the window, and the most recent day's volume is moderate, close to the earlier levels.
2021-11-02.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong buying conviction, so there is no volume-backed confirmation of a breakout yet.

2021-11-03.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting from the lower part of the range with choppy early candles and a strong green rally through the middle. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, near the window high, after small pullbacks along the way, so this is an uptrend.
2021-11-03.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained expansion or contraction, though it has a few spikes. The tallest bar is a green up-day in the later-middle part of the window, and the most recent bars are moderate green bars that trail off slightly at the right edge.
2021-11-03.combined: Price has been rising while volume stays roughly even, so the uptrend has no strong volume confirmation. The large green spike on heavy volume supports the rally, but the recent flat-to-lower volume suggests less conviction behind the latest advance.

2021-11-04.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, from a low near the left side to a high near the right, with a few red pullbacks along the way (including a shallow one before the final rise). The latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, just below the window high, so this is an uptrend rather than a reversal or breakout.
2021-11-04.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay at roughly similar heights from left to right, with a few taller green bars in the middle and near the right third of the window and no clear surge or drying up in the most recent days. Up days and down days are mixed in size, with no obvious volume spike on the latest session.
2021-11-04.combined: Rising prices on flat volume suggest the uptrend is steady but lacks strong new buying conviction. The trend is intact, but the volume pattern does not confirm an accelerating move.

2021-11-05.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window to the upper-right, with a dip early on and a few pullbacks inside the rise. The latest candles sit near the window high, about in the upper part of the range, and no close clearly leaves the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2021-11-05.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in the latest days compared with earlier. The tallest bars are green, appearing in the middle-to-late part of the window, while recent bars are moderate and mixed between green and red.
2021-11-05.combined: Rising price with flat volume suggests the uptrend is steady but lacks strong conviction, since the latest up moves are not backed by an expanding volume surge.

2021-11-08.kline: Price climbs from low levels on the left to near the top of the 20-day range on the right, with a few down days in between. The latest candles are small and sit in the upper part of the range, close to the window high but not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2021-11-08.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained build-up or fade. The tallest green bar sits around the middle-to-late rise, and recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier ones, with both up and down days mixed in.
2021-11-08.combined: Price has been rising on volume that is not expanding, so the advance is orderly but shows no added conviction. The trend is intact, but a clear confirmation would need volume to pick up on the up days near the highs.

2021-11-09.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from a low on the left and climbing in a series of higher highs and higher lows to the upper part of the range. The window high is a tall green spike about two-thirds of the way through, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below that high, with no clear break above it.
2021-11-09.volume: Volume is flat, with recent bars about the same size as earlier ones. The largest bar is a green up day in the middle of the window, while the most recent days show moderate red and green bars near the window average.
2021-11-09.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend is intact but lack strong buying conviction. The absence of a volume surge on the latest advance means it does not confirm a breakout.

2021-11-10.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to near the window high in the upper right, with a steady series of higher highs and higher lows, including a large green spike around the peak. The latest candle is a large red day that pulls back from the top but still closes in the upper half of the range, so this is a pullback inside a rise rather than a reversal.
2021-11-10.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bar is a green up day near the high, and the most recent red down day is of ordinary size, not a heavy-volume spike.
2021-11-10.combined: The rising price over most of the window with mostly steady volume supports the uptrend, but the lack of heavy volume on the latest red day means the pullback shows no strong selling pressure, so the trend is not clearly weakening.

2021-11-11.kline: Price rallied from near the window low to a peak near the top of the range, with a large green spike, then fell back over the last several sessions in a mostly red run. The latest red candle closes around the middle to lower half of the range, having given back a little more than half of the rise, which fits an inverted-V top.
2021-11-11.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars come mid-window, including a large green day near the peak, while the most recent red days trade at volumes similar to earlier sessions.
2021-11-11.combined: The price decline is not accompanied by a volume surge, so the sell-off lacks strong conviction. The reversal top is plausible but not confirmed by heavier selling volume.

2021-11-12.kline: Price rallied from near the window low to a peak in the middle-to-late window, then fell over several red candles, forming an inverted-V shape. The latest green close sits roughly in the lower-middle of the range, below the peak and well above the window low.
2021-11-12.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction in the last few days. The tallest bar appears in the middle-left of the window on an up day, and recent red down-day bars are similar in height to earlier bars.
2021-11-12.combined: The rally-then-fall shape with the close in the lower half suggests a top, but flat volume gives no strong confirmation that sellers are overwhelming buyers. The reversal signal is therefore tentative until volume supports the decline.

2021-11-15.kline: Price rallied over several days to a sharp spike high near the window top, then sold off hard, giving back roughly half the rise, with a bounce into the middle of the range. The latest red candle closes around the middle of the range, roughly the lower half, so this reads as an inverted-V style top rather than a breakout.
2021-11-15.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained surge or drop. The largest bar sits on the big green spike day near the middle of the window, and the bars after it stay at similar levels, mostly red days.
2021-11-15.combined: The heavy-volume green spike followed by steady red sessions on similar volume suggests the rally met supply and the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume. Watch whether later sessions expand volume on further declines.

2021-11-16.kline: After a mid-range start, price spikes to the window high around the 8th-9th bars, then falls over about 7 days to near the window low by the 16th-17th bars, with several large red candles. The last 3-4 days rebound on mostly green candles and recover roughly half of the decline, leaving the latest close in the upper half of the range, so this reads as a V-shaped bottom.
2021-11-16.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: most bars sit at a similar level, with a few tall green bars around the early spike standing out, and the final bars are about average height, not clearly expanding or drying up.
2021-11-16.combined: The rebound off the low is not backed by a clear volume surge, so the recovery looks tentative rather than confirmed. Volume that is flat on both the decline and the rise suggests the reversal needs follow-through volume to be trusted.

2021-11-17.kline: Price falls from the middle-to-upper part of the window into a low region near the window low, around the 13th to 15th candles, then rises over about four candles back toward the window high. The latest green candle closes near the top of the range, recovering most of the earlier decline, which fits a V-shaped bottom.
2021-11-17.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, consistent with the flat state. The tallest bar lines up with the large green up-day early in the window, and the most recent green day is only moderate, not a clear surge.
2021-11-17.combined: Rising price on roughly flat volume gives the recovery less conviction than a volume-backed reversal would, so the bottom needs follow-through to be confirmed.

2021-11-18.kline: After a choppy middle section with a sharp mid-window drop, price rallies over the last four or five days, and the final green candle closes near the top of the 20-day range, well above the earlier highs near the middle-left of the window. The latest close sits at the window high, so it has left the prior range upward.
2021-11-18.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the recent days. The tallest bars are scattered among both red and green days, and the final green bar is only modestly higher than the bars before it.
2021-11-18.combined: Rising price without a clear increase in volume suggests the breakout is not strongly confirmed by participation. It would be stronger if volume expanded on the upward closes.

2021-11-19.kline: After a rally to a mid-window peak, price fell back into a dip near the window low, then rose steadily over the last several days. The final 2-3 green candles close well above the earlier highs and finish at the top of the window range, so the latest close sits near the window high.
2021-11-19.volume: Volume expands over the window: the earliest bars are moderate, the mid-window bars are lower, and the most recent bars are the tallest, with the largest green bars on the final up days. This lines up with the rising price, as the strongest volume comes on the up days.
2021-11-19.combined: Rising price on rising volume, with the latest closes above the prior range, confirms the breakout.

2021-11-22.kline: After a choppy, mostly sideways stretch in the lower part of the window, price rallies sharply over the last several days with large green candles and closes above the earlier highs, leaving the prior range upward. The window high is set by the final day's long upper wick, and the latest red close sits in the upper part of the range, roughly three-quarters of the way up.
2021-11-22.volume: Volume expands clearly into the end of the window: the rally days carry the tallest bars of the period, with the two most recent sessions among the highest, while the early sideways days had smaller, mixed volume. The big volume bars line up with the green up days, and the final red day also shows high volume.
2021-11-22.combined: Rising price on rising volume confirms the breakout above the prior range. The final red day on heavy volume, below a long upper wick, hints at some selling into the spike, so follow-through should be watched.

2021-11-23.kline: The window starts with a sideways, choppy stretch in the lower-middle of the range, then climbs steeply over the last 7 to 8 sessions into the upper part of the range. The rise makes new highs, including a red candle with a long upper wick that touches the window high, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below that peak.
2021-11-23.volume: Volume expands clearly through the rally, with the tallest bars in the last 5 to 6 sessions. Most of those bars are green, but the red day near the peak also carries high volume, and the final bar is slightly lower than the peak volume.
2021-11-23.combined: Heavy volume on rising green candles supports the uptrend, with buying interest growing as price climbs. The high-volume red day at the spike high is a warning that selling pressure appeared near the top, so the trend needs to hold its gains to stay intact.

2021-11-24.kline: Price falls to a low around the early-middle of the window, then rises in a steep advance, with pullbacks along the way. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, below the spike high from a long-wick red candle near the top, so this is an uptrend rather than a confirmed breakout.
2021-11-24.volume: Volume expands over the window: bars were modest early on, then rise sharply around the advance, with the tallest green bars near the late-window rally and a red high-volume bar at the top. The most recent bars remain well above the early-window levels, consistent with expanding volume.
2021-11-24.combined: Rising prices on rising volume suggest the uptrend is supported by active buying, though the long-wick candle near the top shows some selling pressure at higher prices.

2021-11-26.kline: Price spends the first half of the window in a low, choppy range, then climbs steeply over roughly the last six to seven sessions to a spike high near the window top. The final two sessions pull back on red candles, leaving the latest close about mid-to-upper range, so the pullback does not change the overall rising trend.
2021-11-26.volume: Volume is expanding: early bars are mixed and fairly tall, the mid-window is lighter, and the bars from the rally onward are the tallest in the window. The largest bars line up with the green up-days of the rally, and the most recent red down-day still carries a sizeable bar.
2021-11-26.combined: Rising prices on rising volume during the rally support the uptrend, but the red pullback on a sizeable volume bar shows some selling pressure near the highs. The trend is intact, though the latest pullback needs confirmation.

2021-11-29.kline: Price slid for roughly the first half of the window, bottoming around bars 10-11, then rallied sharply in a V-shaped recovery to a high spike near bar 15 that is at the top of the range. After a red pullback the last bar is green and closes in the upper part of the range, so the recovery has erased the earlier decline.
2021-11-29.volume: Volume is flat across the window, so recent days are about the same as earlier. The tallest bar sits in the middle-right during the rally, and the bars around the pullback and the latest sessions are moderate, mixing green and red days.
2021-11-29.combined: The price recovery from the low is not confirmed by a clear volume surge, so the reversal signal is only moderate. The price action and flat volume together suggest a V-shaped bottom that needs follow-through to be confirmed.

2021-11-30.kline: After a choppy, sideways start near the lower-middle of the range, with a dip of red candles around the middle-left, price rallied strongly over the later part of the window. The latest candle is a tall green bar that closes near the window high, which is set by a red day's long upper wick just before it, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2021-11-30.volume: Volume was modest and mixed through most of the window, then rose on the rightmost bar, which is the tallest volume bar in the chart and far above the surrounding days. That spike falls on a green up day, consistent with the volume spike state.
2021-11-30.combined: The strong rally into the latest close on the highest volume of the window suggests buying interest is driving the uptrend. Because the last close is near rather than clearly above the prior high, this confirms the uptrend more than it signals a confirmed breakout.

2021-12-01.kline: Price rose from a low near the bottom of the window through a series of higher highs and higher lows, with small red pullbacks along the way. The latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the window high, but not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is not a breakout.
2021-12-01.volume: A volume spike shows in the last three days: the second-to-last green day has the tallest bar in the window, and the latest red day also trades heavily, well above the early-window levels. Volume was modest at the lows and built as the rally progressed.
2021-12-01.combined: Heavy volume on the strong green up day supports the rally, but the heavy-volume red day on the latest bar signals selling into strength near the highs. The uptrend holds for now, though the latest session is a warning sign that needs confirmation from the next close.

2021-12-02.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from lows near the bottom of the range on the left to a spike near the window high in the final stretch, with several pullbacks along the way. The latest close is a green candle sitting in the upper-middle part of the range, below the window high, so the rise has not broken out.
2021-12-02.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are modest and similar in size, while the most recent days show the largest bars, including a very tall green day near the end and a tall red day just after it. Up days mostly carry the heavier volume in the final stretch, with the latest green day also above the early-window average.
2021-12-02.combined: Rising prices on rising volume support the uptrend, with heavier buying on the advance and the latest close holding in the upper part of the range. The bigger red-day volume during the pullback suggests some selling pressure, but it does not yet indicate a reversal.

2021-12-03.kline: Price starts near the window low, dips slightly in the first few candles, then climbs over most of the window with mostly green bars, peaking near the window high with a long-wicked spike before a small pullback. The latest close is a red candle in the upper half of the range, below the peak high, so the rise is intact and no reversal has occurred.
2021-12-03.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are short to moderate, while the recent bars, especially the tallest green bar near the peak and the following red bars, are clearly the highest in the window. Up days generally carry the largest volume, with a few high-volume red days in the final stretch.
2021-12-03.combined: Rising prices on rising volume support the uptrend and suggest strong buying interest. The high-volume red bar on the latest day shows some selling pressure near the highs, so the trend's continuation should be watched.

2021-12-06.kline: The 20-day window climbs from a choppy, lower-left start to a higher-right finish, with the latest green candle closing near the upper part of the range. The highest wick sits a few candles before the end and is not exceeded by the final close, so there is no clear breakout, and the pullbacks along the way are minor within the rise.
2021-12-06.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are small, while the later bars are much taller, with the tallest bars appearing in the middle-to-late section. Up and down days are mixed toward the end, with a few red days carrying heavy volume.
2021-12-06.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, though the heavy-volume red days near the end show some selling pressure that the latest green day has not fully overcome.

2021-12-07.kline: The price path climbs from near the bottom of the window to the top, with a few small pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles around the middle. The latest candle is a green bar closing near the window high, in the upper part of the range. The window high is a long upper wick on a red candle about two-thirds of the way across, so the close is near but not clearly above that prior high.
2021-12-07.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the earliest bars low and the bars in the middle and later part of the chart noticeably taller. The tallest bar sits on a green up day in the second half, and the most recent bars stay at moderately high levels. Up days carry most of the heavy volume, though a few high-volume red days appear in the latter half.
2021-12-07.combined: Rising prices on rising volume support the uptrend and suggest buyers are increasingly active. The close near the top of the range, with volume still elevated, is consistent with the rise continuing, though the lack of a clear close above the prior high means it is not yet a confirmed breakout.

2021-12-08.kline: Price climbs from low on the left to the top-right, with a few red pullbacks along the way. The last two or three green candles close near the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so the price has left its prior range upward.
2021-12-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, consistent with the measured state. The tallest bars sit in the middle of the window, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar in height to earlier ones rather than expanding sharply.
2021-12-08.combined: Rising prices on volume that is not expanding only partly confirm the breakout, so the move lacks strong volume backing. Watch whether the next up days bring higher volume to validate the breakout.

2021-12-09.kline: Price climbs from the low left side of the window to the high right side, with a few pullbacks along the way, most notably a sharp red day and a long upper wick near the middle. The latest close is a small red candle near the window high, in the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact.
2021-12-09.volume: Volume is flat overall: the most recent bars are roughly the same size as those earlier in the window. The tallest bars come in the middle, a large green bar around the middle of the window and a large red bar just after it, while the last several days are moderate and similar in size.
2021-12-09.combined: The rising price path with steady volume suggests the uptrend is continuing without fresh volume-driven conviction. The latest small red day on ordinary volume looks like a minor pause rather than a reversal, so the pattern stays UPTREND.

2021-12-10.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, rising from near the window low on the left to near the window high on the right, with small red pullbacks along the way such as the red candles in the middle. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, close to the window high, so the rise has not reversed.
2021-12-10.volume: Volume is flat, with recent days at about the same level as earlier in the window. The tallest bar sits in the middle-to-late part of the window on a red down day, while the most recent bars are moderate and similar in height to earlier ones, with no clear surge.
2021-12-10.combined: Steady higher highs and a close near the top of the range, on volume that has not expanded, suggest a persistent but unconfirmed uptrend. The big volume spike on a down day shows some selling pressure, but it did not stop the advance.

2021-12-13.kline: Price climbs steadily across the 20-day window from near the lows on the left to near the window high on the right, with several small pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles around the middle. The latest candle is a large red bar that opens near the top of the range and closes slightly lower, so the close still sits in the upper part of the range.
2021-12-13.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest green bars come in the middle-to-late stretch, and the most recent red day is also tall, so the flat state holds with a few spikes rather than a rising trend in activity.
2021-12-13.combined: Rising prices on steady volume suggest an orderly uptrend without strong evidence of accelerating buying interest. The latest large red day on relatively high volume is a caution that sellers were active near the high, though the close remains in the upper range.

2021-12-14.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right of the window, with a few pullbacks along the way, most notably a dip in the middle. The latest candle is red and closes just below the prior day's close, but it still sits near the top of the window range, so the uptrend holds.
2021-12-14.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The most recent two days are red and show somewhat taller bars than the days just before them, but the overall level is similar to earlier in the window, and one large green spike earlier stands out.
2021-12-14.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume suggest the uptrend is orderly without strong new buying conviction. The recent red down days on slightly higher volume are a mild caution that momentum may be softening near the highs.

2021-12-15.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from near the bottom to near the top, with small pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles mid-window and near the end. The latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, close to the window high, so the rise is intact with no clear breakout above a prior range.
2021-12-15.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in the latest days. The tallest bar sits in the first half, and the most recent sessions show moderate bars that are similar in height to earlier ones, with red and green days mixed.
2021-12-15.combined: A steady price climb on broadly even volume suggests the uptrend is orderly, but without a volume surge the move does not show strong new buying pressure. The latest close sitting near the high supports continued strength, though the flat volume gives no extra confirmation of a breakout.

2021-12-16.kline: Price rises from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with pullbacks such as the red candles mid-window that do not interrupt the overall climb. The latest close sits near the top of the 20-day range, close to the window high.
2021-12-16.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in the latest days. The tallest bar appears early-to-middle in the window, and recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones.
2021-12-16.combined: Rising price on steady volume points to an orderly uptrend without strong conviction or a clear surge of buying. The lack of a volume expansion on the latest up moves means the trend is intact but not especially confirmed.

2021-12-17.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left area of the window to the right, with a choppy base early on and a steep rally in the middle and later part. Several red pullback candles appear inside the rise, including one near the upper highs, and the window high sits in the right-hand portion. The latest candle is a green day that closes around the middle-to-upper part of the range, well above the window low but below the peak, so the rise is intact.
2021-12-17.volume: Volume expands toward the right: the early bars are modest, while the bars from the middle to the end are taller, with several large red and green bars. The most recent bar is the tallest green bar in the chart, so the latest up day has the heaviest volume, though a couple of large red down days also appear in the late stretch.
2021-12-17.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, with the heaviest volume on the latest up day. The large red volume days during the late pullback suggest selling pressure is present, so the trend is confirmed but not without caution.

2021-12-20.kline: Price rises from a low zone early in the window into a peak near the top of the range, with a tall red candle at the high, then falls back through several red and green candles. The latest green candle closes in the lower-middle part of the range, well below the window high, so the rally has been partly given back in an inverted-V-like shape.
2021-12-20.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bar is a green up-day in the rising phase, and the later red down-days are mostly similar in size to the up-days.
2021-12-20.combined: Flat volume during a rally that gives back a large part of its gain gives weak confirmation of a top, since selling pressure is not clearly heavier than buying. A close in the lower half after a rise on steady volume points to a possible reversal that still needs follow-through.

2021-12-21.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window to a cluster of highs near the middle-right, then pulls back sharply on several red candles before a green recovery over the last few days. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, below the window high but well above the window low, so the rise is not reversed.
2021-12-21.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest green bar comes near the right-center, while the largest red bars cluster in the middle-right, and the most recent days are about the same size as earlier bars.
2021-12-21.combined: The rising price path with a latest close in the upper range is consistent with an uptrend, but flat volume gives no extra conviction that buyers are driving the move. The pullback did not come with a clear volume spike, so the uptrend looks orderly rather than confirmed by strong participation.

2021-12-22.kline: Price rises from the lower-left of the window to a peak near the upper part of the range around the middle-right, then pulls back on several red candles to a mid-range trough, and the last few green candles recover so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, below the window high. The pullback gives back only a modest part of the rise, so the overall shape is a rising trend with a pullback rather than a reversal.
2021-12-22.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop-off, so the flat state holds. A few bars stand out, including a tall green up-day in the later part of the window, while recent bars are of similar size to earlier ones.
2021-12-22.combined: Price is rising with volume at broadly similar levels, so the uptrend has no strong volume confirmation, though the pullback is not accompanied by heavy selling either. The pattern remains an uptrend with a latest close in the upper part of the range.

2021-12-23.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from a low start to a peak spike near the upper-middle of the window, with a sharp pullback of several red candles afterward and a partial recovery over the final bars. The latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, though below the window high, so the pattern is an uptrend with pullbacks inside the rise.
2021-12-23.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window: the tallest green bar appears early in the window and the largest red bars cluster in the middle, while the most recent days are similar in height to earlier bars, matching the flat volume state. Up days and down days carry comparable volume with no clear surge.
2021-12-23.combined: Rising price on flat volume suggests the uptrend has moderate support but no strong buying surge confirming it. The pullback came without a volume spike, so it looks like an orderly correction rather than a reversal.

2021-12-27.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window toward the upper right, with several green up-days and a few pullbacks along the way, including a sharp red spike near the middle that reaches close to the window high. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the top, but does not clearly clear the earlier highs, so this is a rising trend rather than a breakout.
2021-12-27.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur in the middle and earlier part of the window, a large green bar stands out around the middle-right, and the bars over the last several days shrink to the lowest levels in the window. Up days and down days both show smaller volume toward the end.
2021-12-27.combined: Rising prices on falling volume suggest the uptrend is losing momentum, so the latest advance lacks the broad participation that would confirm strength.

2021-12-28.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from a low zone on the left to the upper part of the range on the right, with a sharp peak near the middle-right and a pullback of roughly a third of that rise before the advance resumes. The latest close, a small red candle, sits near the upper part of the window range, below the highest highs but well above the window low.
2021-12-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the early and middle bars, including a tall green spike, are much larger than the bars of the last several sessions, which are visibly shorter. The final red day shows a small uptick compared with the bars just before it, but it remains well below the window's volume peak.
2021-12-28.combined: Price is making higher highs on steadily shrinking volume, so the uptrend is intact but lacks conviction and participation is fading. This divergence is a caution that the rise may stall unless volume picks up again.

2021-12-29.kline: Price rises across most of the window from a low near the left-third, with a sharp peak about two-thirds of the way through and a pullback of several red candles afterward. The latest candles recover to the upper part of the range, near the window high but not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend with a pullback rather than a breakout.
2021-12-29.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early bars and a tall spike mid-window are the heaviest, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter and the last few are the lowest of the window. Volume is not expanding on the up days at the end.
2021-12-29.combined: Price is rising toward the top of the range while volume is shrinking, so the advance lacks strong participation and the uptrend is less convincing. A breakout would need rising volume to confirm.

2021-12-30.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with a sharp drop in the middle that is recovered. The latest closes sit near the top of the window range, so this reads as an uptrend with a pullback inside the rise rather than a breakout.
2021-12-30.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur in the middle and early part of the window, while the most recent bars are clearly lower. Volume is heavier on the red down days in the middle of the window and lighter on the recent up and down days near the top.
2021-12-30.combined: Price is still rising toward the top of the range while volume fades, so the advance lacks conviction and the uptrend could stall without renewed buying volume.

2021-12-31.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with a red candle, then climbs through alternating green and red days with a large swing in the middle. The latest candles cluster near the top of the range, close to the window high, without closing clearly above the earlier highs, so the rise with pullbacks is an uptrend.
2021-12-31.volume: Volume is contracting: a tall green spike appears about two-thirds of the way through the window, and bars fall steadily toward the right, with the most recent days the lowest in the window. Up days and down days both see smaller volume at the end.
2021-12-31.combined: Price is holding high in the range while volume dries up, so the uptrend lacks conviction and a continuation would need volume to pick up again.

2022-01-03.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from a low near the start to a peak about two-thirds of the way through, with a pullback of red candles that bottoms out around the middle-late section before a steady climb of green candles. The latest green candle closes near the window high, so the close sits in the upper part of the range, but it does not clearly clear the earlier peak, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2022-01-03.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars and the spike near the middle are tall, while the bars over the last several days are noticeably shorter, consistent with the stated volume state. The most recent green bar shows a modest rebound in volume, but it does not return to the earlier levels. Up days mostly carry the taller bars, and the red pullback days show lighter volume.
2022-01-03.combined: Rising price on shrinking volume suggests the advance is losing participation and conviction, so the uptrend is intact but less strongly supported. The modest volume rebound on the latest up day is a small positive, but it is not enough to confirm a fresh breakout.
