2022-10-07.combined: Steadily falling prices on flat volume suggest a grinding downtrend without strong selling climax or heavy accumulation. The lack of a volume surge on the recent down days means the decline is not yet showing signs of exhaustion or a reversal.

2022-10-10.kline: The 20-day window falls from near the window high to the lower part of the range, with several small green bounces along the way that do not reverse the decline. The latest close sits near the bottom of the range, close to the window low.
2022-10-10.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early red down-day spike near the start is the largest bar, and the most recent days show smaller bars. Red and green days are mixed, with the recent down days carrying lower volume than the early selloff.
2022-10-10.combined: Falling prices on shrinking volume point to a fading selling push rather than a capitulation or a confirmed reversal. The lack of heavy volume on the latest declines suggests the downtrend is losing momentum, but no bullish reversal is shown yet.

2022-10-11.kline: Price starts with mixed candles, rises to a high in the upper-middle of the window around the early-mid bars, then falls for most of the remaining days with only small bounces. The latest close sits near the lower part of the window range, near the window low.
2022-10-11.volume: Volume contracts: the tallest bars occur early in the window (a large red bar near the start and tall green and red bars in the middle), while the most recent bars are visibly shorter. Recent down days carry less volume than the heavier selling earlier in the window.
2022-10-11.combined: Falling prices on shrinking volume suggest the selling pressure is fading without a capitulation spike, so the downtrend is losing momentum but no reversal or breakout is confirmed yet.

2022-10-12.kline: Across the 20 days price falls from a high near the top of the window, with a few green bounces along the way, to lows near the bottom of the range. The latest candle is red and closes in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so the decline has not reversed.
2022-10-12.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bars come in the early-to-middle part, including a very large red day near the start, while the most recent days show clearly smaller bars. Down days carry most of the heavier volume, and the quieter recent bars are split between red and green.
2022-10-12.combined: The falling price on heavier early volume and the lighter volume on the latest decline suggest selling pressure is fading rather than accelerating, but the downtrend is intact and no reversal is confirmed.

2022-10-13.kline: The window starts with a brief rally to near the window high, then falls in a series of lower highs and lower lows through the middle and right side. The latest candle is a tall green day that bounces off the window low but still closes in the lower part of the range, so the decline dominates.
2022-10-13.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drying up. The tallest bar is the first day, which is red, and the most recent green day is about average, with most other bars at similar heights.
2022-10-13.combined: Steady volume during a falling price path suggests the decline has no strong conviction behind it, but nothing here signals a reversal. The latest green bounce is not yet confirmed by a clear volume increase, so the downtrend remains the better read.

2022-10-14.kline: The window opens with a higher area and then falls in steps, with red candles dominating the middle and late stretch, and a brief green bounce in the middle and another near the end. The window high sits near the first few days, and the latest red close is in the lower half of the range, above the deepest lows near the window bottom, so the decline is intact.
2022-10-14.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear expansion or contraction. A tall green spike appears early-to-middle and several red down days carry moderate-to-high volume, while the most recent bars are similar in size to earlier ones.
2022-10-14.combined: Price is falling on volume that is not expanding, so the decline shows steady selling pressure rather than a capitulation or a clear turn. Volume does not confirm a reversal, so the downtrend reading holds.

2022-10-17.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the window high on the left and stepping down through lower highs and lower lows with a few bounces, including a mid-window rally of several candles. The latest candle is a small green bar sitting in the lower part of the range, well below the window high and near the lower third of the range.
2022-10-17.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear expansion or contraction: the tallest bars occur early and mid-window, and the recent bars are of moderate height and similar to earlier levels. The bars alternate between green and red without a consistent pattern tied to the rise or fall.
2022-10-17.combined: The steady decline on roughly unchanged volume suggests the downtrend lacks strong conviction, with no sign of a selling climax or of heavy buying to signal a reversal. Because the latest close remains in the lower part of the range, the downtrend pattern stands, though a breakdown or reversal would need volume to confirm it.

2022-10-18.kline: Price starts near the top of the 20-day range with a large red candle and falls over most of the window, with a few small green bounces along the way. The window low sits near the bottom of the range, and the latest red candle closes in the lower-middle part of the range, so the decline has not been reversed.
2022-10-18.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in recent days. A few earlier bars are taller, including a tall green bar near the start, while the most recent bars are similar in height to the middle of the window, and up and down days are mixed.
2022-10-18.combined: A steady downtrend on flat volume suggests the decline lacks strong conviction from either buyers or sellers, with no capitulation or volume-backed reversal in the recent bars. The pattern stays a downtrend unless a higher-volume rally or breakdown appears.

2022-10-19.kline: The window opens near the top of the range and falls through a series of mostly red candles to a low near the bottom of the range, with a long green bounce candle at that low. The rebound since then has recovered only about 40% of the decline, and the latest close sits in the lower half of the range, so this is a downtrend with a bounce rather than a reversal.
2022-10-19.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, as the flat state indicates, with one large spike in the early-middle bars and no sustained rise or fall. Volume on the recent up and down days is similar to earlier days, so no volume surge stands out at the end.
2022-10-19.combined: Price is still falling overall while volume stays flat, so there is no volume confirmation of a reversal. The recent bounce on unremarkable volume looks weak and does not yet change the downtrend.

2022-10-20.kline: Price falls from the upper part of the window through a series of lower highs and lower lows, with the first half sliding toward the window low. Mid-window bounces stall well below the early highs, and the latest candles sit in the lower-middle of the range, not near the high.
2022-10-20.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars come early, while the most recent sessions are of similar size to earlier ones, and red and green days alternate without a clear pattern.
2022-10-20.combined: A falling price path with steady, unremarkable volume suggests the selling pressure is persistent but not accelerating, so the downtrend lacks volume confirmation of a new leg down. Watch for a volume expansion on a break below the recent lows to confirm continuation.

2022-10-21.kline: The window starts near the top of the range, falls steadily for about 10 to 12 days into a low near the window bottom, then rebounds in a V-shape over the last several days. The rebound recovers roughly two-thirds of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range but below the early-window highs, so this is a V-shaped reversal bottom rather than a breakout.
2022-10-21.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with the tallest bars early in the decline and near the low, and the most recent bars at about average levels rather than expanding. The big green up day near the low stands out, but the recovery days show no clear volume surge.
2022-10-21.combined: The price recovery is not backed by a clear rise in volume, which is consistent with a flat volume state and leaves the reversal only moderately supported. Confirmation would require rising volume on the up days in the recovery.

2022-10-24.kline: Price fell over several days from the upper left to a low near the middle-right of the window, then rallied for several sessions to finish near the upper part of the range. The rebound recovered most of the decline, and the latest green candle closes in the upper portion of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2022-10-24.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The early bars are tall, a large green spike appears near the low, and the most recent green up days are moderate and similar in size to earlier days.
2022-10-24.combined: The V-shaped recovery on volume that is about even with earlier levels suggests a bottoming attempt, but without a volume surge the reversal is not strongly confirmed.

2022-10-25.kline: After an early high near the top of the window, price fell to a low near the lower part of the range around the middle of the window, then rallied steadily over the last several sessions. The final green candle closes at the window high, clearly above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so this is a breakout from the prior range after a V-shaped drop.
2022-10-25.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early bars are tall, mid-window volume is elevated on several red and green days, and the most recent bars are noticeably shorter than the earlier ones. The last few green up days carry only moderate volume, so volume does not expand into the latest move.
2022-10-25.combined: Rising price to new highs on falling volume is a weak confirmation of the breakout, since the move lacks the volume expansion that usually validates a break above prior resistance. The breakout should be treated as unconfirmed until volume picks up on the up days.

2022-10-26.kline: After a choppy, mostly downward stretch that bottomed around the middle of the window, price rallied strongly over the last several days with tall green candles, lifting above the highs of the earlier part of the window. The latest candle is a small red day, but it closes in the upper part of the range, near the window high.
2022-10-26.volume: Volume stays roughly flat, with no clear surge: the tallest bars sit early in the window and in the middle, while the recent rally days show moderate volume similar to earlier levels. The latest red day has average-sized volume, and up and down days are mixed in height.
2022-10-26.combined: The price has pushed above the prior range, but volume is not expanding on the rally, so the breakout is less convincing than one confirmed by rising volume. The small red latest day after the advance suggests some hesitation near the highs.

2022-10-27.kline: Price fell from the window's low area, then rallied for several sessions with mostly green candles to a peak near the top of the range, followed by a few red candles that pulled back roughly half the rise. The latest red close sits near the middle to lower half of the range, a shape resembling an inverted V.
2022-10-27.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no dominant spike, matching the flat state. The tallest bars are early red days and a green day during the rally, while the most recent red bar is still sizeable, so recent volume does not fade or surge.
2022-10-27.combined: The rally came with steady volume and the pullback has not brought a clear volume surge, so the decline looks more like a measured give-back than a panic sell-off. Confirmation of a top would require the lower close to hold with stronger selling volume.

2022-10-28.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from a low near the bottom of the range around the middle of the window to a final green candle that closes near the window high. A brief red pullback interrupts the climb but the lows keep stepping higher, so this is an uptrend with the latest close in the upper part of the range.
2022-10-28.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. The early green bar and the final green bar are a bit taller than the middle bars, but there is no sustained increase in activity, and up and down days carry comparable volume.
2022-10-28.combined: Price is climbing toward the top of the range while volume stays flat, so the uptrend is steady but lacks strong volume conviction. Confirmation would be stronger if volume rose on the up days.

2022-10-31.kline: After an early dip, price fell to a low near the bottom of the window around two-thirds of the way across, then rallied in a series of higher highs. The last few candles push above the earlier range highs, which sat around the middle-upper part of the window, and the latest close is near the top of the window range. The price path is a V-shaped recovery that ends in an upward break.
2022-10-31.volume: Volume expands in the last several sessions, with the tallest bar near the right edge on a green up day and elevated red and green bars leading into it. Volume in the early part of the window is noticeably lower, and the most recent green day is still above the average of the earlier sessions.
2022-10-31.combined: Rising price on rising volume during the breakout above the earlier range confirms the upward break. The expansion in volume on the up days supports the move as real buying interest rather than a low-volume drift.

2022-11-01.kline: Price fell from the early part of the window to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-left, then climbed steadily with a few small pullbacks to a spike of highs near the right side. The latest candle is a red day that sits in the upper third of the range, just below the window high, so this is a rising path rather than a breakout or reversal.
2022-11-01.volume: Volume expands into the right side of the window: the early bars are modest, while the most recent stretch includes a very tall green day near the end and a large green bar just before it. The final red day trades on moderate volume, lower than the recent green surge.
2022-11-01.combined: Rising prices on expanding, heavier green-day volume support the uptrend, and the latest red day on lighter volume looks like a normal pullback rather than distribution.

2022-11-02.kline: Price fell from a low near the window's middle-left to a peak near the right side, forming a rising run with mostly green candles, then reversed with three to four red candles that gave back more than half the advance. The window high sits near the right-hand peak, and the latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range, making this an inverted-V style top.
2022-11-02.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, with the tallest bar sitting near the late-stage peak and the most recent red bars staying elevated compared with the quieter early bars. The strongest volume comes on the up-move's climax and on the subsequent red sessions, so the selling days are not light.
2022-11-02.combined: Heavy volume on the peak and the following down days suggests distribution, so the reversal from the top looks credible rather than a minor pullback. The latest close in the lower half of the range on expanding volume supports a REVERSAL_TOP reading.

2022-11-03.kline: After a multi-day rise from the lower part of the window to a peak near the window high, price fell over several days, giving back most of the rise. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range, making this an inverted-V style top.
2022-11-03.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. One tall green bar appears near the peak, while the recent red down days show volume similar to earlier bars.
2022-11-03.combined: The price reversal from the high is clear, but flat volume means the sell-off is not backed by a volume surge, so the top is less convincing as a confirmed reversal.

2022-11-04.kline: After a low near the window's left-middle, price rallies over about eight days to a peak near the upper end of the range, then falls over about five days and gives back most of that rise. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the lower end, forming an inverted-V shape.
2022-11-04.volume: Volume stays in a similar band through most of the window, with one tall green bar near the rally peak and a taller red bar on the latest day. Recent volume is not sustained above earlier levels, which matches the flat volume state.
2022-11-04.combined: The rally and reversal happen without a clear volume surge, so the top looks tentative and lacks strong conviction from participants. The fall is confirmed by the latest close in the lower range, but the flat volume means the move is not strongly backed by heavy selling.

2022-11-07.kline: Price rises across most of the window from near the lows to a peak near the top of the range, then falls over the last several sessions and gives back most of the rise. The final candle is a small green bar sitting near the bottom of the range, so the latest close is in the lower half, forming an inverted-V style top.
2022-11-07.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest volume bar sits on a green up day near the peak, while the sell-off days show moderate, similar-sized bars, and the most recent days are not noticeably heavier than earlier ones.
2022-11-07.combined: The rally came with mostly steady volume and the peak was marked by one high-volume up day, which does not show strong conviction. The sell-off that followed did not carry clearly heavier volume, so the top looks like a reversal with moderate confirmation rather than a high-conviction distribution.

2022-11-08.kline: Price climbs steadily from the left side of the window to a sharp peak near the right-hand third, forming an inverted V shape, then falls over the last several days and gives back most of the rise. The latest close sits in the lower part of the 20-day range, near the bottom of the window.
2022-11-08.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days. The tallest bar sits on the rally peak day, and the recent red down days are moderate in size, similar to earlier bars.
2022-11-08.combined: The price fall from the peak is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume. Selling pressure looks steady rather than capitulative, which leaves the top reversal tentative.

2022-11-09.kline: Price climbs from the lower-middle of the window through a series of higher highs to a tall green peak candle near the window high, then falls through several red candles and gives back well over half of the rise. The latest close sits near the bottom of the range, in the lower half, so the shape is an inverted-V style top.
2022-11-09.volume: Volume is flat over the window: the most recent days are about the same as the earlier days, with no sustained surge or drop. The clearest spikes are a tall green bar at the price peak and a tall red bar during the sharp decline, and the final days are of ordinary size.
2022-11-09.combined: The rally to a peak followed by a multi-day decline that retraces most of the gain suggests a top, but flat volume means the selling is not being driven by unusual participation. Confirmation would require heavier volume on the down days or a further drop in price.

2022-11-10.kline: The window starts with a volatile dip, then rises over several green days to a sharp peak near the middle-right of the window, which is the window high. The price then falls over several red days, giving back nearly the whole rise down to the window low, and ends with a small green bounce that leaves the latest close around the middle of the range, slightly below halfway. This is an inverted V shape with a small recovery at the end.
2022-11-10.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drying up in the latest days. The tallest bar sits on the big green up day near the peak, and a few red down days in the decline also show comparable volume, so the chart does not show a clear volume trend.
2022-11-10.combined: The fall from the peak came on volume similar to the rally, so the reversal is not confirmed by a volume surge. The small final bounce on steady volume suggests the decline is losing momentum but has not yet clearly reversed.

2022-11-11.kline: Price rose to a peak near the window's high, then fell for several days into a V-shaped trough in the lower part of the range, with a sharp drop of multi-day red candles. The last few sessions rebounded with green candles, and the latest close sits about two-thirds of the way up the range, recovering roughly 60% of the decline, so the pattern reads as a V-shaped reversal bottom.
2022-11-11.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars occur during a few scattered sessions, and the most recent green up days are at about the same level as the earlier bars rather than clearly larger.
2022-11-11.combined: The price recovery is supported by steady, unremarkable volume rather than a clear expansion, so the bounce looks like a tentative reversal that still needs confirmation from rising volume on follow-through up days.

2022-11-14.kline: Price rallies from the left side of the window to a tall green spike near the middle, then falls over several sessions to a low in the lower-middle of the range, with the lowest lows around the 15th to 16th bars. Over the last three to four sessions it recovers, with the latest red close sitting in the upper half of the range but below the window high. This is a V-shaped fall and partial recovery, not a breakout or breakdown.
2022-11-14.volume: Volume stays fairly steady across the window, consistent with the flat volume state, with no sustained surge or drop. The most notable bar is the tall volume spike on the large green up day near the middle of the window, and the recent bars are of similar size to earlier ones, mixing green and red days without a clear increase.
2022-11-14.combined: The recovery off the lows is not accompanied by a clear rise in volume, so the rebound looks tentative rather than strongly confirmed. The reversal signal is therefore weaker, and the pattern would need follow-through on higher volume to be more convincing.

2022-11-15.kline: After an early rally to a spike high near the window's upper-middle, price fell over about five sessions into a rounded trough of large red candles in the lower-middle of the range, then rebounded over the last four or so sessions. The rebound has recovered roughly 70% of the decline, and the latest candle closes in the upper half of the window range, so this is a V-shaped bottom pattern.
2022-11-15.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bar is a green day near the early peak, and a tall red day appears during the decline, while the recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier ones.
2022-11-15.combined: The rebound is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion, so the recovery lacks strong volume confirmation. The reversal is plausible on price alone, but the flat volume suggests the bounce has not yet attracted decisive buying interest.

2022-11-16.kline: The window shows a V-shaped path: an early rise peaks near the window high, then a multi-day decline drops to the window low in the later-middle part of the window, followed by a multi-day recovery. The recovery retraces roughly 60% of the fall, and the latest red close sits in the upper half of the range, a bit below the earlier peak.
2022-11-16.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drying up. The tallest bar is a green up day in the early-middle part, and the most recent bars are at moderate levels similar to earlier days, with a mix of green and red bars.
2022-11-16.combined: The recovery off the low is not backed by a clear volume expansion, so the bottom reversal is only moderately supported. Confirmation would need higher volume on the up days of the rebound.

2022-11-17.kline: Price rises from mid-range to a peak near the window high, then falls for several days to a low near the window bottom, and then recovers through several green days. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, roughly two-thirds of the way up, having regained about half or more of the decline; the shape resembles a V bottom.
2022-11-17.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall. The tallest bar is an early green up day, and a few red down-day bars are also high, so spikes occur on both up and down days without a clear trend.
2022-11-17.combined: The rebound off the lows is not backed by a rising volume trend, so the V-shaped recovery is only partly confirmed. Volume is not expanding on the recent green days, which tempers confidence in the bottom reversal.

2022-11-18.kline: Price rallied to a peak in the early-middle part of the window, then fell sharply over several red candles to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-late window. It then recovered in a sharp rise of several green candles, recovering roughly two-thirds of the decline, so the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2022-11-18.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained rise in the most recent days compared with earlier. The chart shows a large green spike early in the window and a tall red spike during the decline, while recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier ones, and up and down days are mixed.
2022-11-18.combined: The recovery off the low is not confirmed by a volume surge, so the reversal signal is weaker than it would be with heavier buying on the up days. Price and volume together suggest a tentative V-shaped bottom that needs follow-through on rising volume to be trusted.

2022-11-21.kline: The window starts near the upper part of the range, then falls in a steep run of red candles to a low about two-thirds of the way down the window, forming a V-shaped bottom. A rally of several green candles then recovers roughly 60-70% of that decline, and the latest candles pull back slightly, leaving the final close in the upper-middle part of the range.
2022-11-21.volume: Volume is contracting: the early window has tall green and red bars, with the largest spike on a red down day near the middle of the window, while the bars on the right are shorter and mostly red. The volume chart shows the rally days carrying less volume than the selloff, and the most recent bars are the smallest in the window.
2022-11-21.combined: The rally on fading volume and the small pullback on lighter volume suggest the reversal lacks conviction, so the V-shaped recovery is not strongly confirmed. Falling volume during the bounce points to weak buying interest and a possible stall.

2022-11-22.kline: Early in the window price swings up and down near the upper part of the range, then falls over about eight sessions to a low near the bottom of the chart, with the lowest closes in the middle-lower section. A rally of several green days then recovers most of that decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, a V-shaped bottom.
2022-11-22.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bar is a green spike early on, and bars trend lower toward the right. The most recent sessions, including the latest green day, show the smallest volume bars of the window.
2022-11-22.combined: The rebound off the lows is occurring on shrinking volume, which weakens confirmation of the V-shaped reversal. Price is recovering, but the falling volume suggests buying interest is fading and the bottom needs follow-through on stronger volume to be confirmed.

2022-11-23.kline: Price opens the window near the upper part of the range after an early green rally, then falls over several days into a low cluster around the middle-to-lower part of the window, with a long red wick reaching the window low. It then rebounds over several days with small green and red candles, recovering roughly 70% of the decline, so the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, a V-shaped bottom.
2022-11-23.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars are tall, with the highest volume near the start and in the middle selloff, while the recent bars shrink steadily to the lowest levels at the right edge. The rebound days, including the latest green candles, trade on noticeably lighter volume than the earlier decline.
2022-11-23.combined: The price recovery from the low is not supported by volume, since the rebound happens on shrinking participation, which makes the reversal less convincing. The pattern still fits a bottom reversal on price, but confirmation would need volume to expand on the up days.

2022-11-25.kline: Price fell over several days from near the window's high to a low about three-quarters of the way down the chart, forming a V-shaped bottom. A multi-day rally of green candles then recovered most of that decline, and the last few sessions moved sideways near the upper part of the range, with the latest small red candle closing in the upper half.
2022-11-25.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars are at the start of the window, and the bars trend lower toward the most recent day. The largest green bars occur on rally days in the middle of the window, while the recent red and green bars are noticeably shorter.
2022-11-25.combined: The rally was supported by heavier green-day volume, but volume has faded as price stalled near the highs, so the reversal lacks strong follow-through. The pattern suggests a recovery that is losing momentum rather than a confirmed new uptrend.

2022-11-28.kline: After an early decline to lows near the bottom of the window, price rallied in a run of green candles to the upper part of the range, then rolled over into several red days. The shape is a V-like rebound followed by a fade, and the latest red close sits in the lower half of the range, roughly halfway down from the window high.
2022-11-28.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early red sessions and the big green spike mid-window carry the heaviest bars, while the last several sessions show clearly smaller bars, with only the final red day picking up a little. Heavier volume appears on several of the rally's green days, and the decline days trade on lighter volume.
2022-11-28.combined: The rally came on sizable volume, but the fall since then is occurring on shrinking volume, which suggests the advance is losing momentum and the pullback lacks strong selling conviction. Price has given back a large part of the rally, so the top pattern is plausible, though it is not yet confirmed by heavy volume on the downside.

2022-11-29.kline: After a high near the top of the window at the left, price fell to lows in the lower-middle of the range, rallied on a run of green candles to a mid-window peak that stayed below the early high (lower highs), and then fell again. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the window low area.
2022-11-29.volume: Volume is contracting: the early window has the largest spike, with mostly red bars and a few green bars in the middle. The most recent bars are clearly shorter than earlier ones, with a modest uptick on the final day.
2022-11-29.combined: Falling prices on shrinking volume suggest the selling pressure is fading, but there is no volume-confirmed reversal, so the downtrend bias remains unchanged.

2022-11-30.kline: Price falls from a high near the start of the window into a low about a third of the way through, then rebounds through a series of green candles. The rebound recovers most of the decline, and the latest green close sits in the upper half of the window range, roughly two-thirds of the way up, which makes this a V-shaped bottom.
2022-11-30.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no clear surge or drop in the recent days. The tallest bar falls on an early red down day, and the most recent bars are moderate, not clearly larger than earlier ones, while the up days do not dominate volume.
2022-11-30.combined: The price rebound from the low is not backed by a volume increase, so the reversal signal is weaker than a V-shape on expanding volume would suggest. The recovery still needs confirmation from rising volume on follow-through up days.

2022-12-01.kline: Price fell from the middle of the range to near the window low over the first five candles, then rallied strongly to near the window high by about the twelfth candle. 2023-01-30.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right across the 20 days, with small pullbacks along the way such as the red candles in the middle. The latest red candle sits near the top of the window range, just below the recent highs, so the close remains in the upper part of the range.
2023-01-30.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars appear early on, including a large red day near the left, while the recent bars are of similar height and alternate between green and red.
2023-01-30.combined: The steady higher highs and higher lows on roughly flat volume suggest a orderly uptrend without strong conviction behind the latest move. The latest red day on moderate volume is a small pullback rather than a reversal signal.

2023-01-31.kline: Price climbs steadily across the 20-day window, with a few small red pullbacks (such as the red candles near the middle and the two red candles just before the last bar) that do not break the rising pattern. The window low is at the far left and the high is near the right edge, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, close to the window high.
2023-01-31.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the early red bars on the left are tall, but the mid-to-late bars are similar in height, with no clear surge or drop in the most recent days. Up days (green) and down days (red) are mixed in height without a dominant pattern, so volume does not clearly expand or contract.
2023-01-31.combined: Price is rising with the latest close in the upper range, but volume is not expanding to support the move, so the uptrend is intact without strong volume confirmation.

2023-02-01.kline: Price climbs steadily across the 20-day window, from lows near the bottom-left to highs near the top-right, with a few small red pullbacks along the way. The latest green candle closes near the window high, in the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact.
2023-02-01.volume: Volume is flat, as the stated state indicates: the recent bars are about the same height as the earlier ones, with no clear surge or drop. The tallest early bars are red down days, while the latest bars are a mix of green and red at moderate heights.
2023-02-01.combined: A steady rise on steady volume suggests a healthy but unremarkable uptrend without strong conviction from buyers or sellers. Volume does not confirm a breakout, so the uptrend reading rests on price structure alone.

2023-02-02.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left to the upper right of the 20-day window, with small pullbacks along the way such as the red candles near the middle and the red day just before the last few candles. The latest green candle closes near the window high, in the upper part of the range.
2023-02-02.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop, and bars alternate between green and red days. The final bar is the tallest in the chart, but the recent days are not clearly higher than earlier ones.
2023-02-02.combined: Steadily rising prices on roughly even volume suggest a healthy uptrend without strong conviction behind the latest move. The tall final volume bar on the green day is worth watching for confirmation of the trend.

2023-02-03.kline: Price climbs in a steady staircase of green and red candles from the lower left, then the last two sessions jump sharply, with the rightmost green candle closing at the very top of the window range and above the highs of the earlier part of the window, leaving the prior range upward.
2023-02-03.volume: Volume is modest and fairly flat through most of the window, then rises over the last few sessions, with the final bar towering far above all others as a clear volume spike on an up day.
2023-02-03.combined: The sharp rise to new window highs on a large volume spike, all on green up days, strongly confirms the upside breakout.

2023-02-06.kline: Price climbs in a staircase from the lower left to the upper right, with a series of higher highs and higher lows. The final two sessions jump sharply to a new window high near the top of the chart, leaving the earlier range above its prior highs. The latest candle is a small red body that closes just below that high but still in the upper part of the range.
2023-02-06.volume: Volume is quiet and mixed through the middle of the window, then builds steadily into the last few sessions. The biggest bar sits in the last three days and towers over the window's normal level, and most of the late surge comes on green up days. The final red day trades on a noticeably lower bar than the spike.
2023-02-06.combined: Rising prices on sharply rising volume confirm the breakout above the prior range. The small red final session on lower volume is a mild caution, but it does not yet undermine the breakout.

2023-02-07.kline: Price climbs steadily across the 20-day window from near the bottom-left to the top-right, with small red pullbacks along the way. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, close to the window high, and the sharpest rally comes in the final several days.
2023-02-07.volume: Volume is mostly moderate through the early and middle part of the window, then rises sharply in the last few days, with the tallest bar about two sessions before the end and a still-elevated green bar on the latest day. The red down days in the recent stretch carry lower volume than the up days.
2023-02-07.combined: Rising prices on a volume spike suggest strong buying interest behind the advance, which supports the uptrend. The close is near the window high but does not clearly clear the prior range, so it is not yet a confirmed breakout.

2023-02-08.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, from low candles on the left to a series of higher highs and higher lows, with a few small red pullbacks along the way. The highest high sits at the right side near the window peak, and the latest close is a red candle in the upper part of the range, just below the recent high, so the pattern is an uptrend.
2023-02-08.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, while the final stretch shows the tallest green bars in the chart, including a very large spike about two-thirds of the way across. Several recent up days carry much higher volume than the early bars, and the latest red day is still above the early-window average.
2023-02-08.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, since buyers are increasingly active on the advances. The latest red day on somewhat lower volume than the peak suggests a mild pause rather than a reversal.

2023-02-09.kline: Price climbs from the low on the left to the high on the right, with a series of higher highs and higher lows and a tall spike near the window high in the later part of the window. The last few candles are red and pull back slightly from that spike, but the latest close still sits in the upper part of the range, so this is an uptrend with a small pullback.
2023-02-09.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no single day standing out sharply. Several green up-days carry moderate to tall bars, and the most recent days show red bars of similar height to earlier ones, which matches the flat volume state.
2023-02-09.combined: Price is rising while volume holds steady rather than expanding, so the advance is orderly but not showing strong new buying interest. The recent red days on similar volume suggest a mild pause in the uptrend rather than a reversal.

2023-02-10.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window with a few red pullback candles along the way, then makes a sharp rally in the second half to the window high near the top of the range. The latest candle is a green bar that sits in the upper part of the range, below the peak, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout or reversal.
2023-02-10.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, consistent with the flat state, with moderate green and red bars through the early and middle days. The one standout is a very tall green bar on the sharp rally day, and the most recent bars are close to the earlier average level without any expansion.
2023-02-10.combined: Rising price with volume that is not expanding in the latest days suggests the uptrend is intact but has no fresh volume push behind it. The big volume spike on the rally day shows strong buying interest at that point, so the trend is supported but not newly confirmed by the latest bars.

2023-02-13.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from low candles on the left to a sharp rally that peaks near the window high in the right-middle section. The last few sessions move sideways near the upper part of the range with a few red down days, and the latest green close sits in the upper half, below the window high.
2023-02-13.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bar appears in the middle-to-late section on a green up day, and the most recent bars are moderate and mixed between green and red, with a few red down days not clearly lighter than the green ones.
2023-02-13.combined: Rising price on flat volume shows the uptrend is intact but lacks strong volume confirmation, so the move looks steady rather than urgent. The lack of a volume surge on the recent up days suggests buyers are not showing a clear new wave of conviction.

2023-02-14.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting from the lower part of the range with a series of higher highs and higher lows. The steepest advance comes in the middle-to-late stretch, with a tall green candle pushing to the window high. The latest several candles churn in the upper part of the range, and the most recent close sits near the upper portion, not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is not a breakout.
2023-02-14.volume: Volume contracts over the recent days: the largest spike occurs during the sharp advance, while the last several bars are clearly lower and fairly flat. Recent down days show red bars of moderate volume, and the latest up days are lighter than the earlier green surge.
2023-02-14.combined: Rising price with shrinking volume in the latest days suggests the uptrend is intact but losing momentum, so the recent upper-range trading lacks strong conviction. Confirmation of further upside would need volume to pick up again.

2023-02-15.kline: Price climbs steadily from the low at the left edge of the window to the highs at the right, with a sharp gap-up and a tall green candle around the middle-right. The last several sessions move sideways near the upper part of the range, and the latest green close sits in the upper part of the range just below the window high, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-02-15.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with a large spike on the tall green day in the middle-right and a few red days after it that trade at moderate levels. The most recent bars are similar to earlier volume rather than clearly higher or lower, and up days are mostly green while down days are red.
2023-02-15.combined: Rising price with volume that stays near its earlier level suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong new buying conviction, and nothing in the volume confirms a breakout above the prior highs.

2023-02-16.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting near the bottom with a series of higher highs and higher lows, interrupted by small red pullbacks and a sharp jump in the middle of the window. The window high is at the right edge, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, so this is an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2023-02-16.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained surge or drop in recent days. The chart shows one very large spike around the middle of the window, which lines up with the sharpest price jump, while the most recent bars are moderate and similar to the early-window levels. Down days (red bars) show modest volume and do not stand out as heavy selling.
2023-02-16.combined: Rising price with volume that is not expanding suggests the uptrend is steady but not strongly confirmed by participation, with the mid-window spike marking the main burst of buying. The lack of a volume surge on the latest advance means the trend is intact but would need increasing volume to add conviction.

2023-02-17.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from lower-left candles to higher-right candles, with several down days along the way. The sharpest advance comes in the middle, where a large green candle pushes near the window high, followed by choppy trading near the top. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range but below the earlier window high, so it is a pullback-tolerant uptrend, not a breakout.
2023-02-17.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with no sustained surge in the recent days compared with earlier in the window. The main spike occurs mid-window, around the big advance, and recent bars sit at similar levels to the early bars, with a mix of green and red volume bars.
2023-02-17.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume show a persistent uptrend without strong conviction from a volume surge. The lack of expanding volume on the latest up days suggests the trend is intact but not yet confirmed by fresh buying pressure.

2023-02-21.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting from lower levels on the left, with a sharp rally in the middle that pushes up to the window high and a few small red pullbacks along the way. The latest candle is a red day that closes near the midpoint of the range, just above it, so the uptrend is intact but weakening at the end.
2023-02-21.volume: Volume is flat, with recent days at about the same level as earlier in the window. The one standout is a large green spike during the mid-window rally, while the remaining bars, including the latest red day, stay at moderate, similar heights.
2023-02-21.combined: The rally was driven by a heavy-volume surge, but the flat volume since then means there is no strong new buying or selling conviction behind the latest red pullback. The uptrend remains the reading, though the latest close near the midpoint is a caution that momentum has faded.

2023-02-22.kline: Price starts low in the window, rallies sharply in the middle to a spike high near the top of the range, then trades sideways in the upper-middle area with mixed red and green candles. The latest candles drift down to sit roughly in the middle-to-lower part of the range, without a clear fall that gives back half the rally, so the action reads as a sideways range after the jump rather than a clear reversal.
2023-02-22.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: one large spike occurs in the middle-to-early rally day, with other sessions at moderate, similar levels. The most recent days show no sustained surge or drop-off, and the final bar is somewhat lower, consistent with the flat volume state.
2023-02-22.combined: The sharp rally came on heavy volume, but later price action has not followed through with expanding volume, so the recent sideways trading on steady volume suggests consolidation rather than a confirmed trend or breakout.

2023-02-23.kline: Price rises from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the upper range in the middle-to-late days, then pulls back and oscillates without a sustained direction. The latest candles sit around the middle of the range, well below the window high, so the move looks sideways rather than a clean trend or reversal.
2023-02-23.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest bar comes around the middle of the window on an up day, with the tallest spike well above the others, and the most recent sessions show clearly smaller bars, with several down days showing modest volume.
2023-02-23.combined: Sideways price action on shrinking volume suggests indecision and a lack of conviction from either buyers or sellers. A breakout or breakdown would need a renewed rise in volume to be confirmed.

2023-02-24.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left area through a sharp rally to the window high near the middle-right, forming an inverted V shape over several days, then falls for several days on mostly red candles. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, well below the peak and roughly giving back most of the rally.
2023-02-24.volume: Volume is contracting: a large spike occurs on the strongest up day near the peak, but volume then declines steadily and the most recent bars are the lowest in the window. Down days through the decline are only modestly active, and the latest red bars carry noticeably less volume than the earlier spike.
2023-02-24.combined: The rally on heavy volume followed by a sell-off on fading volume suggests the upside momentum has faded and the reversal from the top lacks strong selling conviction. Shrinking volume on the decline indicates the pullback may be losing steam rather than accelerating, so the top pattern is not yet confirmed by volume.

2023-02-27.kline: Price rises from the lower left of the window to a peak near the top of the range in the middle of the window, then falls over the last several days. The decline gives back most of the rise, and the latest green candle closes in the lower half of the range, so the shape is an inverted V reversal top.
2023-02-27.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur in the early-to-middle part of the window during the rally, while the most recent days show much smaller bars. The recent red down days are lighter than the spike volume on the advance, and the latest bars sit at a low level.
2023-02-27.combined: The price reversal from the top comes on falling volume, so the selling pressure looks weaker than the buying that drove the rally. This suggests the top is not yet confirmed by heavy distribution, so the reversal signal is less convincing.

2023-02-28.kline: Price rose sharply from the lower-left area to a peak near the top of the window around the fourth to fifth candles, then gave back most of that rise over the following days with a mix of red and green bodies. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, roughly a third of the way up from the window low, forming a rough inverted-V shape.
2023-02-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest spike occurs early in the window, around the rally peak, and bars decline steadily toward the right, with the most recent days clearly lower than the earlier bars. Red and green bars are mixed in the recent days, with no volume surge on the down days.
2023-02-28.combined: The price fade after the peak is occurring on shrinking volume, so the selling lacks strong conviction, but the latest close in the lower half of the range still supports a top formation. Confirmation would require a further close below the recent pivot lows on rising volume.

2023-03-01.kline: Price climbs from a low near the left side of the window to a high plateau in the upper part of the range, then falls over roughly eight to ten days, giving back more than half of the rise. The latest close sits near the bottom of the range after a series of lower highs and lower lows, so the shape is an inverted-V style top.
2023-03-01.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars come early in the window, around the initial rally, while the most recent days show clearly shorter bars. The recent red down days carry only moderate volume, and the latest green bar is also modest.
2023-03-01.combined: The rally came on heavy volume, but the decline has happened on lighter volume, so the sell-off lacks strong conviction. Together this supports a reversal top that is still unconfirmed by volume on the downside.

2023-03-02.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, from the upper-left area down to the lower-right, with a sequence of mostly red candles and lower highs in the second half. The latest candle is a green bounce that closes near the bottom of the window range, so the close stays in the lower part of the range and the bounce does not change the downtrend.
2023-03-02.volume: Volume contracts across the window: the two tallest green bars sit at the far left, and volume falls steadily to lower levels on the right. The most recent bars, both red and green, are the smallest in the chart, so the final days trade on clearly lighter volume than earlier in the window.
2023-03-02.combined: Price is falling on shrinking volume, which suggests selling pressure is fading but has not reversed, since the latest close remains in the lower range. The small green bounce on light volume is not strong enough to confirm a reversal, so the downtrend stays intact unless volume and price expand upward.

2023-03-03.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range on the left to a low near the bottom around the 18th-19th bars, with several red candles in the decline and only brief bounces. The final candle is a sharp green bounce that recovers to roughly the middle of the range, below the window high, so the latest close sits in the middle-to-lower part of the range rather than the upper part.
2023-03-03.volume: Volume is flat: the tallest bar is the oldest day at the left edge, and the rest of the bars sit in a fairly narrow band at moderate levels with no sustained surge or fade. Red and green volume bars are mixed through the decline, and the final green up day is about average in size, not a standout.
2023-03-03.combined: The downtrend persists on flat volume, so there is no clear sign of selling exhaustion or conviction behind the late bounce. The final up day on average volume is too weak to confirm a reversal, so the decline remains the dominant read.

2023-03-06.kline: Price fell steadily from the upper part of the window toward the window low near the right-center, then turned up over the last three or four sessions in a V-shaped recovery. The latest green candle closes near the top of the 20-day range, recovering most of the decline, so the latest close sits in the upper half.
2023-03-06.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay at roughly similar heights across the window, with no clear surge on the recent rally days. Green up-days and red down-days are mixed through the middle, and the final rising days are not much heavier than earlier days.
2023-03-06.combined: The V-shaped recovery on steady, unremarkable volume suggests a bottom has formed, but the rebound lacks the volume expansion that would confirm it. The pattern is tentative until the rise is backed by heavier buying volume.

2023-03-07.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, falls over several days into a low near the bottom of the range, then rallies sharply over the last few sessions, forming a V-shaped bottom. The latest red candle closes in the upper half of the range, having recovered most of the earlier decline.
2023-03-07.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with bars of similar size across the window and no dominant spike at the end. The most recent bars are somewhat higher, but not by enough to mark a clear surge, and up and down days show mixed volume levels.
2023-03-07.combined: The sharp rebound from the low is a bottom-reversal signal, but because volume does not clearly expand on the recovery days, the move is less convincing and needs confirmation from rising volume.

2023-03-08.kline: Price falls across most of the window from an upper start to a low near the bottom of the range around the 17th-18th bars, then rebounds sharply over the last few bars, including a long green candle and a gap up to a spike near the window high. The latest small green candle closes in the upper half of the range, about three-quarters of the way up, so the rebound recovers most of the earlier decline; the rise is short, though, so the shape resembles a V.
2023-03-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge; the bars stay at similar heights, with a few taller bars on the late green rebound days and a red day near the end.
2023-03-08.combined: The price recovery into the upper half of the range is not clearly supported by rising volume, since the volume stays about even while price rebounds, so the reversal signal is tentative and needs confirmation from higher volume on the up days.

2023-03-09.kline: The window falls from the upper area through a series of red candles into a low near the window's lower-middle, then a sharp multi-candle rally carries price back to the window high near the top, with a tall green candle at the end of the rise. Subsequent pullbacks leave the latest red close around the middle of the range, so the V-shaped recovery is only partly confirmed.
2023-03-09.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no sustained surge or fade, matching the flat state. The one standout is a tall green bar during the rally, while the most recent red days show moderate volume similar to earlier bars.
2023-03-09.combined: The sharp rally on a volume spike supports the recovery from the low, but the flat volume and the latest close near mid-range leave the reversal unconfirmed.

2023-03-10.kline: Price rises for about the first six days to a high near the top of the window, then falls through most of the remaining days to a low near the window's bottom (around day 15) below the starting level. A partial bounce brings it back to the middle of the range, and the latest candle is a red close in the lower-middle part of the range, so the fall dominates the window.
2023-03-10.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained build-up or drop-off. Scattered spikes stand out, including a tall green bar in the middle-late window and a tall red bar on a red down day near the end, while most other bars sit at similar levels.
2023-03-10.combined: Falling prices on volume that is not clearly expanding give little confirmation of a new leg down. The late tall red bar suggests selling pressure on the latest decline, but flat volume overall leaves the downtrend tentative.

2023-03-13.kline: Price fell from the early highs through the middle of the window into a V-shaped low near the bottom, then rallied over the last several sessions. The latest green close sits around the middle of the window range, so it has recovered roughly half of the decline but has not clearly reached the upper half.
2023-03-13.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the 20 days, with no sustained surge or drop-off compared with earlier sessions. A few taller green bars appear during the rally, and some red down days show moderate volume.
2023-03-13.combined: The rally off the low is supported by several up days with at-or-above-average volume, which backs the reversal. Because volume is flat and the latest close is only near the midpoint, the bottom reversal is tentative and needs further strength to confirm.

2023-03-14.kline: Price fell from near the window high on the left to a trough around the lower-middle of the range, then rallied in several up days, forming a V-shaped bottom. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, having recovered roughly two-thirds of the decline, though it remains below the early highs.
2023-03-14.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, with no sustained rise or fall in activity. A few bars stand out as taller, including some green up days in the later rally and one red day near the end, but the overall level stays similar to the earlier days.
2023-03-14.combined: The rally off the low came with up days that were not clearly heavier than the decline, so volume does not strongly confirm the reversal. The V-shaped recovery in price is intact, but it would need stronger volume on up days to carry more conviction.

2023-03-15.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, falls over roughly the first 10-12 candles into a trough near the bottom of the range, then rises over the last several candles. The recovery reaches the upper part of the range, so the latest close sits in the upper half, forming a V-shaped double-bottom-like reversal.
2023-03-15.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop. A few taller green bars appear mid-window and near the right side, but the most recent days are about the same as earlier days.
2023-03-15.combined: The price recovery from the low is not backed by a volume increase, so the reversal looks less convincing. Flat volume suggests the rebound has not yet attracted strong new participation.

2023-03-16.kline: Price fell in a steady slide from the upper left to a low near the lower middle of the window, then rallied for several days to finish near the window high, forming a V-shaped bottom. The rebound recovered most of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2023-03-16.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early and middle sessions are moderate, while the recent rally days carry the tallest bars, including a spike around the middle-right. Most of the late-window up days are green and high, so volume rises with the advance.
2023-03-16.combined: The V-shaped recovery is supported by rising volume on the up days, which suggests buyers are gaining conviction as price climbs back toward the window high. The pattern is a reversal from the fall, not yet a confirmed breakout above the prior highs.

2023-03-17.kline: Price falls from the left side into a low about two-thirds of the way across the window, then rallies in a series of mostly green candles toward the window high. The latest candle is a red day that closes in the upper part of the range, near the top of the window.
2023-03-17.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, the largest green-day volume comes mid-window during the rally, and the most recent days are noticeably heavier. The final bar is the tallest in the chart and is red, so the latest session has heavy volume on a down day.
2023-03-17.combined: The rally on rising volume supports the uptrend, but the heavy-volume red candle on the latest day near the highs suggests some selling pressure, so the trend is intact but showing early signs of potential exhaustion.

2023-03-20.kline: Price fell from the upper-middle of the window to a low about two-thirds of the way through, then rallied in a series of mostly green candles. The last several days push above the highs of the mid-window range, and the latest close sits near the top of the 20-day range, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2023-03-20.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window, with the most recent days clearly higher than the early part. Several tall green bars appear on the rally days, while a few red days show elevated volume too, though the latest bar is only moderate.
2023-03-20.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume, with heavier buying on the up days, support the breakout above the earlier range. The move is not yet fully confirmed by one unusually large final-day volume bar, so follow-through would strengthen the signal.

2023-03-21.kline: After a dip in the middle of the window, price rallied strongly, with the last few green candles closing above the highs of the earlier part of the window and reaching the top of the range, so the latest close sits near the window high.
2023-03-21.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the earlier bars are mostly moderate, while the largest spike is a tall red bar a few days before the last day, and the final green bars show only moderate-to-high volume.
2023-03-21.combined: Price breaking above the prior range with volume expanding overall supports the breakout, but the biggest volume surge came on a down day, so the confirmation is mixed rather than clean.

2023-03-22.kline: Price fell from the upper-middle of the range to a low near the bottom of the window around the early-middle bars, then rose steadily over the later bars to a high at the window's top on the most recent day. The latest candle is red with a long upper wick reaching the window high, so its close sits in the upper part of the range, consistent with an uptrend.
2023-03-22.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no sustained surge or fade, so the flat state holds. A few bars stand out, such as a tall red bar near the right side, while the most recent bar is red but not the largest. Green up days are not clearly heavier than red down days.
2023-03-22.combined: Rising prices on roughly flat volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong volume confirmation. The latest red day with a long upper wick and no volume spike hints at hesitation near the highs rather than a decisive push higher.

2023-03-23.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right, with a few pullbacks along the way, and the rightmost candles sit near the top of the window range. The latest close is in the upper part of the range, close to the window high, so the pattern is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
