2023-09-12.kline: Price rose from a low near the window bottom around the middle of the window to a peak at the top of the range, then fell sharply over the last few days in a rough inverted-V shape. The latest red close sits in the lower half of the range, having given back most of the prior rally.
2023-09-12.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, consistent with the expanding-volume state. The tallest bar is a green day near the peak, and the largest recent bars are red down days on the decline, so volume is clearly heavier as the price falls.
2023-09-12.combined: The rally on rising green volume was followed by heavier red volume on the sell-off, so the decline has conviction behind it. Together this supports a top with downside follow-through rather than a minor pullback.

2023-09-13.kline: Price starts near the lower-middle of the range, dips briefly, then climbs over roughly ten days with several large green bodies to a peak near the top of the window, forming a rounded inverted-V top. A large red candle then drops sharply from the peak, and the last several days stay in the lower part of the range, so the latest close sits near the bottom third and the decline has given back most of the rally.
2023-09-13.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate and mostly similar in size, while the largest green bar appears during the rally and the heaviest red bars cluster in the most recent days, with the last few sessions well above the early-window average.
2023-09-13.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp red decline after the peak, and on recent down days, suggests selling pressure is strengthening and supports the reversal from the top.

2023-09-14.kline: Price rose from a low near the left side of the window to a peak near the window high around the 14th to 15th bars, then fell over several sessions and gave back most of that rise. It forms an inverted V with the latest close in the lower half of the range.
2023-09-14.volume: Volume stayed roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall in activity. One tall green bar near the peak stands out, while several red down-day bars near the end are fairly large, but overall volume does not clearly expand.
2023-09-14.combined: The price reversal from the peak is not strongly confirmed by volume, since selling days did not show a clear surge in activity. The top pattern remains valid on price alone, but the lack of volume expansion makes it less convincing.

2023-09-15.kline: Price climbed for about ten candles from the lower-left area, with a strong green rally, to a peak near the upper part of the window, then fell over about six candles with large red bodies, giving back most of the rise. This forms an inverted-V shape, and the latest red candles close in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2023-09-15.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the early bars are moderate, a tall green spike appears near the peak, and the most recent red down-days are clearly higher than the early bars, with the rightmost bar the tallest.
2023-09-15.combined: Heavy volume on the decline below the peak, concentrated on red down-days, confirms the reversal top and suggests sellers are in control after the rally.

2023-09-18.kline: Price climbed from the lower left through a series of green candles to a peak near the upper part of the window, then fell sharply in a few red candles and kept sliding into the lower third, forming an inverted-V shape. The fall gave back more than the rise, and the latest green candle sits in the lower half of the range, well below the window high.
2023-09-18.volume: Volume was moderate during the rise and then expanded: a very large green-day spike appeared near the peak, followed by heavier red-day volume during the decline, with the most recent days still showing elevated volume.
2023-09-18.combined: Rising volume on the sell-off days alongside the drop from the peak suggests distribution and confirms the reversal top, while the final green candle on lower volume hints only at a weak bounce.

2023-09-19.kline: Price climbed over the first part of the window to a peak near the top of the range, then fell sharply through a large red candle and several red days to lows near the bottom, giving back most of the rise. The latest green candle sits in the lower half of the range, about two-thirds of the way down from the window high, which makes this an inverted-V style reversal top.
2023-09-19.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in recent sessions. The tallest bars are a green spike near the peak and a red spike during the sharp decline, and the most recent bars are moderate, in line with earlier levels.
2023-09-19.combined: The price reversal from the peak is not clearly confirmed by volume, since the selling days do not show a dramatic increase over the earlier days. The pattern is still valid on price alone, but the lack of a volume surge on the decline leaves the reversal less convincing.

2023-09-20.kline: Price rallies over the first half of the window to a peak near the top of the range, forming an inverted V with several up days, then drops sharply on a large red candle and falls further. It gives back more than half of the rise and settles into a lower, sideways base. The window high is near the peak, the window low is near the bottom of the lower base, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range.
2023-09-20.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained surge or drying up in the most recent days compared with earlier. The tallest volume bars come mid-window on the red selling days during the drop, while the green up-day bars earlier were lower and the final few bars are moderate and mixed in color, similar to the earlier baseline.
2023-09-20.combined: The heavy volume on the red decline days supports the reversal from the peak, but the flat volume recently suggests the selling is not accelerating and the lower base may be stabilizing rather than confirming a fresh breakdown.

2023-09-21.kline: Price rallied for about eight days from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high, then reversed with a large red candle and fell over the following days to a latest close near the bottom of the range, giving back nearly all of the rise. The shape is roughly an inverted V, with the most recent candle sitting in the lower part of the range.
2023-09-21.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no clear expansion or fade. The tallest bar is a green day during the rally, while several red down days in the decline carry comparable, sizable volume, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier ones.
2023-09-21.combined: The falling prices are not accompanied by a clear volume surge, so the reversal is only weakly confirmed by volume. Selling pressure is steady rather than capitulating, so the top is plausible but not strongly validated.

2023-09-22.kline: Price rallies over roughly the first nine sessions to a peak near the top of the window range, then falls over the following days, giving back most of the rise. The shape is an inverted V with a rounded top, and the latest close sits near the bottom of the range, close to the window low.
2023-09-22.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction. A large green bar stands out near the rally peak, and several large red bars appear during the decline, but the most recent sessions are about as active as earlier ones.
2023-09-22.combined: The price path points to a top, but flat volume gives weak confirmation: the selloff is not clearly accompanied by a volume surge. Rising volume on the down days would have strengthened the reversal signal.

2023-09-25.kline: Price rises over about six sessions to a peak near the top of the window, then a sharp decline over the next dozen sessions gives back well over half of the rise. The latest green candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the window low, forming an inverted-V shape.
2023-09-25.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained surge in the most recent days compared with earlier in the window. The tallest green bar comes on the up-day near the peak, a tall red bar appears during the decline, and the final sessions show moderate, mixed volume.
2023-09-25.combined: Heavy volume on the peak up-day followed by a decline that has not shown a volume climax or clear capitulation suggests the rally has rolled over. Flat volume through the sell-off gives only modest support to the reversal, so the top pattern is plausible but not strongly confirmed.

2023-09-26.kline: After a short rally from the lower-left area to the window high in the first few sessions, price falls across most of the window with only small bounces, and the latest red candle closes near the window low, in the lower part of the range.
2023-09-26.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off; a tall green bar appears early near the peak, a few tall red bars sit mid-window, and the most recent bars are close to the window average.
2023-09-26.combined: The steady decline on fairly even volume shows selling pressure without clear capitulation or a volume-driven reversal, so the downtrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by volume.

2023-09-27.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range with a steep drop to the window low around the early-middle bars, then a few partial rebounds that fail to recover much ground. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so this is a downtrend with bounces inside the fall.
2023-09-27.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no clear build-up or fade into the latest days. The tallest bars come from a mix of up and down days in the middle of the window, and the most recent bars are moderate and close to the window average.
2023-09-27.combined: Falling price with flat volume means the decline is steady rather than accelerating or capitulating, so the downtrend persists without strong volume confirmation. The lack of a volume surge on the recent down days argues against an imminent reversal, but it also gives no sign of heavy selling pressure building up.

2023-09-28.kline: The window opens with a few small green candles near the top, then a large red drop to a lower level, followed by a choppy descent with weak bounces, and the latest candle is green but sits in the lower part of the window's range, near the lows. Price falls across most of the window without a clear close below the earlier lows, so this is a downtrend rather than a breakdown.
2023-09-28.volume: Volume stays at a similar level throughout the window, with no sustained surge or fade, though a few taller bars appear in the early and middle sections. Red (down) days are frequent and several carry above-average volume, while the most recent bars show no clear spike, consistent with the flat volume state.
2023-09-28.combined: Mostly red candles on comparable volume suggest persistent selling pressure without strong conviction from a volume surge, so the downtrend continues but lacks a volume-driven acceleration. The latest green candle on unremarkable volume is too weak to signal a reversal.

2023-09-29.kline: The window opens near the high, drops sharply mid-early with a large red candle, then bounces in a modest rally around the middle of the window before falling again into the lower part of the range. The latest close sits near the window low, and the bounces do not change the overall decline.
2023-09-29.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay at moderate levels throughout, with one tall green bar early-middle and a tall red bar later, and recent days are about the same as earlier. Down days and up days both appear at similar sizes, so the volume chart shows no clear expansion or fade.
2023-09-29.combined: Price falling steadily while volume stays at ordinary levels suggests the decline is orderly rather than panic-driven, with no volume surge to confirm a reversal. The lack of volume support for the mid-window bounce supports the view that the downtrend continues.

2023-10-02.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting with a large red candle near the top of the range and sliding lower through a series of smaller bounces. The window high sits at the left edge and the window low is near the right side, and the latest green candle closes in the lower part of the range, so the decline holds despite the recent green days.
2023-10-02.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade: the early tall green spike and the large red bars are offset by similar-sized bars later on. Down days and up days both carry comparable volume throughout, and the most recent bars are about the same height as earlier ones, which matches the flat volume state.
2023-10-02.combined: The steady decline on unchanged volume suggests selling pressure without a strong surge of conviction, so the downtrend looks orderly rather than capitulatory. The recent green candles on similar volume are not enough to signal a reversal, so the bearish structure still applies.

2023-10-03.kline: The window opens with a large red candle near the top of the range, followed by a drift lower with small bounces, and the latest candles sit near the window low, so the latest close is in the lower part of the range. Prices fall across most of the window, with the early high near the top and the recent closes in the bottom third.
2023-10-03.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars appear early, including a tall green day near the start, while the most recent bars are of moderate height, similar to those in the middle of the window.
2023-10-03.combined: Steadily falling prices on flat volume suggest a persistent downtrend without strong selling climax or accumulation signals. The lack of rising volume on the latest down moves means the decline is not clearly accelerating, but nothing in the volume indicates a reversal.

2023-10-04.kline: The window starts with a tall green candle near the low, rises to a high around the first third, then trades choppily in the middle of the range before dropping to a low near the 80% mark. The last few sessions show a small green rebound, with the latest close only in the middle-to-upper part of the range, short of a clear recovery of the late fall.
2023-10-04.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early sessions show the tallest bars, including a large red bar and a tall green bar, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter and fairly even, so the volume chart shows fading activity into the latest days.
2023-10-04.combined: Choppy, sideways price action with no firm direction, combined with shrinking volume, suggests a pause or indecision rather than a confirmed breakout, breakdown, or reversal.

2023-10-05.kline: The window opens near the top of the range and falls over most of the 20 days, with lower highs and a long red decline into a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-to-late part of the window. Green candles then rise over the final several sessions, recovering roughly half of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2023-10-05.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur early in the window, including a very large red day, while the most recent sessions show clearly lower bars that are fairly uniform. The recent volume bars are both red and green, so the lower volume does not favor either side.
2023-10-05.combined: The recovery in price is occurring on shrinking volume, so the rebound lacks strong participation and the V-bottom is not strongly confirmed. A further rise on expanding volume would be needed to validate the reversal.

2023-10-06.kline: Price falls from near the window high to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-late part of the window, forming a V-shaped bottom, then rallies over the last several days. The latest close is a green candle near the top of the range, recovering most of the decline, so the shape is a V-shaped reversal bottom.
2023-10-06.volume: Volume is flat: bars stay in a similar band throughout, with the tallest bars early in the window (a red spike around the third day) and recent bars roughly the same height as earlier ones. Up days (green) and down days (red) are mixed in volume terms, with no clear surge on the recovery.
2023-10-06.combined: The recovery is coming on steady, unremarkable volume, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume expansion. Price action supports a bottom reversal, but buyers have not yet shown a clear volume surge behind the rally.

2023-10-09.kline: Price fell from the upper part of the window through a series of red candles to a low near the window's lower end around the middle-late bars, then rallied in a V shape with several green days to a close at the window high on the rightmost bar. The rise recovered nearly all of the decline, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2023-10-09.volume: Volume is contracting: the tall volume spikes occur on the early and mid-window red days, while the most recent bars are visibly smaller and fairly even, mostly green days on moderate volume.
2023-10-09.combined: The rally off the low is happening on steadily shrinking volume, so the V-shaped recovery has weaker participation behind it and only partially confirms the reversal.

2023-10-10.kline: Price fell in a steep, multi-day slide from a high near the top of the window to a low near the bottom, then rallied in a V-shaped recovery that has nearly retraced the whole decline. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, but below the early-window highs, so this is a double-sided reversal rather than a breakout.
2023-10-10.volume: Volume is flat overall: the early red bars on the left are tall, a spike appears in the middle during the selloff, and the recent green bars on the right stay at moderate, steady heights similar to earlier in the window. Volume does not clearly expand on the up days of the recovery.
2023-10-10.combined: The rally off the low is happening on volume no heavier than the earlier selloff, so the reversal lacks strong buying conviction. Confirmation would need volume to rise on up days as price keeps climbing.

2023-10-11.kline: Price starts mid-to-high, rises to a peak near the top of the window early on, then falls steeply for several days to a low near the bottom around the middle-late part of the window. It then rises over the final several days and recovers most of the fall, with the latest close in the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom that does not clearly exceed the early highs.
2023-10-11.volume: Volume is flat overall: one very large red spike appears early in the window during the sharp decline, while the recent days show moderate, fairly uniform green bars that are similar in size to the mid-window volume. Recent up days do not stand out in volume compared with earlier days.
2023-10-11.combined: The recovery from the low is supported by steady green days, but without volume expansion on the rebound the move lacks strong conviction, so the V-shaped reversal is tentative and needs volume to confirm it.

2023-10-12.kline: Price falls for roughly the first ten days, with lower highs and lower lows, to a low near the middle-left of the window, then rallies for about ten days in a V-shaped recovery that climbs back to the window high. The latest close sits near the top of the range, so the rebound has recovered most of the decline.
2023-10-12.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the first bar is the tallest, and the recent bars sit at roughly the same moderate height as the middle of the window rather than surging. The rally days are mostly green with volume similar to the red days earlier, so no clear volume expansion stands out.
2023-10-12.combined: Rising prices on flat volume suggest the recovery is real but lacks strong conviction, so the V-shaped reversal is not yet confirmed by a volume surge.

2023-10-13.kline: Price falls for most of the window from a mid-upper start, with a V-shaped low near the window low around the middle-late bars, then rises steadily for about the last eight bars to the window high. The rebound recovers nearly all of the decline, and the latest red candle closes near the upper end of the range, just below the window high, so this is a V-shaped reversal bottom rather than a breakout.
2023-10-13.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge: the early bars are tall, the middle bars are moderate, and the most recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones. Up and down days (green and red) carry about the same volume, so the volume chart shows no strong expansion or contraction.
2023-10-13.combined: The rally off the low is not accompanied by a noticeable increase in volume, so the recovery lacks volume confirmation and is less convincing as a durable reversal. Price and volume together suggest a V-shaped bottom that has recovered strongly but still needs heavier volume on up days to confirm it.

2023-10-16.kline: The window starts with a sharp decline of several red candles that bottoms about 40% of the way through, forming a V-shaped reversal. A steady rise of mostly green candles then recovers well over half of the fall, with the latest close near the upper-middle of the range, below the window high set by a spike near the right side.
2023-10-16.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the tallest bars come from the early red selloff days, while the recent bars are of similar, moderate height. Up and down days show no clear volume pattern, so the rebound is not carried by a volume surge.
2023-10-16.combined: The price recovery from the low is not matched by rising volume, so the V-shaped reversal is only weakly confirmed. A stronger bottom signal would need volume to expand on the up days.

2023-10-17.kline: Price fell in a steady run of red candles from near the top of the window to a low about a third of the way up the range around the middle of the window, then rallied through a series of green candles back to near the window high, with a red candle near the top and a small pullback before the last green candle. The rally recovered nearly the whole decline and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, which fits a V-shaped bottom reversal.
2023-10-17.volume: Volume stays at roughly the same level throughout the window, with no clear spike or dry-up. The early red down days carry tall bars, and the later green up days show similar heights, so the recent days do not stand out from the earlier ones.
2023-10-17.combined: Price recovered on volume that is about the same as during the decline, so the rebound lacks strong volume confirmation. The reversal is plausible but would be more convincing if the rally came with clearly higher volume.

2023-10-18.kline: The price path rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from a low near the left-middle area and climbing through a series of mostly green candles to a high near the upper end of the range around the 17th day. A large red pullback candle then appears near the high, followed by smaller green candles, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range but below the window high, with no clear close above the earlier highs, which makes this an uptrend with a pullback rather than a breakout.
2023-10-18.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with a few taller red-day bars early on and bars of similar height in the most recent sessions, so there is no clear surge or drying up at the end. Heavier bars appear on some down days early in the window, while recent up and down days carry similar volume.
2023-10-18.combined: Price has been trending higher while volume stays flat, so the rise is steady but shows no volume-driven acceleration or breakout confirmation. The recent pullback on ordinary volume suggests the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by participation.

2023-10-19.kline: Price rallies from a low near the first third of the window to a high near the right side, around the 17th candle, then falls for about five candles and gives back roughly half of the rise. The latest close is a small red candle sitting near the middle of the range, slightly below it, so this is an inverted-V shape rather than a breakout or breakdown.
2023-10-19.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no clear surge or dry-up as the price turns. A few red bars early and mid-window are about as tall as the green bars, and the most recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones, which matches the flat volume state.
2023-10-19.combined: The rally and partial give-back show a top forming, but flat volume does not show strong selling or buying conviction behind the turn. The reversal is therefore a tentative signal that would need heavier volume on the down days to be confirmed.

2023-10-20.kline: Price rose over most of the window from a low near the middle-left, with a series of green candles lifting it toward a peak near the right-hand side, then fell back over the last several sessions in a rounded inverted-V top. The decline gave back most of the rise, and the latest red candle closes near the bottom of the window range, in the lower part of the range.
2023-10-20.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with bar heights similar from the early red days through the middle and the recent sessions. The early red bars are not clearly larger than the later ones, and the final red down days are about the same size as the green up days before them.
2023-10-20.combined: The reversal shape on price is not confirmed by volume, since flat volume shows no surge on the decline or on the peak days. The decline lacks a volume signal of heavy selling, so the top is less convincing than the price path alone suggests.

2023-10-23.kline: Price rises over roughly the first 60% of the window from a low near the left side to a peak near the window high around two-thirds of the way across, forming an inverted-V shape. It then falls back over the last several days and the latest green close sits in the lower half of the range, having given back most of the rise.
2023-10-23.volume: Volume is flat: bars stay at similar heights across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars are early red down days and a few red days near the peak, while the green up days in the middle of the rise carry moderate volume.
2023-10-23.combined: The rally to the peak came on ordinary volume and the decline is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. The inverted-V shape still points to a top, but the flat volume means the signal is only moderately convincing.

2023-10-24.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-right, forming an inverted-V shape. It then falls over several sessions, giving back most of the rise, and the latest green candle sits in the lower-middle part of the range, well below the window high.
2023-10-24.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no clear sustained expansion or contraction. Several red down-day bars in the later part of the window carry volume similar to the green up-day bars earlier, and the most recent bar is not markedly heavier than the window average.
2023-10-24.combined: The rise came on broadly steady volume and the decline has not shown a clear volume surge, so the volume does not strongly confirm the reversal. The inverted-V price shape with lower closes suggests a top, but the evidence is moderate rather than decisive.

2023-10-25.kline: Price rises for most of the window from near the lows to a peak about two-thirds of the way across, forming an inverted V, then falls over several days and gives back most of the rise. The latest red candle sits in the lower half of the window range, well below the peak.
2023-10-25.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The taller bars cluster near the peak and during the sell-off, while recent days are mixed red and green at moderate levels, consistent with the flat volume state.
2023-10-25.combined: A rally that reverses into a sell-off is a top signal, but flat volume means the decline lacks strong volume confirmation, so the reversal is less convincing than it would be on heavy selling volume.

2023-10-26.kline: Price rises for about 12 days from a low-middle start to a peak near the top of the window, forming an inverted V, then falls over the last several days. The latest red candle closes near the window low, giving back most of the rise, so the latest close sits in the lower part of the range.
2023-10-26.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The most recent red day is the tallest bar, but it is a single-day spike rather than a trend, and the volume bars mix red and green days without a clear pattern.
2023-10-26.combined: The price reversal from the peak is clear, but volume is flat rather than expanding on the down moves, so the top is not strongly confirmed by volume. The final sharp down day with the tallest volume bar suggests selling pressure is starting to appear.

2023-10-27.kline: The stock climbs over roughly the first 12 days to a peak near the top of the window, forming an inverted V, then falls through several red candles and ends near the bottom of the range. The latest candle is a small green bounce that sits in the lower part of the range, well below the peak.
2023-10-27.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars cluster on the red down days in the middle-right of the window, and the most recent green day's volume is close to the window's typical level.
2023-10-27.combined: The decline occurs with volume at or above typical levels, which suggests selling pressure during the reversal. Because overall volume is flat rather than clearly expanding, the top is not strongly confirmed, and the latest small bounce on average volume does not signal a recovery.

2023-10-30.kline: Price rises for about ten days from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high, then falls for roughly nine days, giving back nearly the entire rise, forming an inverted V. The latest close is a small green candle in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2023-10-30.volume: Volume stays at a broadly similar level across the window, so recent activity is about the same as earlier. A few red down-day bars, especially a tall one near the end, stand out, but they do not represent a sustained surge.
2023-10-30.combined: The decline is happening on volume that is roughly unchanged from earlier in the window, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. The pattern reads as a rise that has been fully reversed, but the flat volume means the selling pressure is not clearly intensifying.

2023-10-31.kline: The price rises over roughly the first 11 to 12 days, from the lower-middle of the range to a peak near the top of the window, then falls over the remaining days in a rounded, inverted-V shape. The fall gives back most of the rise, and the latest close, a small green candle, sits in the lower part of the range near the window low.
2023-10-31.volume: Volume stays at a fairly steady level across the window with no clear surge or drop-off in the latest days. The tallest bars are red down days in the middle and later part of the decline, while several green up days in the rally carry similar moderate volume.
2023-10-31.combined: The rounded top followed by a sustained decline suggests a reversal from the prior uptrend, but flat volume gives little extra conviction. The heavier red down days hint at selling pressure, yet the lack of a volume surge on recent days means the reversal is not strongly confirmed.

2023-11-01.kline: The price rises from the left to a peak near the top of the range around the 9th candle, then falls for about eight days to a low near the bottom of the window. It then rebounds over the last few sessions, forming a V-shaped bottom, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, roughly three-quarters of the way up.
2023-11-01.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with bars at similar heights throughout and no clear surge. The taller red bars in the middle of the window fall on down days, while the final green bars are not noticeably larger than earlier ones.
2023-11-01.combined: The rebound recovers more than half of the prior decline, which supports a bottoming reversal, but volume does not expand on the up days. Flat volume means the recovery lacks strong participation, so the bottom is less convincing until volume picks up.

2023-11-02.kline: The window falls from a high near the top of the range around the middle of the window to a low near the bottom about two-thirds of the way through, then rebounds over several days. The final green candle lifts the close to roughly two-thirds up the range, recovering about 60% of the decline, which fits a double-bottom-like reversal rather than a continuing downtrend.
2023-11-02.volume: Volume stays broadly flat across the 20 days with no sustained surge or drop-off. Taller bars appear on some red down days in the middle and on a few recent days, but the overall bar heights stay in a similar band, and the last green bar is not dramatically larger than earlier bars.
2023-11-02.combined: The rebound is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. Price has recovered from the lows, but buyers do not appear to be pushing volume higher on the up moves.

2023-11-03.kline: Price fell from a high near the top of the window through a mid-window bounce to a low near the bottom around the 17th-18th bars, then rose over several green candles in a V-shaped recovery. The latest close sits just above the midpoint of the range, having recovered roughly half or more of the earlier decline.
2023-11-03.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no strong expansion or contraction, though a few red down-days in the middle show taller bars. Recent green up-days are at levels similar to earlier bars, so the rebound is not carried by a volume surge.
2023-11-03.combined: The rebound off the lows is occurring on volume that is no higher than earlier in the window, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume. Price recovery alone supports a bottoming pattern, but it needs follow-through on rising volume to be convincing.

2023-11-06.kline: Price falls from near the window high on the left through a series of lower highs and lows, then bottoms out around two-thirds across the window in a V shape. A rally of several green candles follows and recovers most of the decline, leaving the latest close in the upper part of the range, though still below the window high.
2023-11-06.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the latest days. The red down-day bars in the middle and near the trough stand out as the tallest, while the green up-day bars in the recovery are mostly similar in height to earlier bars.
2023-11-06.combined: The V-shaped recovery on roughly flat volume suggests the bottom has formed, but without a clear volume surge on the rally the reversal is not strongly confirmed. The heavier red volume near the low shows selling pressure that buyers have so far absorbed.

2023-11-07.kline: Price falls for about 14 of the 20 days, from the upper-middle of the range to a low near the bottom of the window around the 14th-15th bars, forming a V shape. It then rises over the last five or six days, with the latest green candle closing near the window high, above the early-window highs and recovering all of the decline.
2023-11-07.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge. The tallest bars are a red day in the middle of the window and a red day around bar 13, and the final rally days show only moderate green volume.
2023-11-07.combined: The V-shaped recovery and the latest close near the top of the range point to a bottom reversal, but the flat volume does not show the strong buying interest that would confirm it. The rally is not yet backed by a clear volume surge.

2023-11-08.kline: The window shows a V shape: price falls from near the window high through several days of red candles to a low in the lower-middle part of the range, then rises through several green candles and recovers most of the decline. The latest close sits near the top of the range, close to the window high, so the recovery is more than half of the fall and the pattern is a V-shaped reversal bottom rather than a breakout.
2023-11-08.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with bars of similar height from left to right and no sustained surge. The tallest bars come in the middle and near the right, and the large red bar near the low lines up with the sell-off, while the green up days in the recovery do not show a clear volume expansion.
2023-11-08.combined: Price recovering from the low on volume that is no higher than earlier in the window suggests the reversal is plausible but not strongly confirmed. A V-shaped rebound with flat volume lacks the participation that would make it convincing.

2023-11-09.kline: Price falls from a high near the top of the window through several down days to a low near the bottom of the range about two-thirds of the way across, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then rises for several days, recovering most of the decline, and the latest candle is a small red bar near the top of the range, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2023-11-09.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no clear surge or drying up, which matches the flat volume state. The tallest bars cluster in the rising section on the right, and the latest bar is a moderate red bar at a level similar to earlier bars.
2023-11-09.combined: The V-shaped recovery on steady volume suggests the decline has reversed, but without a clear volume expansion on the up days the rebound is not strongly confirmed. The price strength in the rally is backed by average volume, so the reversal signal is moderate rather than decisive.

2023-11-10.kline: Price fell from the early part of the window to a low near the middle, forming a V-shaped bottom, then rallied steadily on mostly green candles and recovered most of the decline. The latest close is a green candle near the top of the window range, close to the early highs.
2023-11-10.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. A few days stand out, including a tall red bar on a down day in the early-middle section and a tall green bar during the rally, while the most recent days show no sustained surge or drop.
2023-11-10.combined: The V-shaped recovery is supported by green up days in the rally, but the lack of a volume surge on the recovery leaves the reversal only moderately confirmed.

2023-11-13.kline: Price fell from the left side of the window to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-right, then rose steadily on mostly green candles, recovering nearly all of the decline. The latest candle is a small red day that sits near the top of the range, close to the window high, so the rise was a V-shaped reversal from the bottom.
2023-11-13.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no clear surge or drying up relative to earlier days. Several of the taller bars fall on green up days during the rally, and the most recent red bars are moderate in size rather than standing out.
2023-11-13.combined: The rally off the low came with volume that is roughly steady rather than clearly expanding, so the recovery is not strongly confirmed by volume. Price has recovered most of the decline near the top of the range, which supports a V-bottom reversal, but the flat volume means the move needs follow-through to be convincing.

2023-11-14.kline: The window starts with a decline of several days that ends in a long red candle near the window low, then a multi-day rally of mostly green candles lifts price back to near the window high. The rally recovers essentially all of the fall in a V-shaped bottom, and the latest small red candle sits near the top of the range, in the upper part.
2023-11-14.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge or drying up, and the bars stay at similar heights throughout. Green up-day bars are mixed in with red down-day bars, and the most recent red bar is moderate rather than unusually large or small.
2023-11-14.combined: Price recovering from the low on volume that is about the same as earlier in the window gives only a modest confirmation of the V-shaped reversal. The lack of a volume surge on the rally means the recovery lacks strong conviction, so the latest pullback should be watched.

2023-11-15.kline: The window forms a V-shaped reversal: an early decline from the upper part of the range falls to the window low around the 9th to 10th bars, then a steady multi-day rise recovers nearly all of the drop. The latest close sits near the window high, in the upper part of the range, with only small pullbacks along the way.
2023-11-15.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no clear spike or dry-up. Bar heights stay in a similar band from start to finish, and the tallest bars appear in the middle and later part of the rise, with no sharp volume surge on the final up days.
2023-11-15.combined: The recovery from the low is supported by price strength, but volume does not expand on the rally, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. Price and volume together suggest a V-shaped recovery that is intact but not yet confirmed by increasing participation.

2023-11-16.kline: Price fell from the window's high at the left into a low about a third of the way through the window, then rallied in a series of higher highs and higher lows with a few small pullbacks. The latest green candles close near the top of the 20-day range, close to the window high.
2023-11-16.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the bars stay in a similar height band from left to right with no strong surge or drop-off recently. The tallest bars sit in the middle of the rally, and the most recent days are moderate and similar to earlier levels, with green up days and red down days mixed in.
2023-11-16.combined: The steady rise on roughly unchanged volume suggests the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong volume confirmation of a new surge in buying interest. The latest closes near the window high support the trend, though the flat volume gives no clear sign of a breakout.

2023-11-17.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with a sharp drop of several red candles early on followed by a steady series of higher highs and higher lows. The latest close sits near the top of the window range, after a few small red pullbacks that do not reverse the rise.
2023-11-17.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, as the flat state indicates. Several tall green bars appear in the middle of the window, while the most recent bars are of similar height and mix of green and red, so there is no clear volume surge at the end.
2023-11-17.combined: The price rise continues on steady rather than expanding volume, so the uptrend is intact but volume does not confirm a new acceleration or breakout. Recent up and down days carry similar volume, which suggests balanced participation rather than strong buying pressure.

2023-11-20.kline: After an early red drop to near the window low, price climbs through most of the 20 days with small pullbacks along the way, and the latest candles sit near the window high in the upper part of the range. The rise is a steady staircase of higher highs and higher lows, so the pattern is an uptrend.
2023-11-20.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no clear surge or drop-off in the latest days. The tallest bars occur in the middle of the window on mostly green up days, while the most recent bars are moderate in height and mix green and red days, matching the flat volume state.
2023-11-20.combined: Rising price on steady, unremarkable volume supports the uptrend but does not add strong confirmation of a fresh breakout. Without a volume expansion on the latest up days, the trend looks orderly rather than accelerating.

2023-11-21.kline: Price climbs steadily from low on the left to near the top of the window, with a few small red pullbacks along the way. The latest candle is a small red body sitting near the window high, in the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact rather than reversed.
2023-11-21.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, consistent with the flat volume state. A few mid-window green bars are taller and the early red bars are sizable, but the most recent bars are not noticeably larger than earlier ones, and the final bar is slightly lower.
2023-11-21.combined: The steady price rise is not accompanied by a clear volume surge, so the uptrend is intact but lacks strong volume confirmation. Recent flat volume alongside a small red close near the highs suggests the advance is losing some momentum.

2023-11-22.kline: Price climbs steadily from the bottom-left to the top-right of the window, with small red pullbacks inside the rise and no reversal. The latest close, a small red candle, sits near the window high in the upper part of the range, so the window is an uptrend with the pattern not forming a breakout.
2023-11-22.volume: Volume is contracting: the tall green bars in the early and middle part of the window give way to noticeably shorter bars over the last several sessions. The final two or three days show the lowest bars, with the most recent day still shorter than the peaks.
2023-11-22.combined: Price is still rising overall, but it is doing so on shrinking volume, which suggests the advance is losing momentum. This is a weaker sign for the uptrend than rising volume would be, so it warrants caution rather than confirming a new leg up.

2023-11-24.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting near the bottom-left and stepping higher with several green up days. The highest prices sit at the far right, and the latest close is near the top of the range after a small red pullback in the final days. The shape is a steady rise rather than a clear reversal or breakout.
2023-11-24.volume: Volume is contracting: the early and middle bars are tall, with the largest bars around the mid-window green rally, while the bars over the last several days are visibly shorter. The most recent red bars are among the lowest in the window, so the quieter volume lines up with the recent pullback days.
2023-11-24.combined: The price uptrend is intact, but the falling volume into the latest high-level pullback suggests waning buying conviction. Without a volume surge on up days, the trend looks less strongly supported and could stall if volume does not pick up.

2023-11-27.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left to the upper right, with the window's lows near the start and the highs in the final days, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range. The rise is interrupted only by small red pullbacks, and the last few candles flatten near the top, so the shape is a persistent rise rather than a reversal, with no clear fall that gives back half the gain.
2023-11-27.volume: Volume is contracting: the early green bars are tallest, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter, and the last several red down days are among the lowest bars in the window. Volume therefore declines as the price approaches its highs, with the strongest activity on early up days.
2023-11-27.combined: Price is still rising overall, but it is doing so on shrinking volume, and the recent red days are on light volume, which suggests the uptrend is losing momentum. This is a caution signal for the trend rather than a confirmed reversal.

2023-11-28.kline: Price rises in a rounded, accelerating curve from the lower left to the upper right of the window, with most candles green and only brief red pauses. The latest close is near the window high, in the upper part of the range, and the last few candles flatten into a small pullback that gives back only a small part of the rise, so it is not a reversal.
2023-11-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars come from the early and middle green up-days, while the bars over the most recent days are visibly shorter. Recent red down-days are not very heavy either, so the latest sessions show less participation than the earlier rally.
2023-11-28.combined: Rising prices on falling volume suggest the uptrend is still intact but losing momentum, so the rally is not being driven by strong buying. Watch whether price can hold near the highs or whether the shrinking volume turns into a deeper pullback.

2023-11-29.kline: Price climbs steadily from the low on the left to near the top of the 20-day range, with a shape like a rising arc. Recent candles stall in a tight band just below the window high, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2023-11-29.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tall green bars of the early and middle rally give way to shorter bars on the most recent days. Volume is lowest on a few recent red days, and the latest bars are mixed between up and down days.
2023-11-29.combined: The rise is still intact, but shrinking volume as price stalls near the highs suggests fading buying momentum rather than a fresh breakout. The uptrend needs a close above the window high on expanding volume to be confirmed as continuing.

2023-11-30.kline: Price climbs from near the window low in the early days through a series of higher highs and higher lows, then flattens into a choppy band near the window high. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the recent peak, so the rise is intact despite the sideways stretch at the top.
2023-11-30.volume: Volume contracts across the window: the tallest bars are on the earliest green up days, and bars shrink steadily toward the right. The most recent sessions show lower red and green bars, with the latest bar green but still well below the early volume.
2023-11-30.combined: Price rising on shrinking volume suggests the uptrend is losing momentum near the highs, so the trend is still intact but less convincing. Volume does not confirm any new breakout.

2023-12-01.kline: Price climbs steeply from the lower left of the window to a plateau near the window high, with the latest green candle sitting in the upper part of the range close to the highs. The rise is interrupted only by small red candles near the top, so this is a pullback within an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2023-12-01.volume: Volume is flat across the window, as the measured state indicates. The tallest bars appear on the earliest green days of the rise, while the mid and late window bars are more uniform, with several red down days showing lower volume and recent green days at moderate levels.
2023-12-01.combined: Price rising on volume that is not expanding suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong conviction, and the flattening near the highs shows buying interest is no longer accelerating.

2023-12-04.kline: Price climbs steadily from near the window low over most of the 20 days, with a few small pullbacks along the way, and it peaks near the upper part of the range in the later sessions. Recent candles flatten out just below the high, and the latest red close sits in the upper part of the range, so the rise is still intact.
2023-12-04.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the early green up-days show tall bars, mid-window red and green bars are similar in height, and the most recent bars are moderate rather than spiking. No single day stands out sharply, and up and down days carry similar volume.
2023-12-04.combined: The rise is supported by steady but not expanding volume, so the uptrend is intact without strong new buying pressure. The flat volume alongside the flattening top suggests the advance may be losing momentum, so confirmation of further upside is limited.

2023-12-05.kline: Price climbs steeply from the window low near the bottom-left, then flattens into a choppy plateau of small red and green candles in the upper part of the range. The rightmost bar is a large green candle that closes at the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier consolidation, so price leaves the prior range upward.
2023-12-05.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: the early green and red bars are tall, the middle bars dip lower, and the recent bars return to about the same height as the early ones. The final green bar is among the taller bars, but it does not stand out far above the rest.
2023-12-05.combined: A close above the prior range on volume that is not clearly expanding is a less convincing breakout, so the move needs follow-through on higher volume to confirm it.

2023-12-06.kline: Price climbs from the low left side of the window to near the window high on the right, with pullbacks along the way, most notably a few red candles in the middle. The latest candle is a red day that closes in the upper part of the range, near the highs but not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-12-06.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in the most recent days. The tallest bar is a green day in the later part of the window, and the latest bar is a moderate red bar, so the volume chart shows no strong expansion.
2023-12-06.combined: Price rising over the window on roughly flat volume suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong volume conviction. The latest red down day on moderate volume hints at some hesitation near the highs.

2023-12-07.kline: Price climbs from near the bottom of the 20-day window to near its high, with a large green rally in the early-middle section and several small pullbacks along the way. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, close to the window high, so the rise holds despite the intermediate dips.
2023-12-07.volume: Volume is flat overall: recent days are about as heavy as earlier ones, with no sustained surge or drop. Several green up days show tall bars, including a standout green day near the right side, while some red down days are lighter, so up days carry slightly more volume than down days without a clear trend in the bar heights.
2023-12-07.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume suggest the uptrend is intact but lack strong volume confirmation, so the move looks orderly rather than explosive. Volume that does not expand on the latest advance leaves room for the trend to stall if buying interest fades.

2023-12-08.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from lows near the bottom of the range on the left to a close near the window high on the latest day. The rise includes several small pullbacks, such as the red candles in the middle, but the overall path is upward and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, forming a stepped climb rather than a distinct named shape.
2023-12-08.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. Taller bars appear early in the window and at a few points in the middle, and the most recent bars are of moderate height, similar to earlier levels, and mix green and red days.
2023-12-08.combined: Rising prices with steady, unremarkable volume suggest an orderly uptrend without strong conviction behind the latest moves. Volume shows no clear acceleration to confirm a breakout, so the uptrend reading rests on the price path alone.

2023-12-11.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, from a low base at the left to a cluster of higher highs near the right edge, with a brief dip around the middle. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, near but not at the window high, so the pattern is an uptrend with pullbacks inside the rise.
2023-12-11.volume: Volume stays roughly flat, with no clear surge in the most recent days compared with the rest of the window. Bar heights vary, and several of the taller bars fall on green up days, while the last few bars are similar in size to earlier ones.
2023-12-11.combined: Rising prices on steady volume suggest the uptrend is intact, but the lack of expanding volume gives little extra conviction that the advance is accelerating.

2023-12-12.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from lower levels on the left with choppy red and green candles and then climbing in steps to a tall green candle near the right. The latest close sits near the upper end of the window's range, just below the highest high, so the window reads as an uptrend with pullbacks inside the rise.
2023-12-12.volume: Volume is flat overall: the early bars are fairly tall, the middle of the window dips to its lowest levels, and the recent bars recover to roughly the same heights as the early part. The tallest bar is a green day in the later part of the window, and the most recent bars are green at similar levels to the early bars, so no clear surge or drop-off appears.
2023-12-12.combined: Rising prices on roughly unchanged volume support the uptrend but do not strongly confirm a new move, since the recent up days lack a clear volume expansion. Buyers are steady rather than accelerating, so the trend is intact but not yet backed by a volume surge.

2023-12-13.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right of the window, with a mix of green and red candles along the way, and the latest green candle is the tallest in the chart. Its high and close sit above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward, forming a breakout after a stair-step rise; the latest close is at the very top of the range.
2023-12-13.volume: Overall volume stays about the same across the window, with many green bars at similar heights to the red bars, so the flat state holds. The final bar is the highest on the chart, but it is a single-day spike rather than a sustained rise in volume, and it lines up with an up day.
2023-12-13.combined: The breakout is supported by a strong up day on the latest bar, but volume has not clearly expanded across the window, so confirmation is only partial and a follow-through day would strengthen it.

2023-12-14.kline: The window starts with choppy, mostly sideways candles near the lower-middle of the range, then climbs steadily through the right half, with several green up-days and a few small red pullbacks along the way. The latest candle is a green bar that closes near the window high, sitting in the upper part of the range.
2023-12-14.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are mixed and moderate, while the right-side bars are taller and mostly green, with the most recent days showing some of the largest volume in the window. Red down-days in the middle of the window carry comparatively lighter volume than the rising sessions near the end.
2023-12-14.combined: Price rising to the upper part of the range on increasing volume, mostly on up-days, suggests the uptrend is being supported by buying interest. The pattern reads as an uptrend rather than a confirmed breakout, since the latest close is near the top of a range built by the rise itself.

2023-12-15.kline: Price starts low in the window, dips in the middle with several red candles, then rises steadily over the last eight or so sessions. The most recent candles sit near the window high, with the latest close in the upper part of the range, so the pattern is an uptrend with pullbacks inside the rise.
2023-12-15.volume: Volume is quiet in the first half of the window, with mostly moderate bars and a few red down days. It builds through the rally, and the rightmost bar is the tallest in the chart, a clear spike on a green up day. Up days generally carry heavier volume than down days.
2023-12-15.combined: Rising prices on rising, heavier volume, with the latest session showing the largest volume spike, suggest strong buying interest behind the uptrend. The spike near the high supports continuation, though it does not by itself confirm a breakout above the prior range.

2023-12-18.kline: Price starts in the lower-middle of the range, chops sideways, then climbs steadily through the second half of the window, with a sharp rally of tall green candles near the end. The window high is a long green candle near the right side, and the latest candle is a red day that closes in the upper part of the range, below that high, so this is a pullback within the rise rather than a breakout.
2023-12-18.volume: Volume is mostly moderate through the window and rises into the final stretch. The standout is a very tall green bar just before the last day, far above the surrounding bars, while the latest red day trades on noticeably lighter volume.
2023-12-18.combined: The strongest volume coincides with an up day during the rally, which supports the uptrend. The lighter volume on the latest red day suggests a mild pullback rather than a reversal.

2023-12-19.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting from a low area on the left with choppy red and green candles and then stepping up in larger green bodies, with a few small red pullbacks along the way. The window high is at the top right, near the second-to-last to last candles, and the latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, well above the midpoint but not clearly breaking above the earlier highs.
2023-12-19.volume: The volume state is a spike, and the chart confirms it: one of the last three days, the second-to-last bar, is far taller than the rest of the window and is a green up day. Volume was generally low and mixed on the early red and green days, then built gradually toward the right, while the latest day's bar is moderate and well below that spike.
2023-12-19.combined: Rising prices on a volume spike on an up day support the uptrend and show strong buying interest, but the smaller volume on the latest green day suggests the spike's momentum is fading and the trend needs follow-through to stay convincing.

2023-12-20.kline: Price starts low in the window with choppy red and green candles, then climbs steadily toward the upper right, with the strongest advance in the second half. The highs are near the window's top, around the tall green candle late in the window, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range after only a small pullback, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-12-20.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, and the recent bars are generally higher. The tallest bar by far is a green up day late in the window, and the most recent bars are moderate, with the final day a red bar at a fairly high level.
2023-12-20.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, and the heavy green volume spike shows strong buying interest. The lighter last few sessions and the red final day suggest the advance is pausing rather than accelerating.

2023-12-21.kline: Price starts near the window low in small, mostly sideways candles, then rises in a series of mostly green candles to a peak near the window high around the 16th day. A short pullback of red candles follows, and the latest red candle closes around the middle to upper-middle of the window range, so the rise dominates the window.
2023-12-21.volume: Volume expands over the window: early days are modest, and volume climbs through the rally with a very large spike on the green day near the peak. The most recent days stay well above the early-window levels, though they fall off from the spike, with red down-days showing mixed volume.
2023-12-21.combined: Rising price on rising volume through the rally supports the uptrend, and the heavy volume spike at the high suggests strong buying interest. The fading volume after the spike and the red pullback candles suggest some hesitation, so the trend is intact but losing momentum.

2023-12-22.kline: Price climbs through most of the 20-day window from near the lows to a sharp peak high in the late-middle bars, forming an inverted-V shape. The last four to five sessions fall back with a series of red candles, and the latest close sits in the lower half of the range, roughly in the lower-middle part of the window's high-low span.
2023-12-22.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall in the most recent days compared with earlier. The standout is a single very tall green bar on an up day near the peak, while the recent red down days show moderate, similar-sized volume to the earlier bars.
2023-12-22.combined: The rally came on generally moderate volume with one large spike on the peak day, and the decline is not accompanied by heavier selling volume. Flat volume means the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation, so the top is tentative and needs follow-through lower to be confirmed.

2023-12-26.kline: Price rose from the lower left of the window to a peak near the upper right-center, with the highest candles around the 13th-14th bars, then fell over the last several days in a series of red candles. The decline gave back roughly half to most of the prior rise, and the latest close sits near the middle of the range, slightly into the lower half, forming an inverted-V style top.
2023-12-26.volume: Volume spikes sharply on the bar at the price peak, a large green day, then drops off. The following red down days trade on steadily smaller bars, with the most recent bars the lowest in the window, so the selloff is occurring on contracting volume.
2023-12-26.combined: The price peak came on a high-volume up day, which suggests a blow-off or exhaustion. The subsequent decline on shrinking volume shows weak selling pressure and only partly confirms the reversal top.

2023-12-27.kline: Price rises across the first two-thirds of the window, from lows near the bottom of the range to a sharp peak with a long upper wick in the upper-middle part of the window, forming an inverted-V shape. It then falls over the last several sessions, giving back most of the rally, and the latest close sits in the lower half of the range.
2023-12-27.volume: Volume contracts over the window, with a single large spike on a green up day in the middle-to-late rally and then mostly lower bars on the final red down days. The most recent sessions show the smallest volume, so the decline is occurring on fading participation.
2023-12-27.combined: The rally was driven by a high-volume surge, but the subsequent price decline is happening on shrinking volume, which suggests the selling pressure is not very forceful and the top is not yet confirmed by heavy distribution. The inverted-V price shape with weakening volume is consistent with a reversal top that still needs follow-through confirmation.

2023-12-28.kline: Price rose from the lower-left of the window through a series of higher highs to a peak near the upper part of the range about two-thirds of the way across, then fell over the following several sessions in an inverted-V shape, giving back well over half of the rise. The latest candles bounce only slightly, leaving the latest close in the lower half of the range, well below the window high.
2023-12-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bar of the window is a single green spike on the day of the price peak, and volume then falls off into a series of smaller red bars during the decline, with the most recent bars the smallest of the late window.

2024-03-04.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, stepping down from near the window high through a series of lower highs and lower lows with only brief green bounces. 2024-03-05.kline: Price drifted lower across most of the window with a series of lower highs, then the last two or three candles fell sharply and closed well below the earlier lows, so the latest close sits near the bottom of the window range. The most recent red candle closes at the window low.
2024-03-05.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window: the earlier bars are moderate and mixed in color, while the last few bars rise sharply, with the tallest bar of the window being a red down day close to the most recent session and the latest bar also red and high.

2024-03-06.kline: The price path falls from the upper part of the window with a few small bounces, then the last one to three candles drop sharply and close near the window low, well below the earlier lows. 2024-03-06.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window, with the tallest bar appearing in the final stretch and the most recent sessions staying well above the quieter early bars. The biggest volume spikes fall on red down days, while the few green days carry noticeably lighter volume.

2024-03-07.kline: Price opens the window near the top of the range and falls over most of the 20 days with a few small green bounces, then the last one to three red candles drop sharply below the earlier lows, so the latest close sits near the bottom of the window range. 2024-03-07.volume: Volume is light in the early and middle part of the window and rises clearly over the final several days, with the tallest bar of the window being a red down day near the later part of the window and the most recent bars also well above the early levels. 2024-03-08.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from near the top of the range on the left to the bottom on the right, with only brief bounces such as the small green candles in the middle. The single high-volume down day adds some weight to the decline, but the lack of a volume surge at the latest lows means the downtrend is not confirmed as accelerating or reversing.

2024-03-13.kline: Price starts near the top of the window with choppy red and green candles, then falls steeply through the middle of the window to near the window low. 2024-03-14.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting from highs near the top of the range and dropping through a large red down candle to a cluster of lows near the bottom. The recent drift lower on contracting volume suggests weakening selling interest rather than a new trend, so the reversal reads as a fading top rather than a confirmed breakdown.

2024-04-15.kline: The window opens near the top of its range, falls for most of the period to a low near the bottom around the middle-to-late bars, then rallies sharply over the final two green days to near the window high before a red day pulls back a little.
