The largest volume spike is on the early red decline, and the high-volume green bar lines up with the late rally, followed by heavy red volume on the final sell-off days.
2024-04-17.combined: Heavy volume on the falling days alongside the failed rally suggests sellers are in control and the downtrend is being pressed, not reversed. The late rally on strong volume was not sustained, so it does not signal a bottom.

2024-04-18.kline: Price fell from a high early in the window to a low around the middle, then rallied sharply over about three to four days to near the window high, forming a peak shape. The following red candles gave back most of that rally over about five days, leaving the latest close in the lower part of the range.
2024-04-18.volume: Volume is roughly flat overall, with the largest bars on the early red days and the sharp green rally days near the middle-to-late window. Volume stays at elevated levels on the falling red days after the peak, and the most recent bar is somewhat lower, so recent volume is not clearly higher or lower than earlier in the window.
2024-04-18.combined: The rally came on heavy green volume, but the decline after the peak came on similar volume rather than a clear surge, so the volume does not strongly confirm the reversal. The price-volume evidence is mixed, leaving the top pattern suggestive but not conclusively confirmed.

2024-04-19.kline: After a mostly sideways start, price rises sharply over a few days into a spike near the top of the window, forming an inverted V with a tall green candle and a long upper wick near the peak. Over the last five or so days it falls back on red candles, giving back most of the rally, and the latest close sits near the bottom of the window range.
2024-04-19.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no clear surge or fade across the window. The tallest volume bars come on the green rally days near the middle-right, and the recent red down days run at moderate levels similar to the early bars.
2024-04-19.combined: The sharp rally on heavy green-day volume followed by a multi-day decline on only moderate volume suggests selling pressure after the peak, but the flat volume profile means the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume.

2024-04-22.kline: Price was mid-range early on, then spiked sharply to the window high on a large green candle near the middle-right of the window, forming an inverted-V shape. Over the next five or so sessions it fell steadily, giving back most of the rise, and the latest small green candle sits in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2024-04-22.volume: Volume stays in a similar band across the window, with the largest bars clustered around the spike up and the heavy red selling days that followed. The most recent days are about the same size as the earlier bars, consistent with the flat volume state.
2024-04-22.combined: The sharp rally on heavy volume followed by a multi-day decline on mostly red, similarly sized volume points to a top that is being sold into. Because overall volume is flat rather than expanding on the decline, the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume.

2024-04-23.kline: Price was choppy and mostly sideways in the early window, then spiked sharply up on two tall green candles to a peak near the top of the range. It then fell over about five days, with large red candles giving back the entire rally and pushing the latest close near the bottom of the window range, in an inverted-V shape.
2024-04-23.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the two big green rally days show the highest bars, and the early and late red decline days are at similar levels, with no sustained surge or drying up in the most recent days.
2024-04-23.combined: The sharp rally on elevated volume followed by a decline on comparable volume suggests the top was not strongly confirmed by volume, so the reversal signal is moderate rather than decisive.

2024-04-24.kline: Price rallied sharply in the middle of the window, peaking near the window high around the 10th to 13th bars, then fell back through the earlier range to near the window low, forming an inverted-V shape. The latest bars recovered only partly, leaving the most recent close in the lower half of the range.
2024-04-24.volume: Volume stays at roughly the same level across the window, with the tallest bars on the rally days and the sharp decline days showing similar activity. The most recent green bars are not notably larger than earlier volume, which matches the flat volume state.
2024-04-24.combined: The rally was not supported by a volume surge, and the decline on comparable volume erased the gains, so the flat volume doesn't confirm the rebound. The latest recovery on steady volume looks weak, consistent with a top rather than a new uptrend.

2024-04-25.kline: Price was mostly sideways in the early window, then surged in a sharp rally to a spike high near the top of the range (roughly the 10th to 12th candles). It then fell back hard through the starting level to the window low near the 17th candle, forming an inverted V, and the latest small green candles rebounded only partway, leaving the final close in the lower half of the range.
2024-04-25.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The biggest bars come on the rally days and the first big red decline days, while the most recent bars are moderate and close to the window average, with green and red days at similar sizes.
2024-04-25.combined: Heavy volume on the rally and early selloff, followed by steady, unremarkable volume on the rebound, suggests the rally was not sustained and the rebound lacks conviction, so the inverted-V top is not confirmed as a clean reversal back up.

2024-04-26.kline: Price rallied over several days from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high, then fell sharply for several days to near the window low, forming an inverted V with a tall green run. The latest closes have recovered only slightly and sit in the lower half of the range, below the midpoint, so most of the rally has been given back.
2024-04-26.volume: Volume is flat, with recent days roughly matching the earlier bars, though the chart shows the heaviest green (up-day) volume clustered during the mid-window rally and several tall red bars during the decline. The most recent bars are moderate and similar in size to the early-window bars, so no volume surge stands out at the end.
2024-04-26.combined: Heavy volume on the rally and the sell-off, with flat volume now, suggests the advance has stalled and selling pressure has not been matched by a new surge of buying. Without rising volume on the recent bounce, the reversal from the top looks unconfirmed but still in place.

2024-04-29.kline: Price rose from the left side to a peak in the middle of the window, then fell for about seven days to a low near the window floor. The last four days rebounded sharply, with the latest green candle closing in the upper part of the range, roughly 70% of the way up, so the rebound recovered most of the decline in a V-shaped reversal.
2024-04-29.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no clear surge or drop-off in the latest days. The tallest bars cluster around the mid-window high and the decline, while the recent green up days show moderate bars similar to the earlier levels.
2024-04-29.combined: Rising prices on roughly unchanged volume suggest the rebound is not yet strongly supported by buying interest, so the V-shaped reversal is tentative. Confirmation would need volume to expand on the up days.

2024-04-30.kline: Price rallies from the left side of the window to a peak near the window high around the eighth candle, then falls over about seven sessions to a low near the window low. A partial rebound follows, but the latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range, forming an inverted-V rally-then-fall shape.
2024-04-30.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent bars are roughly the same size as those earlier in the window. The largest bars cluster during the sharp rally and the early decline, while the recent rebound days show moderate, steady volume.
2024-04-30.combined: The rally was followed by a decline that erased it, and the latest close remains in the lower half, so the top reversal is not yet resolved. Flat volume during the rebound does not confirm a strong recovery, which leaves the reversal signal intact.

2024-05-01.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak near the window high around the sixth and seventh candles, then falls for several sessions to a low near the window bottom. A partial rebound follows, and the final candles slip back, so the latest close sits in the lower half of the range, forming an inverted V shape with a rounded top.
2024-05-01.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars mostly similar in height. A few green up-days early in the rally, around the peak, stand out somewhat, while the recent sessions look about the same as earlier volume, which matches the flat volume state.
2024-05-01.combined: The rally to the peak and the sell-off on mostly comparable volume do not show strong conviction on either side, so the top is only a moderate signal. Flat volume during the rebound and the latest weakness suggests the reversal would need a further close lower on rising volume to be confirmed.

2024-05-02.kline: Price fell over roughly six sessions from a high near the top of the window to a low near the window's lower third, forming a V-shaped bottom, and then rose over about five sessions. The recovery pushed the latest green close into the upper half of the range, above the level where the decline began, so it recovered more than half of the fall.
2024-05-02.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. Heavier red bars appear during the decline, the rebound days are mostly green with moderate volume, and the most recent bar is only modestly above the window's typical level.
2024-05-02.combined: The rebound from the lows came on roughly unchanged volume, so the recovery is not strongly confirmed by participation. The V-shaped reversal is still valid on price, but the flat volume suggests the bounce needs follow-through to be convincing.

2024-05-03.kline: After a decline to a low near the bottom of the window, price chopped in a middle band with a few tall spikes, then the final candle is a tall red bar that gaps up well above every earlier high and sits at the very top of the 20-day range, so the latest close is at the window high. The earlier highs were only about two-thirds of the way up the chart, so the last day leaves the prior range upward.
2024-05-03.volume: Volume is a clear spike on the final day, the tallest bar in the window by a wide margin, and that bar is red, a down day. The earlier bars are moderate and mixed in color, with only a few green days standing out.
2024-05-03.combined: The breakout is on heavy volume, which supports the upward move out of the range, but the spike came on a red day where the close was below the open, so the conviction is mixed and confirmation needs follow-through on the next sessions.

2024-05-06.kline: After a decline to a low near the middle of the window and a recovery, price spikes sharply in the second-to-last day to a wick near the window high, closing a long red candle well above the earlier highs, and the final day is a smaller red candle that gives back part of the gain. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range but below the spike high, so the window ends with the price just above the prior range.
2024-05-06.volume: Volume is a spike: the second-to-last day, a red down-candle at the top of the window, traded far above the window's normal level, while the final red day traded lower but still above the typical volume of the earlier green days.
2024-05-06.combined: The heavy volume on the high-breaking day, even though that candle closed red, suggests strong participation in the upward move out of the prior range. The lighter follow-through selling on the last day is a caution that the breakout has not yet been confirmed by sustained buying.

2024-05-07.kline: After a decline to the lower part of the window and a rebound, price jumps sharply in the last few days, with a tall red candle reaching near the window high and clearly above the earlier highs of the window. The most recent close sits in the upper part of the range, near the top, after the breakout above the prior range.
2024-05-07.volume: Volume is quiet through most of the window, then spikes to the highest level on the spike day near the right edge, several times the normal level. Volume on the surrounding days is moderate, and the spike coincides with the largest up-move even though that day's candle is red.
2024-05-07.combined: The breakout above the prior range is backed by a volume spike, which supports its significance. The red close on the spike day weakens conviction slightly, so confirmation from the next session would strengthen the signal.

2024-05-08.kline: After falling from the left-side highs to a low around the middle-left of the window, price rebounded, dipped again near the middle-right, then jumped sharply in the last few days. The latest closes sit near the top of the window and above the earlier highs, so the pattern is a breakout, though the spike candle itself is red.
2024-05-08.volume: Volume is expanding: the bars in the first half are moderate, while the last several days are clearly higher, with the tallest bar near the start of the recent surge (a red, down day) and the next days also elevated before tapering somewhat at the end.
2024-05-08.combined: Price breaking above the prior range on sharply higher volume supports the breakout, but the high-volume surge day closed red, so buyers did not hold the full gain and follow-through should be watched.

2024-05-09.kline: Price fell from the upper left to a low in the lower-middle of the window, then rallied in a V-shaped reversal with a sharp gap up near the end. The last few candles close near the window high and above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so the latest close leaves the prior range upward.
2024-05-09.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the most recent days clearly higher than the quiet early bars. The tallest bar is a red down day near the end, and the following green up days also trade on heavy volume.
2024-05-09.combined: Rising price on rising volume, with the sharp move above the prior range, supports the breakout, though the heavy red day near the top shows sellers were active at the high.

2024-05-10.kline: Price fell from the upper left to a low near the lower-middle of the window, rallied through several green candles back to the middle, then gapped sharply higher in the final days. The most recent green candle closes near the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so price has left the prior range upward.
2024-05-10.volume: Volume stays fairly steady across most of the window with no sustained increase, aside from one tall red spike on a down day near the start of the final advance. The recent green up days show modest bars roughly in line with earlier levels, so the volume state of flat is reflected.
2024-05-10.combined: Rising price on steady rather than expanding volume only partly confirms the breakout, so the move is credible but not strongly backed by participation. A sustained rise in volume on the next up days would strengthen the breakout reading.

2024-05-13.kline: The window forms a V-shaped path: candles fall from the upper left to a low around the early-middle of the window, then rally for several days to close near the top of the range. The latest green candle sits close to the window high, which is set by a tall red day about two-thirds of the way through, so the recovery covers most of the earlier decline.
2024-05-13.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with a large spike on the tall red day and a few other high bars, while the most recent days stay at moderate levels similar to earlier bars. Up days and down days carry similar volume, so the rally is not clearly supported by a volume surge.
2024-05-13.combined: The price recovery from the low toward the upper range suggests a V-shaped bottom, but flat volume means the rally lacks strong volume confirmation, so the reversal is tentative.

2024-05-14.kline: Price starts low on the left, rises through the middle, and makes a sharp surge to the upper part of the window around the 13th-14th bars, followed by a pullback to the middle of the range. Price then climbs in a series of higher lows to near the window high on the most recent bar, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2024-05-14.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with one tall red spike on the surge day near the middle of the window and otherwise similar bar heights throughout. The most recent bars are about the same size as the earlier ones, and the mix of green and red up and down days shows no clear volume build-up into the latest rise.
2024-05-14.combined: Rising price with volume that stays flat, apart from the mid-window spike, gives only moderate support to the uptrend. The rally is not backed by a clear increase in volume on the recent up days, so conviction is limited.

2024-05-15.kline: After a choppy, mostly sideways stretch in the lower half of the window, price gaps up sharply from the middle of the range to the top of the window, with a large red candle near the high and then a series of up and down days. The latest green candle closes at the top of the window range, above the earlier highs, so price has left the prior range upward.
2024-05-15.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge. The tallest bar is a red day around the sharp drop in the middle of the window, and the most recent green days are only moderately above the typical level.
2024-05-15.combined: Price has broken above its earlier range, but volume on the breakout days is not clearly elevated, so the move lacks strong volume confirmation.

2024-05-16.kline: After about ten sideways-to-slightly-lower bars near the bottom of the window, price gaps sharply upward around the middle of the window and then climbs in a series of mostly green and red candles to the window high. The latest red candle sits near the top of the range, above the highs of the earlier base, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2024-05-16.volume: Volume is roughly flat, as the volume state says: recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones. The tallest bar is on the gap-up day, with a few elevated bars right after it, and the most recent bars return to levels similar to the early window, with no clear surge on the latest up days.
2024-05-16.combined: The upward gap on the heaviest volume supports a genuine breakout, but without rising volume in the latest days the follow-through is less convincing than a breakout on expanding volume would be.

2024-05-17.kline: After an early swing that sank from a mid-window high to a low around the middle of the window, price rallied steadily through the last 8-10 days in a series of mostly green candles with small pullbacks, climbing from the lower-middle of the range to near the window high. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the window high, so the rise dominates the window.
2024-05-17.volume: Flat volume: the tallest bar is a red day near the early-middle of the window, a volume spike on a down day, and the most recent bars are close to the average level seen earlier, with no sustained surge. Green up days in the recent rally carry moderate volume similar to earlier green days.
2024-05-17.combined: Price is rising on steady, unremarkable volume, so the advance looks orderly, but the lack of volume expansion means the recent rally is not strongly confirmed by participation. The early red volume spike marks a sell-off that the stock has since recovered from.

2024-05-20.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from lows near the bottom-left to highs near the top-right, with a sharp red dip around the middle and a gap up after it. The latest green close sits near the window high, in the upper part of the range.
2024-05-20.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion. The tallest red bar is an early-middle spike on a down day, while the most recent bars are moderate and mix green and red.
2024-05-20.combined: The rising price path with the latest close near the top is consistent with an uptrend, but volume is not expanding on the recent up days, so the advance lacks strong volume confirmation.

2024-05-21.kline: After a sideways start near the lower-middle of the window, a gap up around the middle of the window launched a multi-day rally with a large red candle at the top of the move, and the rise continued in a series of higher highs. The latest close, a green candle, sits near the window high in the upper part of the range, so the window reads as an uptrend rather than a fresh breakout.
2024-05-21.volume: Volume contracts over the window: a very tall red spike appears in the middle of the rally, and the volume bars then fall to moderate levels. The most recent bars are clearly lower than the earlier spike and the mid-window volume, with green up days and red down days mixed in.
2024-05-21.combined: Price is still rising to the upper part of the range, but it is doing so on falling volume, which suggests the uptrend is losing momentum and has less buying conviction than during the initial spike.

2024-05-22.kline: After a low cluster of small candles on the left, a sharp gap-up and steady rally carry price to the top of the 20-day range, with the latest red candle near the window high. The rise spans most of the window and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, though the big red candle earlier in the window marks the prior high.
2024-05-22.volume: Volume is contracting: a very large red-day spike appears early in the window, after which bars shrink to moderate levels. The most recent days show smaller bars, with mixed green and red days and a short red bar on the last day.
2024-05-22.combined: Price is still advancing toward the top of the range while volume fades from its early spike, so the rise is losing some conviction. The declining volume does not confirm the uptrend strongly and suggests momentum may be slowing.

2024-05-23.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left lows through a series of green candles to near the top of the 20-day window, with a gap-up region in the middle. The most recent candle is a large red down day that pulls the close back from the window high, but the close still sits in the upper part of the range, so this is a pullback within an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2024-05-23.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest volume bar sits early in the window, and the recent bars, including the latest red down day, are noticeably shorter. The volume spikes on earlier red days contrast with the quieter final sessions.
2024-05-23.combined: The rise is supported by heavy volume earlier in the window, but the latest red day comes on lower volume than before, so the pullback looks orderly rather than a sign of heavy selling. Overall, the uptrend remains intact while the fading volume suggests reduced conviction going forward.

2024-05-24.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window, with a few small down and up candles, then climbs in a staircase to a high near the window top around the second-to-last third. The sharp red drop on the penultimate day gives back a large part of the recent gain, and the final green candle recovers part of it, leaving the latest close in the upper part of the range. Overall the window rises across most of its length, so the pattern is an uptrend with a sharp pullback inside it.
2024-05-24.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bar, a red day early on, is far above the rest, and volume trends lower toward the most recent days. The last few bars are short and sit near the low end of the chart, and the sharp red drop day carries only moderate volume rather than a surge.
2024-05-24.combined: The rally is being made on shrinking volume, and the sharp red pullback did not come with heavy selling, so the uptrend is weakening in participation even though the latest close stays in the upper range. Lower volume on the most recent rise suggests fading conviction rather than a confirmed new leg up.

2024-05-28.kline: The window starts near the bottom of the range, with an early sell-off and a choppy stretch in the middle, then climbs in a series of higher highs and higher lows to the upper part of the range. The latest candle is a red day near the window high, so the close sits in the upper portion of the range, though it does not clearly break above the earlier highs.
2024-05-28.volume: Volume contracts over the window: it spikes early on a tall red day near the start, then trends lower, and the most recent bars are visibly smaller than the earlier ones. Green up-days are mixed with red down-days in the recent stretch, with no heavy volume on the latest rally.
2024-05-28.combined: Price rising overall while volume shrinks suggests the uptrend is losing participation, so it is less convincing than a trend backed by expanding volume. The pattern is still an uptrend, but the contracting volume is a caution rather than a confirmation.

2024-05-29.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with a few small candles, then rises in steps through the middle of the range toward the upper part. A tall red candle in the upper-middle area marks a sizable pullback, but the window still ends with green candles recovering to the upper part of the range, below the window high. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range.

2024-05-29.combined: The price rise is intact, but it is occurring on shrinking volume, which suggests waning momentum rather than strong confirmation of the uptrend. Price is not closing above the earlier highs, so there is no breakout signal.

2024-05-30.kline: Price climbs from a low at the far left to a cluster of highs near the right edge, with one sharp red pullback in the later part of the window that does not reverse the rise. The latest green close sits in the upper part of the range near the window high but does not clearly break above the earlier highs.
2024-05-30.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early days include a tall green bar and a very tall red spike, while the recent bars are noticeably shorter and mostly modest in size. Up and down days both show smaller volume toward the right edge.
2024-05-30.combined: Rising price on shrinking volume suggests the uptrend is losing momentum rather than strengthening. The lack of volume expansion on the latest up days means the advance is not confirmed as a breakout.

2024-05-31.kline: After a sharp early decline from the window high to a low around the fifth bar, price rallies for most of the remaining window, with a few red pullbacks along the way. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the recent highs, though not at the window high.
2024-05-31.volume: Volume is flat overall: the tall red spike on the first day is the main outlier, and the bars after it stay at moderate levels similar to the middle of the window. The most recent green up days are about as heavy as the earlier sessions, with no clear surge.
2024-05-31.combined: The rally is supported by a steady, unremarkable volume level, so the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by volume expansion. Rising prices on flat volume suggest a cautious advance rather than a surge of buying.

2024-06-03.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting near the lower part of the range and climbing in a stair-step pattern with a few red pullback days in the middle that do not break the rise. The latest green candle closes near the window high, in the upper part of the range.
2024-06-03.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the first two bars are tall red (heavy selling), the middle bars are a mix of tall and moderate green, and the most recent bars are roughly similar in height to earlier ones with no clear surge or fade.
2024-06-03.combined: Rising prices with volume that stays roughly steady suggest the uptrend is intact, but without a clear volume surge to confirm strong new buying interest.

2024-06-04.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to new highs at the right edge, with a large red candle mid-late that dips to about the lower-middle of the range before recovery. The last two to three candles push above the highs of the earlier window, and the latest red candle closes near the top of the range, so the window shows a breakout above its prior range.
2024-06-04.volume: Volume stays flat, close to the same level across the window, with no clear surge. The tallest bars come mid-to-late in the window and on some green up days near the end, while the latest red day is moderate in size.
2024-06-04.combined: Price is pushing to new highs, but volume does not expand on the breakout days, so the move is only weakly confirmed by volume. A breakout on flat volume could fail without a volume increase on follow-through days.

2024-06-05.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from a low area on the left to a high at the right edge, with a choppy stretch mid-window that includes a large red candle near the lower part of the range. The latest candle is green and sits at or near the top of the window range, so the trend is intact.
2024-06-05.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained surge in the latest days compared with earlier in the window. The tallest bars appear on a few green up days during the rise, and recent bars are moderate, similar to the earlier levels.
2024-06-05.combined: Rising prices with steady, unremarkable volume support the uptrend but do not show the strong participation needed to confirm a breakout. The move higher is orderly rather than driven by a volume surge.

2024-06-06.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left to the upper right of the window, with several small pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles mid-window, that do not reverse the rise. The latest close sits near the top of the 20-day range, close to the window high.

2024-06-06.combined: Steadily rising prices on flat volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong buying conviction or a volume surge. Since volume is not expanding on the advance, the move is not confirmed by heavy participation.

2024-06-07.kline: The price path rises across most of the 20-day window from a low near the left edge to a high at the far right, with several pullbacks along the way such as the red candles in the middle. The latest close sits near the top of the range, close to the window high, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout or reversal.
2024-06-07.volume: Volume stays about the same from the start of the window to the end, with no clear surge or drop in the latest days. Some green up-day bars are tall early on and a few red down-day bars are mid-height, and the final green bars are similar in size to the earlier bars.
2024-06-07.combined: Rising prices on steady, unchanged volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong buying conviction for a new surge. The pattern stays an uptrend, and a volume expansion on up days would be needed to strengthen it.

2024-06-10.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right of the 20-day window, with a sharp red drop mid-window that is recovered within a few days. The latest candle is a red day near the top of the range, so the rise is intact and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, about two-thirds of the way up, close to the window high.

2024-06-10.combined: The price uptrend holds, but volume shows no clear build-up behind it, so the trend is not strongly confirmed. The latest down day on comparable volume is a mild warning rather than a reversal signal.

2024-06-11.kline: Price climbs from the lower left through a series of higher highs and higher lows, with a few red pullbacks in the middle of the window. The final candle is a very tall green bar that closes near the top of the window, well above the earlier highs, so the latest close sits at the top of the range after leaving the prior range upward.

2025-03-19.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in recent days. Some tall red bars appear early and in the middle, while the most recent bars are of similar height to earlier ones, mixed between green and red.

2025-03-20.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window from near the upper part of the range to the lower part, with several small green bounces along the way, including a sharp drop with big red candles in the middle. The latest few candles are small green bars sitting near the window low, so the latest close is in the lower part of the range, which fits a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2025-03-20.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no clear surge or drop-off in the most recent days compared with earlier ones. The largest bars come mid-window during the sharp red decline, while the final days show moderate bars similar in size to the early window.
2025-03-20.combined: The steady decline on roughly flat volume suggests the downtrend lacks strong new conviction, and the late green bounces near the lows are not backed by a volume surge. Without a clear volume expansion, the bounce does not signal a reversal yet.

2025-03-21.kline: The price path is a steep decline from near the window high to near the window low, with a few small green bounces along the way. The latest candle is green and sits near the bottom of the range, so the close is in the lower part of the window and the fall is not reversed.
2025-03-21.volume: Volume stays broadly level through the window, with bars of similar height from the start to the most recent days. The final bar is the tallest in the chart and is green, but the overall volume level is about the same as earlier, so it does not mark a clear volume surge.
2025-03-21.combined: The downtrend remains intact because the latest green day closes low in the range, and flat volume gives no strong sign of accumulation or a turn. A single up day on the last bar is too weak to confirm a reversal.

2025-03-24.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from near the window high down to the lower part of the range, with a few small green bounces along the way. The shape is a steady staircase decline rather than a clear double bottom or V, and the latest small red candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2025-03-24.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained rise or drop in the most recent days. Several tall bars appear, including a large green bar near the end and a tall red bar earlier, but these spikes are scattered and do not form a trend in the volume bars.
2025-03-24.combined: Falling price with steady volume suggests a persistent but unemphatic selling pressure rather than a capitulation or a fresh surge of participation. The volume does not confirm a turn higher, so the downtrend picture holds.

2025-03-25.kline: The window opens near the top of the range with red candles that step down through the middle and into a low near the bottom, with the lowest point in the later part of the window. The last four or so candles bounce with green bodies, but the latest close sits in the lower half of the range, recovering only a minority of the earlier fall, so this is a downtrend with a bounce rather than a reversal.
2025-03-25.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days. The tallest bar is a green up day near the right side, and several red down days in the middle of the decline carry similar volume to the earlier bars.
2025-03-25.combined: Flat volume during a decline with only a modest green bounce shows no clear volume confirmation of a turn higher. The bounce lacks the volume needed to suggest the downtrend is ending.

2025-03-26.kline: The window opens near the top of its range, falls across most of the 20 days to a low near the right-center, then bounces for several sessions. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, well below the window high and short of recovering half the decline, so it reads as a downtrend with a rebound rather than a bottom reversal.
2025-03-26.volume: Volume is flat overall: the early bars are moderate and the red selling bars around the middle of the window are similar in size to the bars at the end. A single tall green spike stands out near the right side, while the last few bars are roughly average to slightly lower.
2025-03-26.combined: The falling price path with no sustained volume expansion on the down days suggests the decline lacks strong conviction, and the modest rebound on steady volume does not yet signal a change in trend. The pattern remains a downtrend unless price closes decisively back above the prior highs on higher volume.

2025-03-27.kline: Price opens near the top of the 20-day range, then falls steeply for most of the window with a few small green bounces, bottoming in the lower-middle of the chart before a partial recovery over the last several days. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, roughly 45% of the way up from the window low, so the rebound does not qualify as a V-shaped reversal.
2025-03-27.volume: Volume is flat overall: the early sell-off days carry some of the heaviest red bars, and the tallest green spike occurs mid-to-late in the window, while the most recent days show only moderate volume, close to the earlier levels.
2025-03-27.combined: The rebound on green days is not backed by a volume surge, so the recent recovery shows no strong buying conviction and the broader downtrend remains the dominant read, with the latest close still in the lower half of the range.

2025-03-28.kline: The window opens near the top of the range and falls steeply for most of the 20 days, with large red candles in the middle and a low near the window bottom around day 12. A modest recovery of small green candles follows, but it retraces only about a third of the decline, and the latest candle is a red day closing in the lower half of the range.
2025-03-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the early and middle sessions, especially the heavy red selling days and a tall green spike, carry the largest bars, while the most recent days show visibly smaller bars that are mostly green but well below the earlier peaks.
2025-03-28.combined: Price is still making lower highs within a falling trend while volume shrinks on the latest bounce, so the recovery looks weak and unconfirmed. The shrinking volume suggests selling pressure is easing, but without a rally that recovers at least half the decline or a close above prior highs, this does not yet signal a reversal.

2025-03-31.kline: The window opens near the top of its range, then falls sharply through the middle days to a low near the bottom around the 11th-12th bars, forming a V-shaped trough. A partial rebound with several green candles lifts price to roughly the middle-lower part of the range, and the latest close sits in the lower half, well short of recovering half the fall, so this is a downtrend with a bounce rather than a reversal.
2025-03-31.volume: Volume is contracting: the early red down-day bars near the start of the window are the tallest, and the tall green spike near the trough is the largest bar, while the most recent bars are noticeably shorter. Volume is heavier on the sharp decline days and lighter on the rebound and final days.
2025-03-31.combined: Falling price on heavier early volume followed by a rebound on lighter volume suggests selling pressure has eased, but the weak recovery without volume expansion does not confirm a bottom, so the downtrend bias remains.

2025-04-01.kline: The window opens near the upper range, then falls sharply through a series of mostly red candles to a low near the window's lower end, around the 11th-12th bars. Price then bounces with mixed green and red candles and a few stronger green days, but the rebound recovers only about a third of the decline. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, so the bounce is a counter-move inside a broader fall.
2025-04-01.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early red selling days carry the heaviest bars, and a single tall green spike appears mid-to-late in the window. The most recent days show noticeably smaller volume bars than the earlier selloff, consistent with the contracting volume state.
2025-04-01.combined: Falling prices on heavier early volume followed by a bounce on lighter recent volume suggests selling pressure is fading but no buying conviction has emerged. The weak rebound does not confirm a reversal, so the downtrend remains the more likely read.

2025-04-02.kline: Price opens near the window high, then falls sharply through the first two-thirds of the window in mostly red candles down to a low near the bottom of the range, around day 13. A small base and partial rebound follow, with green candles pushing price up to roughly 40% of the way back from the low, so the latest close sits in the lower half of the range. The rebound is not a clear double bottom or V, since it recovers well under half of the decline.
2025-04-02.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with the most recent days at about the same level as earlier. A single tall green spike stands out in the middle of the rebound, and the red down days in the decline carry similar volume to the green up days, so the volume chart does not show a clear surge or fade.
2025-04-02.combined: The rebound happens on roughly steady volume with no decisive volume expansion, so it does not confirm a reversal. The latest close remains in the lower half of the range, so the window still reads as a downtrend with a bounce.

2025-04-03.kline: After a decline from the window's high in the first few days, price bottomed in the lower-middle of the range, recovered gradually through mostly green candles to the upper-middle of the range, then the final candle is a long red bar that drops sharply below the earlier lows, leaving the latest close near the bottom of the window range.
2025-04-03.volume: Volume stays broadly level across the 20 days, with bars of similar size throughout, so there is no sustained surge or drying up. The last bar is red and reaches the top of the volume chart, but that single spike does not change the overall level, which matches the flat volume state.
2025-04-03.combined: The sharp red drop below the earlier lows is a breakdown on the final day, but because volume is flat overall rather than expanding, the move is only weakly confirmed and needs follow-through to be convincing.

2025-04-04.kline: The window starts near its high, falls to a trough about midway, then rises into a choppy upper-middle band before two sharp red down days at the end. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the window range, well below the earlier lows around the middle trough, so the price has left the prior range to the downside.
2025-04-04.volume: Volume was modest through most of the window, with a green up-day spike mid-window. It rises sharply over the last two red down days, and the final bar is the tallest in the window, a volume spike.
2025-04-04.combined: Heavy volume on falling prices, especially on the final red day, confirms the breakdown and suggests strong selling pressure as the stock leaves its prior trading range.

2025-04-07.kline: After an early stretch near the top of the window, price slid and then gapped sharply lower over the last few sessions, with a long red candle followed by a long green candle, both closing well below the earlier lows. The latest close sits near the bottom of the 20-day range, far under the prior trading range, which marks a breakdown from that range.
2025-04-07.volume: Volume spikes over the last three sessions, with the tallest bar at the far right (a green up day) and a large red bar just before it, well above the level of the earlier part of the window, while the early bars are modest.
2025-04-07.combined: The heavy volume on the sharp downside move confirms the breakdown, and the high-volume green rebound on the final day shows some buying interest but does not yet reclaim the broken range.

2025-04-08.kline: After a sideways-to-high start near the top of the range, the last few days break sharply lower: a red gap-down candle, a large red candle, then a green bounce, and a final red candle that closes near the window low, well below the earlier lows. The latest close sits in the bottom part of the range, so this is a breakdown from the prior range rather than a simple downtrend.
2025-04-08.volume: Volume is quiet through the early and middle part of the window, then rises into the final days. The tallest bar is the second-to-last day, a green up day, and the most recent red day also traded well above the earlier average.
2025-04-08.combined: Heavy volume on the red breakdown days confirms selling pressure as price leaves the prior range downward. The high-volume green bounce day suggests some buying interest, but the latest red day holding high volume keeps the breakdown signal intact.

2025-04-09.kline: Price rises over roughly the first 12 days to a high near the top of the window, then falls sharply over the next several days, erasing more than the full rise and reaching the window low near the right side. The latest day is a large green bounce that lifts the close to about the middle of the range, so the price shape reads as an inverted V after a crash, with the close still in the lower-to-middle part of the range.
2025-04-09.volume: Volume is fairly steady and moderate early in the window, then climbs through the sell-off days, which are mostly red and high-volume. The final day is a green bar with the tallest volume in the window, a clear spike well above the recent average.
2025-04-09.combined: The heavy volume on the selloff days confirms the downside move, and the spike on the latest up day shows strong buying into the bounce. That buying is not yet enough to reverse the decline, so the top pattern is still in play until price recovers toward the prior highs.

2025-04-10.kline: Price climbed over the first dozen or so sessions to a high near the top of the window, then formed a rounded top and fell sharply through the middle to the window low. The latest session is a green bar that recovers only part of the drop, so the close sits in the lower part of the range (roughly a third of the way up from the low).
2025-04-10.volume: Volume was modest and mixed early in the window, then built steadily as price fell, with the heaviest bars on the red selling days near the end. The clear spike is on the second-to-last day, and the final green bar trades on lower volume than the spike.
2025-04-10.combined: The heavy volume on the sharp decline confirms selling pressure after the top, and the weaker rebound on lower volume suggests the bounce lacks conviction. Together they support a top that has broken down, with the latest close still in the lower half of the range.

2025-04-11.kline: Price climbs for roughly the first dozen days to a high near the top of the window, then falls sharply through several red candles, with long lower wicks, to a low near the bottom of the range. The last few days show a partial bounce on green candles, leaving the latest close in the lower half of the range, so the rise is more than fully given back in an inverted-V shape.
2025-04-11.volume: Volume is modest early in the window and builds through the decline, with the heaviest red-day bars in the middle-to-late stretch. The tallest bar sits in the last three days on a green up day, a clear volume spike, and the most recent bar is also large but below that peak.
2025-04-11.combined: Heavy volume on the sell-off confirms selling pressure behind the reversal from the high. The spike on the recent green rebound day suggests buyers are stepping in, but the close remains in the lower half of the range, so the bounce does not yet undo the top pattern.

2025-04-14.kline: Price rose to the top of the window early on, then fell sharply over about five days to the window low, roughly a V-shaped bottom. It then recovered about 60% of that drop over the last several days, and the latest red candle closes in the upper half of the range, below the earlier highs.
2025-04-14.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, while the bars from the middle of the window onward are much taller, with the largest spikes during the sharp fall and the recovery. The latest bar is red and still well above the early-window volume.
2025-04-14.combined: The rising volume during the sharp decline and the strong rebound suggests heavy participation on both legs, which supports a V-shaped reversal from the bottom. The recovery is not yet a breakout, since the latest close remains below the earlier highs.

2025-04-15.kline: After a modest early rise to a high near the top of the window, price fell sharply over several days to a low near the bottom of the range, then rebounded over the last several candles in a V-shaped recovery. The rebound has regained roughly half to just over half of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range but well below the window high.
2025-04-15.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window: the sell-off days carry heavy red bars, and the recovery days show the largest green bars, with the most recent sessions clearly higher than the early window levels.
2025-04-15.combined: Heavier volume on the rebound days, alongside a recovery that retraces about half of the drop, suggests buyers are stepping in and supports a V-shaped bottom, though price has not yet reclaimed the prior highs needed to confirm the reversal.

2025-04-16.kline: Price starts near the top of the range with a short up-and-down stretch, then drops sharply through the middle of the window to lows near the bottom. A partial recovery follows, with highs about three-quarters of the way up the range, but the latest red candle closes in the lower-middle area, below the halfway point. The fall covers most of the window and the bounce does not recover half of it.
2025-04-16.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or drying up. The tallest bars come in the middle-to-late part of the window, during both down and up days. The most recent days show moderate volume, similar to earlier levels.
2025-04-16.combined: Flat volume gives no strong confirmation of the downtrend or of the partial recovery. The lower close on roughly even volume suggests selling pressure continues without a clear surge in participation.

2025-04-17.kline: The window opens near the top of its range, then falls sharply through the middle candles to a low near the window bottom. A partial rebound follows, but the latest red candles close in the lower half of the range, below the midpoint, so the bounce does not change the overall decline.
2025-04-17.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained surge or fade across the window. The tallest bars sit in the middle of the window, including a large green day and several red days of similar size, and the most recent bars are mid-sized and close to the earlier average.
2025-04-17.combined: The falling price has not been accompanied by a clear volume expansion, so the selling lacks strong conviction and the downtrend is not confirmed by a volume surge. The partial rebound on similar volume also does not show a decisive shift toward buyers.

2025-04-21.kline: Price dropped from a high plateau near the top of the range early in the window to a low around bars 12-13, then rallied sharply on several consecutive green candles to a peak near the upper-middle of the range around bar 16, which is roughly 70% of the initial fall. The last four or five days rolled over with mixed small candles and a red close, leaving the latest close in the lower half of the range.
2025-04-21.volume: Volume was contracting, as the chart shows: the tallest bars came on the big green rally days around the peak, while the last several bars are noticeably shorter, with the most recent days at low volume and mostly red bars.
2025-04-21.combined: The heavy-volume rally that faded into light-volume red days suggests buyers lost momentum after the rebound, so the rise looks exhausted and the reversal toward the downside is weakly supported.

2025-04-22.kline: Price fell for roughly the first two-thirds of the window, dropping from near the window high to a low around the lower third of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then rallied over several days, recovering most of the decline toward the upper area, before pulling back slightly and ending near the middle of the range.
2025-04-22.volume: Volume was heaviest mid-window, with the tallest bars on the big green rally days and several red selling days, then tapered off into the final days, which are clearly shorter than the earlier bars. This matches the contracting volume state.
2025-04-22.combined: The V-shaped recovery on strong green volume suggests buyers stepped in at the lows, but the shrinking volume and the latest close near the midpoint make the reversal less convincing until price confirms higher with stronger volume.

2025-04-23.kline: The window opens near the top of the range, falls over several days to a low near the bottom of the range in the middle of the window, then rebounds in a series of higher candles. The rebound recovers well over half of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, below the window high. The shape is a V-like bottom.
2025-04-23.volume: Volume contracts: it rises into a large spike around the sell-off low and the rebound, then falls to small bars over the last several sessions. Recent up and down days both show low volume, with no bar in the final stretch matching the earlier peaks.
2025-04-23.combined: The rebound off the low has recovered over half the decline, but it is coming on shrinking volume, so the bottom lacks strong confirmation. Recent price gains are not being backed by heavy participation.

2025-04-24.kline: Price fell in a steady slide from near the top of the window to a low near the bottom around the middle-to-late part of the window, forming the left arm of a V. A rally of several days followed, recovering roughly two-thirds of the decline, and the latest green close sits in the upper half of the range, though below the window high. This is a V-shaped bottom reversal.
2025-04-24.volume: Volume was heaviest during the sell-off and the early part of the rally, with the tallest bars coinciding with large red and green candles near the low. Over the most recent days the bars shrink steadily and stay well below the peak, so volume is clearly contracting as the rally continues.
2025-04-24.combined: The rebound off the low is real, but it is coming on falling volume, so the recovery lacks the conviction that heavy buying would give. The V-bottom pattern is intact, but it would be stronger if volume picked up on the up days.

2025-04-25.kline: Price fell from the upper part of the window to a low near the bottom around the middle of the 20 days, with a long red candle at the trough, then rebounded through several green days. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, roughly two-thirds of the way up from the window low, after recovering most of the earlier fall in a V-like shape.
2025-04-25.volume: Volume contracts: the largest bars come in the middle of the window, around the rebound's strongest green days, while the most recent bars are visibly smaller and fairly uniform. Recent up and down days both trade on light volume, with no clear surge.
2025-04-25.combined: The rebound is occurring on fading volume, so the recovery looks less convincing than a reversal backed by expanding volume. Price has recovered past the midpoint, but the shrinking volume suggests the bottom reversal needs confirmation from a pickup in trading.

2025-04-28.kline: The window starts near the top, falls over several days to a trough around the middle-right of the window, then rebounds with a V-like recovery of roughly two-thirds of the decline. The latest candles sit in the upper part of the range, near the upper-middle, after the rebound.
2025-04-28.volume: Volume contracts: a large spike comes on the big green rebound day in the middle of the window, and volume then falls steadily, with the most recent days' bars clearly lower than the early and mid-window bars. Red down days carried the heaviest volume early on, while the recent green and red days are small.
2025-04-28.combined: The price recovery is real but is coming on shrinking volume, so buying conviction is fading rather than building. Confirmation would need the rebound to continue on rising volume.

2025-04-29.kline: Price fell from near the top of the window through the early and middle sessions to a low about a third of the way up from the bottom, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then rallied over several green days back to near the window high, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just short of the early highs.
2025-04-29.volume: Volume was heaviest in the middle of the window, around the selloff and the first green rebound days, with the tallest bar near the middle. Volume then contracted steadily, and the final several sessions show small bars, mostly green, with only minor red days.
2025-04-29.combined: The rebound recovered much of the decline, but it came on shrinking volume, so the recovery lacks strong buying conviction. The pattern is a reversal to the upside that is not yet confirmed by expanding volume.

2025-04-30.kline: Price fell over the first half of the window, with its lowest point near the bottom of the range, then rose over several days to finish near the upper part of the range. The rebound has recovered roughly three-quarters of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper quarter of the range, below the early highs.
2025-04-30.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur in the early and middle part of the window, while the most recent days show clearly lower bars. The recent up days are green but carry small volume, and the sell-off days earlier carried heavier red volume.
2025-04-30.combined: Rising prices on shrinking volume suggest the recovery lacks conviction and may not yet confirm a durable bottom. The reversal pattern would be stronger if volume expanded on the green up days.

2025-05-01.kline: Price fell to a low in the early-to-middle part of the window, then rallied sharply, with a red peak near the upper-middle of the range around the 9th to 10th candles. After a small dip, price climbed in a steady series of higher highs and higher lows through the last several green candles, and the latest close sits near the top of the 20-day range, at or just above the earlier highs rather than in a clear breakout.
2025-05-01.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bars come in the early and middle sessions, including the largest green bar, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter and cluster at a low level. The recent green up days carry noticeably less volume than the earlier rally days.
2025-05-01.combined: The price advance continues while volume shrinks, so the uptrend is intact but its momentum and buying conviction appear to be fading. Without a volume surge on the latest up days, the move does not yet confirm a breakout above the prior highs.

2025-05-02.kline: Price rose from the lower-left area of the window to near the top-right, with the advance made up of several green candles and only brief pullbacks, including a small red candle near the end. The latest close is a small red candle sitting in the upper part of the range, below the recent highs, so it does not break out of the prior range.
2025-05-02.volume: Volume contracted: the tallest bars occur early in the window, and the bars over the last several sessions are noticeably smaller, with the final bar a red day that is taller than the bars just before it.
2025-05-02.combined: Rising prices on mostly shrinking volume suggest the uptrend is intact but losing momentum, so the advance is less strongly supported than earlier. The larger red volume bar on the latest down day is a caution that selling pressure is appearing.

2025-05-05.kline: Price rose across most of the 20-day window from a low on the left to a high near the top of the range, with a steady series of green candles in the back half. The last two sessions are red and pull back from the window high, but the latest close still sits in the upper part of the range, so the pullback is too small to change the uptrend.
2025-05-05.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the early bars are tall and the middle and late bars are mostly moderate. The most recent red down days show volume near the window average, not a clear surge or drop-off.
2025-05-05.combined: The rise on broadly steady volume suggests a healthy but unremarkable uptrend. The recent pullback on similar volume does not confirm a reversal, so the pattern stays UPTREND.

2025-05-06.kline: Price falls from the left edge with large red candles to a low near the bottom of the window, then rallies through a staircase of green candles to a high near the top of the range, with a red pullback over the last few days. The rally recovers most of the earlier fall, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, a bit below the window high, so the shape is a V-like bottom with a small pullback at the end.
2025-05-06.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained surge or drop-off across the window. The chart shows tall early bars, a spike on a red down day near the right side, and lower mid-window bars, with the final few days roughly in line with the window average.
2025-05-06.combined: The rally off the low is not carried by a clear volume expansion, so the reversal is only moderately confirmed. The spike on the red decline and the recent pullback on steady volume suggest the bottom is holding but the recovery needs stronger volume to be fully convincing.

2025-05-07.kline: After a choppy start with a tall green bar at the left, price climbed for about ten candles to a window high near the right-center, then fell over the last four or five candles, giving back most of the rally. The latest red close sits near the middle of the range, just above it, so the top-shaped rise-and-fall is the clearest read.
2025-05-07.volume: Volume is flat overall: the early bars are tall and then fade, while the red down-day bars near the end are roughly comparable to the earlier activity rather than clearly heavier or lighter. Up and down days are mixed, with no strong surge or drop-off in the latest sessions.
2025-05-07.combined: The price rise and fall is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion on the decline, so the top looks plausible but not strongly confirmed. Follow-through on the next few sessions would be needed to validate the reversal.

2025-05-08.kline: Price rallies over roughly the first two-thirds of the window, with green candles pushing up to a high near the 15th day, then falls through a run of red candles that gives back about two-thirds of the rise. The latest red close sits in the lower half of the window range, forming an inverted-V style reversal top.
2025-05-08.volume: Volume is about the same across the window, with a few taller bars early on and near the middle, and the most recent bars are moderate, not clearly rising or drying up. Volume does not clearly swell on the down days, so it matches the flat volume state.
2025-05-08.combined: Price has turned down from the window high while volume stays steady, so the reversal is not confirmed by a volume surge. The fall on unremarkable volume suggests a weakening rally rather than strong selling pressure.

2025-05-09.kline: Price rallies over several days from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high, with a series of green candles, then falls over the last several days, giving back most of the rise into the lower half of the range; the shape is an inverted V with the latest close about a third of the way up the range.
2025-05-09.volume: Volume is flat overall, staying at roughly similar levels across the window, with a few taller bars on red down days early in the window and around the peak-to-decline stretch, while the most recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones.
2025-05-09.combined: The rally came on steady, unremarkable volume and the decline is not accompanied by a clear volume surge, so the top is credible on price alone but the flat volume gives no strong confirmation of selling pressure.

2025-05-12.kline: The window opens with a large red decline from near the window high down to the window low, then a multi-day green rally of several sessions back up to near the window high, forming a V-shaped bottom. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range after a small pullback, so the rally recovered more than half of the earlier fall.

2025-07-29.kline: Price starts near the window low with a few green days, then climbs in a choppy way to a peak near the upper part of the range in the second half of the window. 2025-08-05.kline: Price rose from the middle of the window to a peak near the upper part of the range, forming a rounded, inverted-V style top around the middle-to-late window. 2025-08-07.kline: After a mid-window slide to lows near the bottom of the range, the price bounces and the final candle is a strong green day that closes at the top of the window, well above the highs of the earlier part of the window. 2025-08-08.kline: The window starts with small candles in a sideways band in the lower-middle of the range, then falls steeply to a low near the bottom of the range around the 15th bar. 2025-08-11.kline: After a multi-day decline from the upper-middle of the window to near the window low, price rebounds sharply in the last 4-5 days, a V-shaped recovery. 2025-08-12.kline: Price spent most of the window in a sideways-to-lower zone with mostly small red and green candles, then fell to a low near the bottom of the range before a long green candle launched a sharp rally over the last three to four sessions. 2025-08-12.volume: Volume is expanding: the early bars are modest, with a few tall red bars during the decline, and the most recent sessions show the tallest green bars in the window, with the final day slightly lower but still well above the earlier average. 2025-08-12.combined: Rising price on rising volume confirms the breakout above the prior range, suggesting buyers are driving the move with growing participation.
