2025-08-29.combined: Rising price on shrinking volume suggests the uptrend is holding but losing conviction, since the recent advance is not attracting the heavy participation seen during the initial rally.

2025-09-02.kline: Price rallied sharply from near the window low in the first few days to the window high around the middle of the window, then pulled back to about the middle of the range before recovering in a series of mostly green candles. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, below the early peak, so the rise is intact.
2025-09-02.volume: Volume contracts: the tallest bars come in the early part of the window, around the sharp rally, and the most recent days show clearly lower bars. Recent up days carry only modest volume, and the latest red day is also lighter than the early spikes.
2025-09-02.combined: Price is still higher across the window, but the shrinking volume on the recent advance suggests weakening participation behind the uptrend. Without a volume expansion on new highs, the trend lacks strong confirmation.

2025-09-03.kline: After a low start, price rallied sharply, pulled back into the middle of the window, then rebounded through a cluster of highs, and the final green candle closes at the top of the window, above the earlier highs in a head-and-shoulders-free rise that leaves the prior range upward.
2025-09-03.volume: Volume is tallest in the early green sessions and shrinks over the window, with the middle red down days running at moderate levels and the most recent bars noticeably smaller than the early ones, consistent with contracting volume.
2025-09-03.combined: The breakout to new highs is occurring on contracting volume, so the price move lacks the volume confirmation that would normally support a breakout, making it a weaker signal.

2025-09-04.kline: Price starts low, rallies sharply early on, pulls back into a mid-window low, then climbs over the last few sessions to close near the window high, above the highs of the earlier part of the window.
2025-09-04.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge; the tallest bars are early green days, while the most recent bars are moderate and mostly green.
2025-09-04.combined: The rise above the prior range on only average volume is a weakly confirmed breakout, so it needs follow-through volume to be convincing.

2025-09-05.kline: After an early rise, price fell to a low around the middle of the window, where a large red candle marks the trough, and then rallied in a series of green candles. The last 3-4 days climb to the highest closes in the window, above the earlier peaks, and the latest red candle sits near the top of the range, so price is leaving the prior range upward.
2025-09-05.volume: Volume is flat: the tallest bar is the first day of the window, and the recent bars are roughly similar in height to the mid-window bars. Volume rises slightly on several of the latest green up days, but the last red day is not unusually large.
2025-09-05.combined: Rising price to new highs on volume that is no higher than earlier in the window only weakly confirms the breakout. Without a clear volume expansion, the move could fail to hold, so it needs follow-through on higher volume to be fully convincing.

2025-09-08.kline: The window falls from an early peak in the upper-middle range to a low near the bottom around the middle of the window, then rallies in a V-shaped recovery. The last few closes sit in the top third of the range, above the early-window highs, so price has left the prior range upward, and the latest red candle is near the window high.
2025-09-08.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the 20 days with no sustained build-up or fade. The tallest green bars come in the middle-to-late window during the rally, while the most recent red bars are moderate rather than extreme.
2025-09-08.combined: Price breaking above the earlier highs on volume that is not clearly expanding gives only tentative confirmation of the breakout. The rally has been supported by up days, but the lack of a volume surge on the latest moves suggests the move needs follow-through.

2025-09-09.kline: After a sell-off that bottomed near the window's lower third (around day 11), price rose steadily through green candles to a high near the top of the window around day 18. The latest candles pulled back on red bars, but the latest close still sits in the upper half of the range, so the rise is intact.
2025-09-09.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent bars are roughly the same size as those earlier in the window, with no clear surge or drying up. Tall green bars appear on several up days, while the latest red down days are moderate rather than heavy.
2025-09-09.combined: The rise on steady volume supports the uptrend, and the recent pullback on non-expanding volume looks like a normal pause rather than distribution. Without a volume surge, the trend is not confirmed as strongly as it would be on rising volume.

2025-09-10.kline: After a decline to a low near the window bottom, price rallied over several days to a peak near the window high, then fell sharply over the last several sessions, forming an inverted V shape. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range, giving back most of the rally.
2025-09-10.volume: Volume is expanding: the most recent sessions show the tallest bars in the window, clearly above the quieter earlier bars. The biggest volume bars come on the sharp down days at the end, while the rally days had more moderate volume.
2025-09-10.combined: Heavy volume on falling prices at the end of the window confirms the reversal from the peak and suggests selling pressure is strong.

2025-09-11.kline: Price fell from the upper-left into a low around the 9th candle, rallied for several green days to a peak near the 17th candle, then reversed with several red days that gave back most of the advance. The window high sits at that peak near the right-center, and the latest green candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the lower third, well below the peak, forming a rough inverted V.
2025-09-11.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the most recent red sell-off days show the tallest volume bars, well above the quieter bars in the middle of the window. Heavy volume clusters on the down days near the top, while the up days in the middle of the rally were comparatively moderate.
2025-09-11.combined: Heavy volume on the decline after the peak suggests strong selling pressure and supports the reversal from the rally high, rather than a routine pullback. The latest small rebound on lighter volume does not yet confirm a recovery.

2025-09-12.kline: The window opens with a sustained decline to a low about two-thirds of the way through the left side, then forms a V-shaped recovery: a multi-day rally of green candles climbs to a high near the window top around bar 16, recovering the full fall. A sharp red drop then pulls price back toward the lower range on bar 18, and the last two green days lift the latest close to just above the middle of the range, in the upper half.
2025-09-12.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, with the tallest bars appearing in the rally and again on the red drop near bar 18, while the early-window bars are shorter. The most recent green days carry moderate-to-high volume, so volume is clearly higher in the recent stretch than earlier in the window, as the stated expanding state indicates.
2025-09-12.combined: The V-shaped recovery on rising volume supports a bottom reversal, but the heavy-volume red drop just before the final rebound means the recovery is not yet clearly confirmed and the latest close sits only marginally above the midpoint.

2025-09-15.kline: Price rose through the middle of the window to a high near the right-center, then fell for several days to a low near the window's lower end (roughly a V-shaped drop), then rebounded over the last few candles, recovering most of that decline. The latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the upper quarter.
2025-09-15.volume: Volume expands over the window: the earlier bars are moderate, while the later bars are taller, with the tallest bars on red down days during the selloff and several large green bars during the rebound. The most recent bar is still fairly sizable, which agrees with the expanding volume state.
2025-09-15.combined: The price recovery on rising volume, with heavier green days during the rebound, suggests buyers are stepping in after the sell-off, which supports a bottoming reversal. The latest red day closing in the upper range on still-elevated volume is less conclusive, so the reversal needs follow-through to be confirmed.

2025-09-16.kline: Price fell from the middle of the range to a low near the bottom of the window, then rallied sharply in a V-shaped recovery to near the window high before a pullback, and rallied again into the upper part of the range. The latest green candle closes in the upper half, having recovered more than half of the earlier decline.
2025-09-16.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate and the last several sessions carry the largest bars, with several green up-days at or near the window's peak volume. Heavy red bars also appear during the pullback.
2025-09-16.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume in the recovery suggest buyers are returning and support a reversal from the lows, though the pullback volume shows some selling pressure.

2025-09-17.kline: Price rose steadily from a low near the window's lower part to a peak near the top of the range around the 14th day, then fell sharply for about four days with large red candles down to the lower area near the 17th day. A rebound of three to four days with green candles recovered most of that drop, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped reversal.
2025-09-17.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no strong surge or drying up. The tallest bars are a red day mid-to-late in the window and a green day after the drop, while the most recent bars are moderate green and do not stand out from earlier days.
2025-09-17.combined: The sharp rebound recovers most of the prior fall, but volume is flat rather than expanding on the green recovery days, so the V-shaped bottom has only modest volume confirmation and should be treated with caution.

2025-09-18.kline: Price rose from the lower left to a high near the upper middle of the window, then fell sharply over about four or five candles to a low in the lower-middle area, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then recovered over the last five or six candles, and the latest red candle closes in the upper half of the range, near the upper part of the window.
2025-09-18.volume: Volume stays at broadly similar levels across the window, with no clear sustained expansion in the latest days. The tallest bars cluster on the red selloff days in the middle of the window, while the rebound's green days carry moderate volume.
2025-09-18.combined: Heavy volume on the decline followed by only moderate volume on the recovery suggests the rebound lacks strong buying conviction. The flat volume state means the V-shaped recovery is not clearly confirmed by volume, so the reversal signal is tentative.

2025-09-19.kline: After a rally from the lower left, price fell sharply mid-window to near the window low, then recovered through several green and red candles. The latest candle is a tall green bar that closes at the top of the range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward. The latest close sits near the window high.
2025-09-19.volume: Volume is mostly moderate and similar across the window, with somewhat heavier red bars during the mid-window sell-off. The final day stands out as a volume spike, far taller than any other bar, and it is a green (up) day.
2025-09-19.combined: A large green up day on a volume spike, closing above the prior range, confirms the breakout.

2025-09-22.kline: After an early rise, price fell back into a sharp dip with a large red candle near the window low, then recovered through several green sessions. The final day is a long green candle that closes near the window high, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2025-09-22.volume: Volume is quiet through most of the window, with a few modest red and green bars, then climbs into the last few sessions. The final day is the tallest bar in the window by a wide margin, a clear volume spike, and it is a green up day.
2025-09-22.combined: A breakout on a volume spike with a green up day is a strong confirmation of the upside move, since heavy buying is driving price out of the prior range. The new move would still need follow-through to be fully trusted.

2025-09-23.kline: After a choppy rise from the lower-left with a mid-window dip, price surges in the last two sessions: a large green candle carries it to the window's highest level, well above the earlier highs. The final small red candle sits just below that peak, near the top of the range, so the latest close is in the upper part of the window.
2025-09-23.volume: Volume was quiet for most of the window and then spikes sharply on the second-to-last day, the large green breakout candle, which is the tallest bar in the chart. The final day's red bar is lower than that spike but still above the earlier average.
2025-09-23.combined: The surge through prior highs on a volume spike confirms the breakout. The softer red bar on the last day is a mild caution, but the price stays near the top of the range, so the breakout still holds.

2025-09-24.kline: Price spent most of the window in a choppy rise from the lower-middle of the range, then in the last few days a large green candle with a long upper wick pushed to the window high, well above the earlier highs of the window. The two red candles after it pulled back only slightly and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the window high.
2025-09-24.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window, with the largest bar of the period on the big green breakout day near the end, and it is clearly higher than the bars earlier in the window. The two red pullback days after it show noticeably smaller volume bars.
2025-09-24.combined: Heavy volume on the strong up day alongside the price break above the prior range supports the breakout, though the lighter volume on the following red days suggests selling pressure is limited but not yet confirmed as a new trend.

2025-09-25.kline: Price base-built near the lower part of the window, then sold off to a low around the middle-left, followed by a steep rally with a pullback; the last few candles (two tall greens and two red days) rose above the highs of the earlier part of the window, with the latest green close near the window high in the upper part of the range.
2025-09-25.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are small, while the largest bar sits on the big green rally day near the end, and the most recent bars stay above the early-window levels although they fall back from that peak on the red days.
2025-09-25.combined: Rising price to new highs on heavy volume during the rally supports a breakout above the prior range, though the lighter red-day volume during the pullback suggests some selling pressure that the latest green close will need to overcome.

2025-09-26.kline: After an early choppy stretch, price fell to a low near the lower-middle of the window, then rose in a steady climb with several higher highs and higher lows. The latest closes sit near the window high in the upper part of the range, and the latest bars do not clearly close above the earlier peak, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2025-09-26.volume: Volume is flat overall, staying at similar levels across the window with no sustained surge. The one standout is a tall green bar on a strong up day in the later part of the window, while the most recent days show moderate, mixed red and green bars.
2025-09-26.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume show the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by increasing participation. The single high-volume up day adds some support, but the lack of broad volume expansion suggests the advance is not yet accelerating.

2025-09-29.kline: The window starts with a fall from the early highs to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle of the window, marked by a long red candle, then a multi-day rally that climbs to a high near the top of the range. The rally recovers nearly all of the decline, forming a V-shaped reversal, and the latest close is a small red candle sitting in the upper part of the range just below the window high.
2025-09-29.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bar, a tall green spike, comes on a strong up day during the sharp rally, and volume falls off afterward, with the most recent bars clearly smaller than the earlier ones and mixing green and red days with no sustained buying or selling.
2025-09-29.combined: The heavy volume on the sharp rally supports the bottom reversal, but the fading volume on the recent pullback suggests the move has less participation and the reversal is not yet firmly confirmed.

2025-09-30.kline: The window starts mid-range, dips to a low with a large red candle in the lower part of the range, then rallies steeply to the window high with a large green candle. The last several days are choppy small-bodied candles near the top, and the latest close is a small red candle in the upper part of the range, so the overall pattern is an uptrend with pullbacks rather than a breakout or reversal.
2025-09-30.volume: Volume contracts over the window, with the largest green spike occurring during the steep rally. The most recent bars are clearly lower and mostly red, so the recent down days carry less volume than the earlier up days.
2025-09-30.combined: Price rose on heavy volume during the rally, which supports the uptrend, but the recent near-top consolidation is occurring on lighter volume and mostly down days. This suggests the upward momentum is fading and a breakout above the window high is not yet confirmed by volume.

2025-10-01.kline: Price fell over the first several days of the window into a low near the bottom of the range, then rallied for about ten sessions in a V-shaped recovery, with a large green candle in the middle of the rise. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, near the window high, and the recovery has erased most of the earlier decline.
2025-10-01.volume: Volume is contracting: the most recent sessions trade clearly below the peak. The largest bar is a green up day during the sharp rally, and the highest volume comes on up days. The last several bars are smaller and mix red and green, with the newest bars lower than the earlier window.
2025-10-01.combined: The V-shaped recovery was driven by heavy buying volume on the sharp up move, which supports the reversal. Volume has since faded while price holds near the top, so the recent strength is less convincingly backed by participation and the reversal needs follow-through volume to confirm.

2025-10-02.kline: Price dropped to a low near the bottom of the window, then rose across most of the 20 days, with a sharp green surge in the middle that took it near the window high. The last several candles are small-bodied and cluster in the upper part of the range, with the latest close near the top, so the rise has stalled into a tight upper-range trading area rather than breaking to new highs decisively.
2025-10-02.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest spike is on the big green surge day in the middle of the window, and volume falls off afterward, with the most recent bars clearly lower than the earlier ones and mostly alternating red and green at modest levels.
2025-10-02.combined: Rising prices on the big early volume spike show strong buying, but the fading volume into the recent upper-range candles suggests the uptrend is losing momentum, so the advance is intact without volume confirmation of a new breakout.

2025-10-03.kline: The window starts with a few red down days to a low near the lower-left, then turns up in a V-shaped recovery and climbs steadily, with a large green candle around the middle-right of the window. The latest green close sits near the window high in the upper part of the range, and the last several days are tightly grouped near the top, not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2025-10-03.volume: Volume is contracting as the charted volume state indicates: the tallest bar is a green spike on a strong up day around the middle-right, and volume falls off afterward. The most recent bars are noticeably shorter than the early and middle bars, with up and down days both running at modest levels.
2025-10-03.combined: Price is still rising and sits near the top of the range, but the rally is occurring on shrinking volume after a large volume spike, which suggests waning buying conviction and that the uptrend may be losing momentum.

2025-10-06.kline: Price starts in the lower part of the window, dips to the window low early on, then rises across most of the 20 days, with a sharp green surge around the middle that lifts it into the upper range. The latest close sits near the top of the window range, so the trend is intact.
2025-10-06.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest bar is a green up day in the middle, and the most recent days show clearly smaller bars that alternate between green and red, so the volume is fading.
2025-10-06.combined: The rising price on a large middle-window volume spike followed by shrinking volume suggests the uptrend is still in place but losing momentum, so the advance is less convincing than it was during the surge.

2025-10-07.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting near the lows and rising to the upper part of the range, with a sharp green surge about two-thirds of the way through. Recent candles churn just below the window high, and the latest close, a small red candle, sits in the upper part of the range.
2025-10-07.volume: Volume contracts over the window: it spikes on the large green up day near the middle, then fades to the smallest bars at the right, with the latest days clearly below earlier levels. The biggest volume bars are green up days, while several of the later red down days are still modest in size.
2025-10-07.combined: The rise is still intact, but the rally is losing participation as volume dries up while price stalls near the highs. This suggests the uptrend is cooling and needs volume to return on up days to resume with conviction.

2025-10-08.kline: Price climbs from near the window low through a series of green and red candles, then gaps sharply up about two-thirds of the way through the window to a level near the window high. The last several candles drift sideways in a tight band just below that high, and the latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, so the window is an uptrend with a consolidation near the top.
2025-10-08.volume: Volume contracts over the window: it spikes to the tallest bar about a quarter of the way in, which coincides with the large gap-up candle, and then falls. The most recent days show lower bars, mostly in the same bar height range as the middle of the window, with a few red down days alongside green up days.
2025-10-08.combined: The rally came on a large volume spike, and the recent rise near the highs is occurring on noticeably lighter volume. This suggests the uptrend is intact but its momentum is fading, so it does not confirm a breakout.

2025-10-09.kline: The price path rises from a low on the left, with a sharp advance in the middle of the window that lifts it to the upper part of the range, followed by choppy, sideways-to-slightly-higher trading near the window high. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, and pullbacks within the rise do not reverse the trend.
2025-10-09.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bar, a large green up-day, comes in the middle of the window, and volume then steps down to smaller bars, with the most recent days showing the lowest volume. Up and down days are both present in the quieter recent stretch, with no single day standing out.
2025-10-09.combined: Price remains near its highs while volume shrinks, so the uptrend is progressing on weakening participation rather than strong buying, which makes it less convincing as a continuation and leaves room for consolidation or a pullback.

2025-10-10.kline: Price starts low in the window, jumps on a large green gap-up candle around the middle of the window, and then runs up to a plateau of mixed candles near the window high. The last bar is a long red candle that drops sharply to about the lower-middle of the range, which is a one-day drop rather than a multi-day fall, so the reversal is only partly formed.
2025-10-10.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars come early, around the big gap-up day, and the recent bars are shorter and mostly near the average. The final red bar is a moderate-height bar, not a volume surge.
2025-10-10.combined: The sharp one-day drop on below-peak volume suggests a possible top after the rally, but the lack of a volume surge on the down day and the short length of the fall leave the reversal unconfirmed.

2025-10-13.kline: Price climbs from low levels on the left, with a sharp green rally through the first half of the window, then flattens into a choppy plateau near the window high. The final three to four days break lower with large red candles, giving back most of the rally, and the latest small green candle leaves the close around the middle of the range, in the lower half.
2025-10-13.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the biggest spike comes early on a strong green up day, and bars shrink steadily afterward. The sharp red drop days near the end carry only moderate volume, clearly below the early peak, and the final bars are among the smallest on the chart.
2025-10-13.combined: The decline off the top is occurring on lighter volume than the early rally, so the reversal lacks heavy selling conviction. Until volume expands on the down days, the top pattern is only tentatively confirmed.

2025-10-14.kline: After a sharp rise from the low area on the left, price made a rounded top near the window high, then churned sideways around that high for many days before a sharp multi-day drop with a large red candle. The latest close is a small green candle in the lower-middle part of the range, having given back roughly half of the rise, which fits a rise-then-fall top rather than a breakout or breakdown.
2025-10-14.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest bar is an early green day on the rise, and bars shrink through the middle and end of the window. The sell-off days carry only moderate volume, and the latest bars are among the smallest in the chart.
2025-10-14.combined: The rally was driven by heavy early buying, but later rises and the decline came on lighter volume, so momentum is fading. The falling price on modest volume gives only weak confirmation of a top, so the reversal signal is tentative.

2025-10-15.kline: Price rallied from a low near the window's left side to a cluster of highs around the middle-right, then fell through several large red candles that gave back most of the rise, and the latest candle sits in the lower half of the range near the lower-middle, forming a rounded top.
2025-10-15.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bars come early in the window, including a tall green spike on the rally, while the most recent days show smaller bars that are clearly below the earlier levels. The bigger red down days in the decline carried more volume than the recent small bars.
2025-10-15.combined: The rounded top with a fall on heavier volume followed by lighter volume on the latest days suggests the rally has lost momentum and selling pressure has faded without a clear new buying push. This supports a reversal top rather than a continuing uptrend, though the lower volume means the signal is not yet strongly confirmed.

2025-10-16.kline: Price rose from a low near the left edge to a peak in the right-middle of the window, then fell sharply through several long red candles, giving back roughly three quarters of the rise. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, forming an inverted-V shape, with small bounces at the end.
2025-10-16.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bars are at the far left, and the bars become progressively smaller toward the right. The largest recent volume spike is a red day in the middle-right of the window, and the final few days show modest volume on mixed up and down candles.
2025-10-16.combined: The price decline has come on falling volume, which suggests selling pressure is fading rather than accelerating, so the top is not strongly confirmed. A reversal top is still the best fit, but the lack of heavy volume on the latest down days weakens conviction.

2025-10-17.kline: The window opens with a choppy rise to a peak near the window high, then falls sharply over several sessions with large red candles down to near the window low. The last few days show a small green rebound that leaves the latest close only partway up the range, so the rise is largely given back, forming a rounded inverted-V top.
2025-10-17.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. The largest red bar sits in the middle-to-late sell-off, and the final sessions are not noticeably heavier than earlier days, so there is no volume surge behind the late rebound.
2025-10-17.combined: The price path points to a top that has been followed by a steep decline, but the flat volume gives no strong confirmation of the reversal. The late green bounce is not supported by rising volume, so it looks weak rather than a sign of renewed buying.

2025-10-20.kline: After a choppy rise to a peak in the middle of the window, price fell sharply to near the window low, then bounced modestly. The last day is a large green candle that gaps up from the prior close and closes near the top of the window range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so this is a breakout pattern.
2025-10-20.volume: Volume is flat overall, with recent days similar to the earlier part of the window. The final green day is the tallest volume bar, but it is a single isolated spike rather than a sustained increase, and the surrounding bars are mid-sized red and green bars.
2025-10-20.combined: The upside break is supported by price, but volume is not clearly expanding across the window, so the breakout has only a single-day volume confirmation. Follow-through over the next sessions would be needed to confirm it.

2025-10-21.kline: After a choppy stretch in the middle of the window and a sharp drop to near the window low, price rebounds with several green candles and the last 2-3 sessions push up through the highs of the earlier part of the window. The latest close sits near the top of the 20-day range, above the prior highs, which marks an upward exit from the earlier range.
2025-10-21.volume: Volume is flat overall: recent bars are roughly the same size as those earlier in the window, with mixed red and green days. The tallest bar sits on one of the late green up days, but it is not part of a sustained build-up in volume.
2025-10-21.combined: Price is leaving the prior range upward, but volume has not expanded to confirm it, so the breakout is less convincing and needs follow-through on higher volume to be fully validated.

2025-10-22.kline: Price fell over several days from the upper-left area to a low near the bottom of the window, then rallied sharply over the last few sessions in a V-shaped recovery with a large green candle near the end. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, having recovered more than half of the decline.
2025-10-22.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, consistent with the flat state, with bars of similar height throughout. The one standout is a tall green bar on the rally day near the right, while the most recent bar is moderate and red.
2025-10-22.combined: The recovery from the low is supported by a large up day, but without sustained above-average volume on the later sessions, the V-shaped reversal is only partially confirmed.

2025-10-23.kline: After a mostly sideways start in the upper-middle of the range, price fell sharply for about five days to the window low near the lower part of the chart, then rallied for about four days in a V-shaped recovery. The rebound recovered more than half of the drop, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, though still below the early-window highs.
2025-10-23.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar size from start to finish. One tall green bar stands out near the end on a strong up day, while the red down days during the drop carried moderate volume.
2025-10-23.combined: The V-shaped recovery is supported by a volume spike on the rebound's strongest up day, but the overall volume pattern is flat, so the reversal lacks broad volume confirmation. Price and volume together suggest a tentative bottom rather than a decisive one.

2025-10-24.kline: Price fell in a steep slide from the middle of the window to the window low, mostly through long red candles, then rallied over several green days to near the window high in a V-shaped recovery.
